jobs.title: Senior Ads ML Engineer
jobs.description:
About Gravity

Gravity is the ad network for AI. We place relevant, sponsored suggestions inside AI platforms, right when someone is deciding what to do or buy.

Everyone at Gravity believes three things:

AI should be free for everyone.
Most people will never pay for an AI subscription.
Someone has to pay for the compute, and advertising is the answer.

If you believe these too, you'll probably fit right in.

We built our ad engine from the ground up for AI interactions. Any AI platform can plug in with one integration, and we're already live on 50+ of them, reaching millions of conversations every day.

You can read more about us at trygravity.com. We've raised $38.5M from investors like Lightspeed, Committed Capital, Basis Set and Caffeinated Capital. We work in person in San Francisco, 6 days a week.

About The Role

We're hiring a Senior Ads ML Engineer
to own Gravity's entire ad engine. This is a senior IC role. You'll set the roadmap, working with our engineering team and our CEO, Zach.

Conversation understanding. Build semantic analysis of conversations from scratch, so the engine knows what each moment is about.
Identity and audiences. Build our identity graph and lookalike products.
Attribution. Build the attribution products that prove what's working for advertisers.
Auto-scaling. Build the auto-scaling that controls spend across different performance objectives.
Data. Decide what data to buy.
Training and deployment. Train the system and deploy it on live traffic.
Continual learning. Build an engine that keeps learning, and run RL on the best-performing ad formats.
Roadmap. Own the roadmap for all of it.

We're not tuning an old ad engine. We're rethinking how one should work: built for many performance objectives, and creating ads that fit the conversation and the person's history.

Job Requirements

Experience. 5+ years in ML, most of it on ads, ranking or recommendations.
End to end. You've built or scaled an ad engine and shipped models on live traffic that moved revenue.
Range. You've worked across several of identity, lookalikes, attribution, RL and continual learning.
AI-native. You're ahead of the curve on AI. You build your own workflows and systems with it, and most of your routine work already runs without you.
Ownership. You don't need to be told what to do. You take responsibility, you follow through, and you don't drop the ball.
No bullshit. You say what you think and you do what you said.

Nice to Have

LLM-based ad matching. Very few people have done it.

Compensation

$260K – $520K base
$625K – $1.25M equity
Health benefits
Unlimited PTO

Compensation Range: $260K - $520K

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role, requiring 3 days per week in our SF Hub. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer who takes real ownership and does well in a fast-moving, ambitious, and problem-oriented environment. You’ll work hands-on with improving our LLMs, and using them to solve for high-impact product opportunities. You’ll own part of the direction of our AI work: framing the right problems, finding their most effective solution, and helping shape the roadmap.

This role is a bit of a hybrid of machine learning/engineering with product. It would suit someone already in an AI Engineering role, as well as software engineers or data scientists that have gone deep into shaping models (themselves) to propel them forward.

What you’ll do

Lead entire AI/ML initiatives from problem definition through delivery.
Influence technical direction and roadmap decisions by framing problems clearly and backing choices with evidence.
Partner with product, engineering, and design to deliver high-impact models.
Strengthen our ML practices and infrastructure, including evals, training pipelines, and model serving.
Mentor teammates and share knowledge to raise the bar across the team.

By 30 Days, You Will Have

Upgraded an existing feature to be meaningfully smarter and/or faster, and shared what you learned with the team.
Reviewed our evaluation approach and improved or built evals for our core features.
Found the highest-leverage opportunities in our AI stack and started shaping priorities with the team.

By 90 Days, You Will Have

Led the delivery of AI features that address valuable customer use cases.
Fine-tuned models for our specific needs and set repeatable practices others can build on.
Developed new processes to speed up how we utilize new AI models.

Qualifications

A track record of owning and shipping production AI/ML systems end-to-end, with the independence and judgment expected of a senior engineer.
A blend of modern LLM expertise and structured problem-solving. You can work backward from a user problem, frame the right technical question, and define how to evaluate success. That structured problem-solving might come from product engineering, technical consulting, or comparable experience.
Deep hands-on experience in LLM post-training and/or inference optimization, with evidence of exceptional results in a specific problem area. For example:
Building a model that outperforms strong alternatives on a specialized task through thoughtful dataset development, supervised fine-tuning, preference tuning, or reinforcement learning.

Making LLMs substantially faster or more efficient through tailored quantization, speculative decoding, or other inference techniques.The ability to go beyond established recipes: diagnosing failure modes, designing experiments, and adapting methods to the problem at hand.Strong evaluation judgment. You design evals grounded in user needs, distinguish meaningful improvements from benchmark gains, and establish practices that catch regressions before users do.
Experience serving and optimizing models at scale, with a practical understanding of the trade-offs between latency, throughput, uptime, and cost.
Strong production Python and fluency with data, including building and cleaning datasets, analyzing results in Python or SQL, and working comfortably with modern training and serving stacks.
Experience influencing technical direction and helping other engineers succeed through clear reasoning, collaboration, and mentoring.

Nice to have

Experience spanning both LLM post-training and inference optimization.
Successful application of preference tuning or reinforcement learning to improve real-world model performance.
Speech or long-context experience, especially with noisy, lengthy transcripts.
Experience establishing ML infrastructure, evaluation practices, or model development workflows at a startup or growth-stage company.

How you work

Ownership: You take ambiguous problems and drive them to clear outcomes without waiting for perfect specs.
High standards: You care about quality and detail, you’re tenacious, and you raise the bar for everyone around you.
Pragmatic and results-driven: You pick the right hills to climb and find the fastest way up.
A generalist who dives deep: You might work on data one day and training methods or infrastructure the next.
Clear communicator: You explain technical results and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
Multiplier: You make the people around you better through mentorship, reviews, and knowledge-sharing.

Compensation And Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
Disability and life insurance options
401(k) and RRSP matching
Paid parental leave
20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time
Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)
Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location.

For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Efficient GenAI Models
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

The AI Models and Applications team at AMD is looking for a specialized Senior Staff Engineer who is passionate about enabling innovative and efficient Generative AI training and inference at scale. You will be part of a core team of incredibly talented specialists and work on scaling training and inference for the latest Generative AI models.

The Person

You have a deep technical understanding and hands-on experience with the latest Generative AI applications in at least one of the following areas: large language models (LLMs), 3D World and Action Models, or image/video generation models. You have experience training models at scale and are passionate about developing efficient approaches to enable distributed training and inference on AMD devices.

Why Join Us?

Exciting Opportunities: As a senior member of the team, you will be at the forefront of innovation, working with the latest Generative AI models and algorithms. You will have the opportunity to shape the future of AI model training and inference optimization across a variety of applications.
Talented Team: Join a team of highly skilled industry specialists who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI. Collaborate with like-minded professionals and learn from the best in the field.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with state-of-the-art Generative AI algorithms and software, enabling you to stay ahead of the curve and drive advancements in AI model training at scale and deployment.
Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly influence how cutting-edge Generative AI models across the industry are efficiently trained at scale, as well as how inference solutions are deployed to serve millions of customers, making a significant difference across various industries and applications.

Key Responsibilities

Propose and apply innovative techniques to support both training and inference, including innovative transformer architectures, parallelism strategies for training on large clusters, inference optimization techniques such as speculative decoding, and optimal KV-caching strategies.
Implement novel, efficient architectures for Generative AI models for training and inference and showcase the benefits on AMD platforms.
Work with open-source frameworks and communities (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, vLLM, SGLang) to integrate AMD-optimized models and libraries and publish training recipes.
Collaborate with software and hardware teams to co-optimize end-to-end performance on current and future AMD solutions.
Increase adoption of agentic workflows for optimizing and deploying Generative AI applications at scale on AMD platforms.
Publish and promote your work at external venues, including major conferences.
Collaborate with researchers within AMD and across industry and academia to promote innovation on AMD platforms.

Preferred Experience

Strong technical expertise in Generative AI model training and inference, with familiarity working with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, vLLM, SGLang, and MuJoCo.
Strong technical expertise in algorithmic innovation for efficient Generative AI applications across both training and inference.
Expertise and publications in one or more of the following preferred areas: efficient model architectures, optimized training, innovative parallelism strategies, or low-precision training.
Additional plus if publications have been presented at conferences such as NeurIPS, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, ICML, or ICLR.
Experience productizing Generative AI models and training foundation models at scale.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively both internally and externally.
Several years of experience in AI, deep learning, and related software development.

Academic Credentials

PhD or master’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

LOCATION:

San Jose, CA. Alternative locations in Seattle, WA, or Austin, TX may be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Scientist

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard – from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

We’re seeking a Senior AI/ML Scientist to design and deploy advanced machine learning solutions for vehicle lifecycle management, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance. You’ll work with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, machine learning, and real-time inference systems to develop intelligent, scalable solutions for automotive applications.

In this highly visible role, you’ll work with complex vehicle and engineering data to generate earlier, more precise insights. You’ll focus initially on 12-volt battery health and help develop approaches that can extend to infotainment and other vehicle systems. Your work will connect foundational AI/ML methods with practical tools used by engineers and service teams, helping them recognize issues sooner and resolve them faster. You’ll partner closely with engineering and AI colleagues and communicate findings and impact to a range of stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to apply advanced machine learning to complex engineering challenges and help turn vehicle data into practical insights that support better products and service outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Build, evaluate, and deploy foundational machine learning models using complex engineering, vehicle telemetry, and other technical datasets.
Develop signature clustering, anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis approaches to connect known issues with patterns in vehicle data.
Create predictive capabilities to detect battery drain, software issues, and emerging failure patterns earlier – supporting faster issue resolution and fewer avoidable warranty claims and service visits.
Apply advanced methods across deep learning, natural language processing, time-series forecasting, generative AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), selecting the right approach for each problem.
Integrate AI/ML capabilities into scalable tools and workflows, translating model outputs into useful, actionable insights for engineers and service teams.
Partner with domain experts and cross-functional engineering teams to frame problems, validate findings, and move solutions from experimentation into practical use.
Build and optimize LLM-based applications, including RAG systems for technical information and automated analysis.
Help develop reliable data pipelines and inference workflows, and communicate results to technical and non-technical stakeholders through clear recommendations, dashboards, or APIs.
Share your expertise and support the growth of other team members as AI/ML capabilities expand.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models, with a track record of applying modeling to complex real-world data.
Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience building, evaluating, and improving ML models.
Practical experience with deep learning and at least one major ML framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Strong hands-on experience with advanced and emerging modeling techniques, including deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, or vector databases, and the ability to select and apply suitable methods to complex problems.
Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with noisy, high-dimensional, or otherwise complex datasets.
Ability to collaborate across disciplines and explain technical results in a clear, decision-oriented way.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Skills)

Master’s or Ph.D. in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline; a Ph.D. is highly preferred.
8+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated experience building custom ML models on complex technical, engineering, or telemetry datasets.
Knowledge of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, diagnostics, or automated root-cause analysis.
Experience with automotive systems, vehicle data, or warranty and service workflows.
Familiarity with SQL, distributed data processing (such as Spark or Hive), ML platforms (such as Databricks, MLflow, or Azure ML), cloud environments, or containerization (such as Docker and Kubernetes).

Compensation:

The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate.

The salary range for this role is $144,700 - $261,300. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.
Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). This role is based remotely, but if the selected candidate lives within a specific mile radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week {or other frequency dictated by your manager}. This job is not eligible for relocation benefits. Any relocation costs would be the responsibility of the selected candidate.

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

Design, build, and deliver GenAI applications that elevate client experience and generate business impact.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align solutions with enterprise strategy and technical standards.
Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering strong practices and continuous learning.
Lead by example in solving complex technical challenges and driving rapid iteration from concept to deployment.

What you have

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have an opening for a Machine Learning (ML) Bioengineer
to conduct research training and evaluating next-generation clinical, protein and genome language models. You will join the Bioresilience Incubator, a dynamic engineering center that integrates predictive computational modeling, machine learning, and experimental biology to advance national security and public health missions. This position will be in the Computational Engineering Division (CED), within the Engineering Directorate, matrixed to the Bioresilience Incubator.

As a member of our multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate with experts in machine learning, molecular simulation, optimization, and bioinformatics, and interface with experimentalists generating large datasets via novel high-throughput assays. You will leverage in-house computational tools and contribute to the design, training, and evaluation of new machine learning-based methods.

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

Collaborate with project scientists and engineers to develop, implement, and evaluate computational frameworks and models.
Contribute to the development and application of advanced analysis methodologies; analyze data; document research through presentations and peer-reviewed publications.
Support technical activities for new capability development and provide solutions to moderately complex to complex technical problems using established and innovative methods.
Contribute to the completion of project milestones, influencing the development of organizational goals and objectives. Establish, implement, and maintain quality standards for project deliverables.
Contribute to briefings and presentations documenting project activities and research results.
Routinely interact with technical contacts at sponsor and partner organizations; represent the organization on specific technical projects.
Participate in the development of future research directions and proposals to secure ongoing projects in computational protein design.
Balance multiple projects/tasks and priorities to ensure deadlines are met, working independently with minimal direction within the scope of assignments.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Guide the completion of projects and influence the development of organizational goals and objectives.

Qualifications

Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.

Experience developing and implementing deep learning models and algorithms using modern software libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar, as evidenced by publications or software releases.
Experience with high-performance computing, multi-node, multi-GPU, distributed training.

Demonstrated ability to represent the organization as a primary technical contact and to contribute to the development of innovative projects, principles, and ideas.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to develop our core libraries for Agentic Applications. Are you excited by the prospect of building foundational technology that powers the next generation of agents? Have you ever dreamed of elevating engineering practices to enable the safe and scalable deployment of autonomous systems? As a global leader in AI and deep learning, NVIDIA is redefining industries and our work in agentic computing is at the forefront of this revolution. Join us in building the scalable agentic capabilities, reusable building blocks, and high-quality libraries that will accelerate developer productivity, ensure agent quality, and provide critical acceleration and optimization for highly performant and efficient agents. Work directly with a community of creative engineers and collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in the world of autonomous agents!

What You'll Be Doing

Track and understand evolving agent development patterns across NVIDIA and the broader ecosystem, maintaining current knowledge of both research and commercial products.
Develop open-source libraries and tools which accelerate and optimize agent harnesses and frameworks ensuring top-tier performance, accuracy, quality, and stability.
Benchmark the latest agents to identify bottlenecks and build creative solutions to increase performance, reduce cost, and improve latency.
Work closely with teams building high-performance data pipelines, RAG systems, vector databases, and GPU-optimized training and inference workflows to deliver best-in-class agentic applications.
Identify gaps and friction in current agent architectures, and translate insights into agentic tools that boosts developer velocity and agent quality—backed by evaluations, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years experience in at least one of Rust, Python, Go, or Node.js, with working familiarity in at least one more.
Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, callbacks, request lifecycles, and event-driven systems.
Hands-on experience with evolving agent architectures, multiple agents frameworks and agent harnesses.
Proficiency in LLM applications, agent workflows, tool calls, and model-provider APIs.
Ability to design or extend cross-language APIs with attention to consistency, usability, stability, and backwards compatibility.
Systems-level debugging and performance intuition: able to trace execution from high-level API calls through runtime internals, language bindings, callbacks, serialization, and event emission to understand overhead and optimize hot paths.
Strong interpersonal skills, enabling direct contact and effective collaboration with the open source community.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on.

We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way.

What you’ll do

Build models for the problems in front of us. You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi-view, multi-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short.
Work through the difficult footage. You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects.
Find out where your models fail. You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results.
Own the path to production. You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back.
Follow problems through to a fix. You’ll reproduce customer-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up.

What you’ll bring

Strong machine learning fundamentals. You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch.
Experience training large vision models from scratch. Your experience goes beyond running or fine-tuning existing models.
Depth in a computer vision specialty. You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction.
Experience owning models in production. You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward.
Comfort with the work as it is. You can make progress with noisy real-world data and adapt when priorities shift.

Nice to have

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

Hand and body tracking: 3D hand and full-body tracking, mesh recovery, human-object and human-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground.
SLAM, VIO and calibration: Learned ego-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale.
3D reconstruction and objects: Feed-forward or per-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

Meet the Team

At Foundation AI, we are leading frontier AI research across Cisco. Our mission is to advance the state of AI. We translate that research into purpose-built models, agentic systems, new algorithms, optimization methods, and scalable data processing techniques that solve real-world problems at scale.

We explore new model architectures, pre-training and post-training methods, inference optimization, evaluation techniques, and data pipelines. Together, we are advancing AI at Cisco and for the broader AI community!

Your Impact

As an AI Researcher, you will work on the research, development, and deployment of advanced AI systems. Your focus will span large language models, agentic AI, multimodal learning, and enterprise-scale AI applications. We are looking for researchers who will help translate frontier research into practical systems by designing experiments, developing new methods, and turning research insights into impactful, scalable AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in researchers with deep expertise in algorithm design for pre-training and post-training, scalable data curation, and reliable AI infrastructure. You will drive improvements to training algorithms, curate and optimize data at scale, and design infrastructure needed to train purpose-built models that can compete with frontier models on specific tasks aligned with Cisco's business priorities and Foundation AI's research agenda.

We place a strong emphasis on publishing research and contributing meaningfully to the AI community. In this role, you will write scientific articles for top-tier machine learning and AI conferences, publish technical blog posts, and contribute to the open-source AI community!

In This Role, You Will

Develop scalable data curation and processing methods that improve model training and task-specific performance.
Build production-ready AI systems using strong software engineering practices.
Optimize large language models and agentic systems for enterprise and security-focused use cases.

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect - Seedance / Seedream / Seed Audio
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Seedance, Seedream and Seed Audio are ByteDance's AI models for video, image and audio. Customers across advertising, gaming and frontier AI applications want to build with them, and most of those customers need more than an API key. They need someone who understands how their business makes content today, can show leaders where AI changes the economics, and can sit with their creators until the new workflow actually runs.

As an Applied AI Architect with ByteDance, you'll get to use our video, image and audio models and work with the teams that build them. You'll also own the full path from industry insight to working adoption: you learn the customer's business, advise its decision-makers on AI transformation, prototype the solution yourself, and train the creators who will use it every day. From first executive conversations to creators using the solution in production, you'll help define what Applied AI means for generative media across these rapidly changing industries. Multiple levels are available.

- Understand the industry and its workflows
- Build deep knowledge of how content is made and paid for in your target industries, from creative production and asset pipelines to budgets, timelines and performance metrics.
- Map where video, image and audio generation creates real value for a customer, and where it does not yet.
- Track how the industry is adopting generative media and turn that into a clear point of view on high-value use cases.
- Advise decision-makers on AI transformation
- Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives, including CMOs, studio heads, heads of creative and CTOs.
- Shape AI transformation roadmaps that cover use-case priorities, workflow and team changes, ROI, and governance for content safety and IP.
- Lead discovery sessions, executive briefings and workshops that turn broad ambition into scoped, fundable projects.
- Partner with Sales and Business Development on strategic accounts, from first conversation through deployment and expansion.
- Prototype agentic solutions on Seedance, Seedream and Seed Audio
- Turn real customer briefs into working prototypes quickly, so customers can judge results on their own content.
- Design end-to-end solutions that combine our models with APIs, agents, automation and the customer's existing tools and pipelines.
- Develop prompting and multi-model workflows that reach professional quality, and be honest about the limits of each model.
- Define how quality is evaluated for each use case, and guide customers from proof of concept to production.
- Enable creators and customer teams
- Design and run hands-on training for creators, artists, marketers and developers at customer organizations.
- Create the materials that let adoption scale without you: playbooks, prompt guides, demo libraries, templates and reference workflows.
- Build internal capability by equipping our sales and solutions teams with demos and vertical stories.
- Represent our models at industry events, creator communities and customer showcases.
- Close the loop with Product and Research
- Bring structured field feedback to product and research teams, with concrete examples of what works and what fails.
- Separate one-off customer requests from repeatable needs, and turn the repeatable ones into product requirements and reusable solutions.
- Test new model capabilities early and work out what they make possible for customers.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Minimally 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical or creative role, such as applied AI, solutions architecture, forward-deployed engineering, creative technology, technical art, or AI consulting.
- A track record of advising stakeholders and moving them from interest to decision. Good at crafting tailored industry stories and solution pitches to convince stakeholders to take actions.
- Hands-on experience with generative AI for video, image or audio, with a real sense of where today's tools excel and where they break.
- Ability to build: comfortable with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs and scripting, enough to ship a working prototype without waiting for an engineering team.
- Clear communication with both executives and creators, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- Experience teaching others, through workshops, training programs, public content or team enablement.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in industries such as advertising, gaming, model labs, robotics, film, VFX, e-commerce or other related fields.
- Having a portfolio of creative or technical work.
- Experience taking AI solutions from proof of concept to production in an enterprise setting.
- Familiarity with production tooling such as creative suites, ad platforms, game engines, 3D tools or simulation environments.
- Ideally coming with public presence in AI or creator communities.

About Us

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​

Why Join ByteDance

Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.​
As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

Team members for this role must be based In San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on our products daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Help shape how millions of people discover and get value from a connected suite of AI-powered products that work where they do.

Superhuman is bringing together products including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Go, GPTZero, and Fathom. The opportunity is bigger than growing any one product: it’s understanding how people move across the suite, what they need next, and how a more connected experience can create lasting value for users and the business.

As a Growth Data Scientist,
you’ll help define how we measure and accelerate that growth. You’ll investigate questions like which product a user is most likely to value next, where people encounter friction across the self-serve journey, and how packaging and monetization can support both adoption and retention. You’ll use experimentation, modeling, and rigorous measurement to turn those questions into decisions.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Finance, and User Research, with visibility into the leaders shaping our growth strategy. Your analysis won’t stop at reporting what happened: you’ll help teams decide what to build, where to invest, and how to know whether it worked.

This role is a chance to bring your multi-product growth experience to an ambitious, evolving portfolio—and help shape how it grows. If you enjoy untangling complex user journeys, connecting product-level insights to portfolio-wide outcomes, and making your work matter in the roadmap, you’ll find meaningful scope in this opportunity.

What you’ll do

Identify the next-best product within our suite that users would value through modeling, persona mapping, and experimentation that increases customer lifetime value.
Map and analyze self-serve user journeys across our product suite, from first visit through activation, purchase, and long-term retention.
Help shape the bundle economics and monetization capabilities of the Superhuman bundle.
Be an embedded data science partner across our growth areas, earning trust and driving evidence-based decision-making by turning insights into roadmap decisions.
Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions that improve user-funnel efficiency and drive meaningful user growth.

Qualifications

You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers.
You have experience with B2C or product-led growth, especially self-serve funnels spanning acquisition, activation, onboarding, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
You understand bundled products and multi-product growth, including how product discovery, adoption, cross-sell, and continued use of multiple products affect conversion, retention, and customer value.
You can use modeling and user-journey analysis to inform next-best-product recommendations, bundle economics, and monetization decisions.
You have experimentation expertise: you can design and analyze A/B tests, choose appropriate success metrics, account for guardrails and tradeoffs, and communicate uncertainty clearly.
You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions.
You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere.
You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity.
You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output.
You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

Nice To Haves

Experience with cross-product attribution and measurement, such as understanding how one product contributes to adoption or retention in another.
Expertise working within a multi-product GTM offering.
You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks.
You have experience working at a fast-growing startup, on AI-native consumer products, and/or in B2C/SaaS.

Compensation And Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
Disability and life insurance options
401(k) matching
Paid parental leave
20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time
Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)
Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Give every agent an owner, scoped credentials, least privilege, and approvals where the action calls for it, and track it from creation to offboarding like a user.
Own the security requirements for AI integrations (MCP connections, OAuth grants), memory, and retrieval, and set tenant defaults and approved connectors.

Put limits on tool calls, network access, data egress, and resource use.
Threat model and adversarially test our internal AI platform and agents, covering prompt injection, data disclosure, unsafe tool use, and unauthorized actions. Turn findings into regression tests and release gates.

About 5 to 7 years in security engineering, application security, or cloud security.
Hands-on experience securing LLM applications, agents, or AI developer tools, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use.
Strong in non-human identity: OAuth, SSO, SCIM, service accounts, and secrets.
Writes and ships code, building the tooling instead of stopping at a recommendation.

Experience with AI gateways, SSPM, CASB, or DLP tools.

This position will be filled at either the SES.3 or SES.4 level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

Develop and deploy remote sensing and data analysis pipelines on HPC and edge computers.
Modeling and simulation of orbital dynamics, remote sensing observations in LWIR to UV, and sensor tasking algorithms.

Document and publish research results in peer-reviewed scientific or technical journals and present results at external conferences, seminars, and/or technical meetings.
Collaborate with other scientists and technical personnel to accomplish research goals.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Lead projects independently, under minimal direction with parameters that may not be well defined and are of a complex nature.

M.S. in physics or astronomy with an emphasis in data science, modeling and simulation, orbital dynamics, or related subfield or the equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Experience with CUDA and deploying algorithms on Nvidia GPUs

They need someone who understands how their business makes content today, can show leaders where AI changes the economics, and can sit with their creators until the new workflow actually runs.

As an Applied AI Architect with ByteDance, you'll get to use our video, image and audio models and work with the teams that build them. You'll also own the full path from industry insight to working adoption: you learn the customer's business, advise its decision-makers on AI transformation, prototype the solution yourself, and train the creators who will use it every day. From first executive conversations to creators using the solution in production, you'll help define what Applied AI means for generative media across these rapidly changing industries. Multiple levels are available.

- Understand the industry and its workflows
- Build deep knowledge of how content is made and paid for in your target industries, from creative production and asset pipelines to budgets, timelines and performance metrics.
- Map where video, image and audio generation creates real value for a customer, and where it does not yet.
- Track how the industry is adopting generative media and turn that into a clear point of view on high-value use cases.
- Advise decision-makers on AI transformation
- Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives, including CMOs, studio heads, heads of creative and CTOs.
- Shape AI transformation roadmaps that cover use-case priorities, workflow and team changes, ROI, and governance for content safety and IP.
- Lead discovery sessions, executive briefings and workshops that turn broad ambition into scoped, fundable projects.
- Partner with Sales and Business Development on strategic accounts, from first conversation through deployment and expansion.
- Prototype agentic solutions on Seedance, Seedream and Seed Audio
- Turn real customer briefs into working prototypes quickly, so customers can judge results on their own content.
- Design end-to-end solutions that combine our models with APIs, agents, automation and the customer's existing tools and pipelines.
- Develop prompting and multi-model workflows that reach professional quality, and be honest about the limits of each model.
- Define how quality is evaluated for each use case, and guide customers from proof of concept to production.
- Enable creators and customer teams
- Design and run hands-on training for creators, artists, marketers and developers at customer organizations.
- Create the materials that let adoption scale without you: playbooks, prompt guides, demo libraries, templates and reference workflows.
- Build internal capability by equipping our sales and solutions teams with demos and vertical stories.
- Represent our models at industry events, creator communities and customer showcases.
- Close the loop with Product and Research
- Bring structured field feedback to product and research teams, with concrete examples of what works and what fails.
- Separate one-off customer requests from repeatable needs, and turn the repeatable ones into product requirements and reusable solutions.
- Test new model capabilities early and work out what they make possible for customers.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Minimally 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical or creative role, such as applied AI, solutions architecture, forward-deployed engineering, creative technology, technical art, or AI consulting.
- A track record of advising stakeholders and moving them from interest to decision. Good at crafting tailored industry stories and solution pitches to convince stakeholders to take actions.
- Hands-on experience with generative AI for video, image or audio, with a real sense of where today's tools excel and where they break.
- Ability to build: comfortable with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs and scripting, enough to ship a working prototype without waiting for an engineering team.
- Clear communication with both executives and creators, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- Experience teaching others, through workshops, training programs, public content or team enablement.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in industries such as advertising, gaming, model labs, robotics, film, VFX, e-commerce or other related fields.
- Having a portfolio of creative or technical work.
- Experience taking AI solutions from proof of concept to production in an enterprise setting.
- Familiarity with production tooling such as creative suites, ad platforms, game engines, 3D tools or simulation environments.
- Ideally coming with public presence in AI or creator communities.

About Us

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​

Why Join ByteDance

Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Fishers, IN, or nearby. This is an on-site position, not a remote one.

Company

At Arrive AI (Nasdaq: ARAI), we're not just building products; we're transforming the future of the Autonomous Last Mile™ (ALM). Over a decade ago, we started with a pioneering vision and patents for the first smart mailbox for drone delivery. Through systematic research, development, and deep customer collaboration, we've evolved to today, where we deploy Arrive Points: smart lockers and mini-cross-docks for frictionless drone, robotic, and courier delivery, from medical supplies to meals to e-commerce. Arrive AI is now scaling the ALM network and platform of the future for all autonomous delivery providers, services, and customers. We are the intelligent choice for the last inch of the Autonomous Last Mile™.

About Us

We move fast, balancing strategy with opportunity. We are merit-based, valuing integrity, innovation, and treating others as we want to be treated. At Arrive AI, every employee is an equity holder and a business owner. Our shared vision, ownership, and culture fuel our mission to revolutionize autonomous delivery.

Product Team

You'll be joining Arrive AI's Product Team to revolutionize Autonomous Last Mile (ALM) logistics by transforming over a decade of research, design, and customer collaboration into the world's first autonomous logistics network and platform. Our fast-paced skunkworks team rapidly iterates, prototypes, and develops next-generation Arrive Point units, networks, and AI-powered platforms. By integrating hardware, robotics, IoT, software, data, AI, and manufacturing, we're driving a bold roadmap for ALM innovation. Based in Fishers, IN, we offer a unique opportunity to do your life's best work, shape the future, and share in the success.

The Role

We're seeking a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to own the Arrive Point vision pipeline end-to-end: from the camera, through inference on the edge device, to the events that ArriveOS acts on and the data that reaches the cloud. You'll decide which models we run, train and optimize them, deploy them to NVIDIA Jetson hardware, and keep them accurate in the field.

This is a hands-on senior role with a bias toward the edge device. You'll work directly in C++ and Python with NVIDIA's DeepStream, GStreamer, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, and related frameworks. You'll be familiar with the cloud side and work closely with our platform team, who manages our operating system and cloud services.

What You'll Do

Own the vision pipeline: Own the Arrive Point vision stack from camera ingress through inference to the events ArriveOS consumes and the data that reaches the cloud.
Build edge pipelines: Develop and maintain C++ pipelines with NVIDIA's DeepStream and GStreamer on Jetson Orin and Thor, using Triton Inference Server and TensorRT.
Select and train models: Evaluate, select, train, and fine-tune the right model for each task, from binary classifiers and CNNs to vision transformers, object detectors, and vision-language models.
Optimize for the edge: Export models through ONNX to TensorRT, build per-platform engines (FP16, INT8), and verify accuracy, latency, and memory on the device.
Collect data on real hardware: Sample, curate, and label data from deployed cameras, fine-tune their configurations, and address edge cases.
Run the model lifecycle: Maintain the training and release pipeline, including dataset versioning, CI-gated evaluation, ONNX and TensorRT parity checks, robustness testing, drift monitoring, and retraining.
Integrate with ArriveOS: Work with the platform team on the gRPC contracts between the vision service and ArriveOS, our Rust-based edge orchestrator, including event debouncing, health reporting, and inter-process communication.
Stream video: Maintain live video egress over WebRTC for remote viewing and operations.
Deploy and operate: Containerize and deploy vision services to edge devices with Docker and K3s, including cross-builds, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and simulated test environments.
Work with the cloud: Collaborate with our cloud and platform team members on object storage, model publishing, and data flows between the edge and the cloud.
Protect camera data: Design with privacy and security in mind for video that can contain personal information (HIPAA familiarity and "on-prem only" experience are a bonus).
Document and communicate: Write architecture decision records, technical guides, and test reports, and present results and trade-offs to engineers, leadership, and partners.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Education and experience: A master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 3 to 5 years of industry experience, or a PhD with 3 or more years of industry experience. We weigh hands-on work with real cameras and edge hardware heavily.
End-to-end ownership: A track record of shipping a vision system from camera to production deployment, not only training models.
Model development: Classical and modern computer vision, with experience evaluating, selecting, training, and fine-tuning classifiers, CNNs, vision transformers, object detectors, and vision-language models in PyTorch.
Edge inference: TensorRT and ONNX, including engine builds, quantization, and accuracy checks after conversion.
Media pipelines: NVIDIA DeepStream and GStreamer.
Serving and APIs: Triton Inference Server, gRPC, and modern API-driven development workflows.
Edge hardware: NVIDIA Jetson (Orin, Thor) and other edge compute such as Raspberry Pi.
Programming: Strong C++ (C++17 or later) and Python.
Data on real hardware: Confidence collecting data on edge devices, including sampling, curation, labeling, edge-case analysis, and adjusting camera and lighting conditions.
Containers and DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes or K3s, CI/CD pipelines, and working familiarity with AWS or Azure and S3-compatible object storage.
Communication: Clear writing and presenting for technical and non-technical audiences, and a habit of documenting as you build.
Learning and flexibility: Quick to pick up new tools, platforms, and problems in a fast-moving startup.

Nice to Have

Specific models: YOLO, TinyViT, NVIDIA PeopleNet, and the NVIDIA TAO Toolkit.
WebRTC: Live video with WebRTC, including SFUs, WHIP, and TURN and STUN.
Inter-process communication: Unix domain sockets, shared memory, and message framing with FlatBuffers or Protocol Buffers.
Camera hardware: Image sensors, optics, housings, GigE, MIPI CSI-2, USB and V4L2, Intel RealSense, and time-of-flight sensors.
Other languages: Familiarity with Rust-based architectures, and Go.
Additional perception: OCR and depth sensing.
MLOps: Dataset versioning, drift monitoring, and label quality analysis.
Video integration: RTSP, ONVIF, and video management systems.
Domain: A background in logistics, delivery, retail, or security video.

Additional

Expect to travel up to 5 days per month.
Responsibilities include all other duties as assigned.
At this time, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Compensation

Salary is market competitive with a high equity incentive. Be an owner and grow with Arrive AI.

jobs.description:
Archer
is collaborating with Air
to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Company Description

Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our Agentic AI team as we scale our AI capabilities across all levels of the U.S. government.

Over the past year, we have seen rapid adoption of our AI agent, Ace. We are building the systems and infrastructure required to move agentic AI beyond demos and prototypes into reliable, production-grade software operating against complex, real-world problems.

This role sits at the intersection of applied AI and systems engineering. You will design and build agent architectures, model integrations, tools, evaluation systems, and infrastructure that enable increasingly capable AI systems. You will work across the AI stack - from experimentation and model behavior to production services and distributed infrastructure.

In order to do this job well: we are looking for engineers who understand that building great AI products requires more than calling a model API. You should be comfortable reasoning about how agents use context, tools, models, memory, and compute, and turning those ideas into reliable production systems.

This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Arlington, VA / Pittsburgh, PA / San Francisco, CA / Anywhere in the US.

This role may require up to 25% travel, including periodic travel to our Pittsburgh, PA and Arlington, VA offices for team collaboration, planning activities, and in-person meetings.

Scope of Responsibilities

Design, build, and improve production agentic AI systems used to solve complex real-world problems.
Develop agent architectures for reasoning, planning, tool use, context management, memory, and multi-step task execution.
Build tools and capabilities that allow agents to securely interact with data, APIs, code, and external systems.
Develop model and inference infrastructure supporting multiple commercial and open-weight language models.
Evaluate new models, inference techniques, and emerging AI capabilities and determine how they can improve our production systems.
Build automated evaluation frameworks to measure agent quality, reliability, task completion, and regressions.
Develop datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies for complex agentic workflows.
Improve agent performance through prompt and context engineering, model selection, tool design, inference strategies, and architectural improvements.
Build scalable APIs, services, and infrastructure supporting agent execution and AI-powered product experiences.
Design systems for asynchronous and long-running agent workflows.
Build infrastructure for safe and reliable execution of agent-generated code and other computational workloads.
Improve system observability through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, and automated alerting.
Investigate failures across models, agents, application code, and distributed infrastructure and turn those findings into systematic improvements.
Optimize model and agent systems for latency, throughput, reliability, and infrastructure cost.
Translate new AI research and emerging techniques into practical improvements to production systems.
Work closely with product, platform, security, and domain teams to bring new AI capabilities from experimentation to production.

Qualifications

U.S. Citizenship is required

Required Skills

5+ years of experience building production software, AI/ML systems, distributed systems, or similar technical systems.
Deep experience designing, building, and operating production AI agents or agent platforms.
Experience developing core agent infrastructure, including agent runtimes, tool execution, context management, memory, orchestration, or related platform capabilities.
Strong understanding of state-of-the-art agent architectures and the engineering tradeoffs involved in building reliable, production-grade agentic systems.
Experience designing agents that use tools, reason across multi-step tasks, interact with external systems, and operate over long-running or complex workflows.
Experience building evaluation systems for agents, including task-level evaluations, behavioral evaluations, regression testing, and production quality measurement.
Strong understanding of modern LLM systems, including model inference, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, model selection, and techniques for improving agent performance.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging models, research, and agent techniques and translate promising approaches into production systems.
Strong programming experience in Python and experience building production-quality software.
Experience designing scalable APIs, services, asynchronous systems, and event-driven architectures.
Experience operating production services using Kubernetes and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, containers, service orchestration, networking, storage, and scalable architectures.
Comfortable debugging complex failures spanning model behavior, agent execution, application code, and production infrastructure.
Able to move quickly between research and engineering: prototype an idea, evaluate it rigorously, understand why it works or fails, and turn successful approaches into reliable production systems.
Comfortable working at the frontier of a rapidly evolving field where established patterns may not yet exist.

Desired Skills

Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship
Experience in or exposure to the nuances of a startup or other entrepreneurial environment
Experience building secure code execution environments or sandboxes for AI agents.
Experience with multi-agent architectures, agent-to-agent communication, or distributed agent execution.
Experience with fine-tuning, post-training, reinforcement learning, or synthetic data generation.
Experience building AI observability, tracing, and debugging infrastructure.
Experience optimizing inference latency, throughput, GPU utilization, or model-serving costs.
Experience with AI security, adversarial testing, or securing agentic systems.
Experience working in government, defense, or other mission-critical environments.

We firmly believe that past performance is the best indicator of future performance. If you thrive while building solutions to complex problems, are a self-starter, and are passionate about making an impact in global security, we’re eager to hear from you.

Air is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Description

Senior Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Scientist

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard – from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

We’re seeking a Senior AI/ML Scientist to design and deploy advanced machine learning solutions for vehicle lifecycle management, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance. You’ll work with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, machine learning, and real-time inference systems to develop intelligent, scalable solutions for automotive applications.

In this highly visible role, you’ll work with complex vehicle and engineering data to generate earlier, more precise insights. You’ll focus initially on 12-volt battery health and help develop approaches that can extend to infotainment and other vehicle systems. Your work will connect foundational AI/ML methods with practical tools used by engineers and service teams, helping them recognize issues sooner and resolve them faster. You’ll partner closely with engineering and AI colleagues and communicate findings and impact to a range of stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to apply advanced machine learning to complex engineering challenges and help turn vehicle data into practical insights that support better products and service outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Build, evaluate, and deploy foundational machine learning models using complex engineering, vehicle telemetry, and other technical datasets.
Develop signature clustering, anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis approaches to connect known issues with patterns in vehicle data.
Create predictive capabilities to detect battery drain, software issues, and emerging failure patterns earlier – supporting faster issue resolution and fewer avoidable warranty claims and service visits.
Apply advanced methods across deep learning, natural language processing, time-series forecasting, generative AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), selecting the right approach for each problem.
Integrate AI/ML capabilities into scalable tools and workflows, translating model outputs into useful, actionable insights for engineers and service teams.
Partner with domain experts and cross-functional engineering teams to frame problems, validate findings, and move solutions from experimentation into practical use.
Build and optimize LLM-based applications, including RAG systems for technical information and automated analysis.
Help develop reliable data pipelines and inference workflows, and communicate results to technical and non-technical stakeholders through clear recommendations, dashboards, or APIs.
Share your expertise and support the growth of other team members as AI/ML capabilities expand.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models, with a track record of applying modeling to complex real-world data.
Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience building, evaluating, and improving ML models.
Practical experience with deep learning and at least one major ML framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Strong hands-on experience with advanced and emerging modeling techniques, including deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, or vector databases, and the ability to select and apply suitable methods to complex problems.
Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with noisy, high-dimensional, or otherwise complex datasets.
Ability to collaborate across disciplines and explain technical results in a clear, decision-oriented way.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Skills)

Master’s or Ph.D. in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline; a Ph.D. is highly preferred.
8+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated experience building custom ML models on complex technical, engineering, or telemetry datasets.
Knowledge of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, diagnostics, or automated root-cause analysis.
Experience with automotive systems, vehicle data, or warranty and service workflows.
Familiarity with SQL, distributed data processing (such as Spark or Hive), ML platforms (such as Databricks, MLflow, or Azure ML), cloud environments, or containerization (such as Docker and Kubernetes).

Compensation:

The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate.

The salary range for this role is $144,700 - $261,300. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.
Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). This role is based remotely, but if the selected candidate lives within a specific mile radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week {or other frequency dictated by your manager}.
