jobs.description:
Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Medford, Burlington, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices.

Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside within a commutable distance from our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices, or who are willing to relocate.

Build a career with purpose. Join our
Cause
to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For

Every day, Cambia's Data & Analytics Engineering Team is living our mission to make health care easier and lives better.

Join our Data & Analytics Engineering team as a Senior Engineer on the Semantic & Agentic Intelligence Squad. You will design, build, and own the semantic foundation and agentic AI capabilities that power governed analytics, intelligent automation, and purpose-built data products across the enterprise.

You will serve as a technical lead, combining deep dimensional modeling expertise with modern AI/LLM engineering, mentoring engineers, driving technical standards, and contributing to platform strategy. This role positions you for growth into Principal-level engineering, architecture, or people leadership.

If you're a motivated Senior Engineer with a passion for making data trustworthy, intelligent, and actionable in healthcare, apply today!

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:

6+ years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Semantic Modeling, or AI/ML Engineering, with senior or lead experience
College degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field
A degree may be substituted by sufficient years of experience in the healthcare industry

Experience with a supported business area is preferred (e.g., Provider Network, Claims, Membership, Digital Solutions, Pricing)
Equivalent combination of education and experience

Skills and Attributes:
Preferably seeking a technically versatile engineer with deep expertise in dimensional modeling, semantic layer design, and agentic AI development. You bring a consulting-oriented mindset, strong SQL fundamentals, and hands-on experience building governed, observable AI solutions in complex enterprise environments.

Preferred Skills

Dimensional Modeling & Data Platform

Deep expertise in dimensional modeling with strong command of grain, bridge tables, many-to-many relationships, and slowly changing dimensions (SCDs)
Awareness of common data modeling pitfalls and how to prevent them
Strong SQL skills on Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Experience with dbt, ELT/ETL design patterns, and orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)
Understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and enterprise platform ownership

Semantic Layer & Governed Metrics

Experience defining governed metrics in a semantic or metrics layer
Has built and deployed a semantic layer (SSAS, LookML, dbt Semantic Layer, or similar) used directly by business users
Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and diagnosing and fixing root causes in the semantic layer

Agentic AI & LLM Engineering

Experience deploying and monitoring AI agents in a governed, regulated environment
Built LLM/agentic applications including RAG pipelines, embeddings/vector search, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agent orchestration frameworks
Experienced with Snowflake Cortex (Analyst, Search, Agents) or comparable native AI tooling
Experience developing and managing AI agents for use cases such as:
Prior authorization
Member support
Care gap identification
Utilization analytics
Anomaly/outlier detection

AI Ops & Observability

Implemented evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability for AI agents covering accuracy, hallucination detection, latency, and cost
Familiarity with scoring techniques such as F1 scoring and related evaluation metrics
Experience with model/agent monitoring, cost optimization, and performance tuning

Healthcare Domain Knowledge

Working knowledge of payer data: claims (837/835), eligibility, enrollment, and provider data
Familiarity with healthcare standards: HL7/FHIR, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS

Nice To Have

Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or formal business vocabularies
Built and managed MLOps pipelines with familiarity with ML models including regression and ensemble methods (e.g., KNN, XGBoost, Random Forest, Decision Trees)
Experience building consumer-facing AI applications or features involving inference
Experience building multi-tier AI applications or multi-agent workflows, including multimodal LLM experience
Experience with statistical and predictive modeling (regression, classification, clustering, time series forecasting)
Experience with BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and translating analytical findings into business narratives
Exposure to experimentation and hypothesis testing (A/B testing, statistical significance)

What You Will Do At Cambia

Lead and mentor Data and AI Engineers and drive engineering standards and best practices across the squad
Design, build, and own scalable dimensional models, semantic layers, and governed metric definitions used by business users and AI systems
Develop and deploy AI agents for healthcare use cases (prior authorization, member support, care gaps, utilization analytics, anomaly detection) in a governed, regulated environment
Build LLM/agentic applications including RAG pipelines, vector search, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration leveraging Snowflake Cortex or comparable tooling
Implement AI Ops practices including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and cost/performance optimization for deployed agents
Optimize platform performance including query tuning, compute sizing, workload isolation, and cost management
Partner with Analytics, Product, Governance, QA, and Business teams to deliver high-quality, observable, and trustworthy data and AI solutions
Contribute to platform strategy, risk assessments, and adoption of modern practices (DataOps, CI/CD, AI tooling)
Ensure data quality, testing, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the team
Demonstrate technical leadership by breaking down complex work and delivering measurable value in squad/model environments

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.

National pay structure — applies to the Boise and Lewiston, ID; Salt Lake City, UT, Oregon and Washington. The full salary range is $115,000 - $188,000 and the bonus target is 15%. The expected salary range is $122,000 - $165,000/year.
Regional pay structure — applies to North Dakota and Idaho and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The full salary range is $103,000 - $169,000 and the bonus target is 15%. The expected salary range is $110,000 - $149,000/year.

About Cambia

Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.

Why Join the Cambia Team?

At Cambia, You Can

Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.

Benefits

In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:

Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
Commute and parking benefits.

Learn More About Our Benefits.

We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.

Define the technical vision and reference architecture for Search AI, including search, retrieval, ranking, relevance, AI-assisted retrieval, and intelligent query processing.
Architect highly scalable distributed search and retrieval systems capable of supporting high-volume, low-latency, mission-critical applications.

Design and evolve search relevance and ranking architectures, including lexical retrieval, semantic/vector retrieval, hybrid search, query understanding, intent detection, learning-to-rank, reranking, personalization, and related ML techniques.

Work closely with teams building high-performance data pipelines, RAG systems, vector databases, and GPU-optimized training and inference workflows to deliver best-in-class agentic applications.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Join us in building the scalable agentic capabilities, reusable building blocks, and high-quality libraries that will accelerate developer productivity, ensure agent quality, and provide critical acceleration and optimization for highly performant and efficient agents. Work directly with a community of creative engineers and collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in the world of autonomous agents!

Track and understand evolving agent development patterns across NVIDIA and the broader ecosystem, maintaining current knowledge of both research and commercial products.
Develop open-source libraries and tools which accelerate and optimize agent harnesses and frameworks ensuring top-tier performance, accuracy, quality, and stability.
Benchmark the latest agents to identify bottlenecks and build creative solutions to increase performance, reduce cost, and improve latency.

Identify gaps and friction in current agent architectures, and translate insights into agentic tools that boosts developer velocity and agent quality—backed by evaluations, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, callbacks, request lifecycles, and event-driven systems.
Hands-on experience with evolving agent architectures, multiple agents frameworks and agent harnesses.
Proficiency in LLM applications, agent workflows, tool calls, and model-provider APIs.
Ability to design or extend cross-language APIs with attention to consistency, usability, stability, and backwards compatibility.
Systems-level debugging and performance intuition: able to trace execution from high-level API calls through runtime internals, language bindings, callbacks, serialization, and event emission to understand overhead and optimize hot paths.
Strong interpersonal skills, enabling direct contact and effective collaboration with the open source community.

Experience building evaluation/benchmarking systems for agent workflows (metrics, regression, feedback loops).

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Role Overview

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical owner for strategic customer AI engagements, responsible for turning high-value business problems into working, production-ready AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI engineering, solution architecture, and hands-on delivery. The FDE works directly with customer business and technical teams to identify the right problem, rapidly build and validate a solution, deploy it into real operating environments, and continuously optimize it against measurable business outcomes.

This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end-to-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer.

Key Responsibilities

Own customer outcomes end to end. Partner with customer business and technical leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, define measurable success criteria, and own the technical outcome from discovery through prototype, live test, production, and optimization.
Build hands-on. Rapidly prototype, code, configure, integrate, test, and deploy AI solutions using customer systems, APIs, data, workflows, and cloud services.
Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and optimize agent behavior, prompts, context, tool invocation, orchestration, grounding, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Connect AI to the enterprise. Develop secure integrations across APIs, webhooks, enterprise applications, data platforms, identity systems, and legacy environments so AI agents can act reliably within real business workflows.
Validate with engineering rigor. Build evaluation and observability approaches that test accuracy, safety, latency, reliability, and business outcomes; diagnose failures and edge cases and iterate rapidly.
Move prototypes into production. Apply sound software engineering, security, governance, CI/CD, version control, monitoring, and operational practices to deliver maintainable production solutions.
Remove production blockers. Work directly with Genesys Product, Engineering, Support, and cross-functional teams to identify platform gaps, resolve technical issues, and unblock customer deployment.
Co-build with customers. Work alongside customer engineers and architects, transfer knowledge, and leave customer teams more capable of operating and extending the solution after the engagement.
Create the field-to-product feedback loop. Translate repeatable customer needs, deployment friction, and edge cases into actionable product feedback, feature requests, technical patterns, and reference implementations.
Build once, scale everywhere. Package proven agents, integrations, prompts, evaluation methods, deployment patterns, and implementation playbooks into reusable assets that accelerate future customer engagements.
Operate with ownership and urgency. Maintain accountability through resolution, manage ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and drive multiple stakeholders toward measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical delivery, solution architecture, or a comparable hands-on role; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
Demonstrated production ownership. Experience taking at least one meaningful software, AI, data, or integration solution from concept or prototype into a production environment and supporting it through real-world use.
Enterprise integration expertise. Experience designing or building with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication/authorization, structured and unstructured data, and modern cloud or SaaS architectures.
Applied AI and LLM knowledge. Practical experience with large language models and agentic AI concepts such as prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, orchestration, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and guardrails.
Engineering discipline for AI. Ability to test, debug, monitor, and improve AI systems using repeatable evaluation, tracing, logging, versioning, and software quality practices.
Customer-facing technical leadership. Ability to lead discovery and technical working sessions, translate ambiguous business problems into buildable technical solutions, and communicate credibly with both senior executives and engineers.
High-agency execution. A record of learning quickly, making sound tradeoffs, operating effectively with incomplete information, and owning problems through resolution rather than handing them off.
Collaborative product mindset. Ability to work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Engineering, Support, Security, and customer teams while converting field learnings into reusable patterns and product feedback.
AI-native development mindset. Comfort using modern AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate software delivery while remaining accountable for code quality, security, and maintainability.
AI-assisted engineering tools. Experience using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Amazon Kiro, or similar AI coding environments as part of a regular development workflow.
Enterprise data and knowledge systems. Experience with vector databases, search, data pipelines, knowledge retrieval, enterprise data platforms, or integrating AI with CRM, ERP, ITSM, or other systems of record.
Agentic AI experience. Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, agent-to-agent workflows, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
Travel flexibility. Ability to travel to customer sites and company events as needed for strategic engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on programming capability. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or an equivalent language, with the ability and willingness to learn additional technologies quickly.
Production AI observability and optimization. Experience with evaluation pipelines, tracing, latency and cost optimization, reliability monitoring, safety controls, or LLM-native performance metrics.
Cloud and deployment experience. Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and with deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, or serverless architectures.
Conversational or voice AI experience. Experience building customer-facing conversational AI, virtual agents, voice AI, or contact-center solutions.
Customer experience domain knowledge. Experience with Genesys Cloud CX, customer experience technology, contact center platforms, workforce engagement, routing, or related enterprise SaaS solutions is valuable but not required.
Security and responsible AI. Understanding of enterprise security, identity and access management, data privacy, auditability, permissioning, prompt injection risks, and safe tool execution for AI systems.
Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced technical education is a plus but not required.

The profile we are building: Business thinker. Hands-on builder. Customer technologist. Relentless owner. Builds once, scales everywhere.

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$134,900.00 - $237,300.00

Benefits:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
Telehealth coverage
Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities
Development and career growth opportunities
Open Time Off in addition to 10 paid holidays
401(k) matching program
Adoption Assistance
Fertility treatments

Working at Genesys

AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

jobs.title: AWS AI Architect/Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking an experienced AI Architect/Engineer
to design, build, and operate enterprise-ready AI/ML solutions and secure, scalable cloud-native applications within AWS GovCloud. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technologist with strong expertise in AI/ML engineering, generative AI, LLM architecture, and AWS cloud services, including serverless and event-driven architecture. This individual will bring strong technical leadership and problem-solving skills to translate complex business needs into production-ready solutions while ensuring security, scalability, and compliance with enterprise and fedRAMP HIGH requirements.

Responsibilities

Architect and lead the development of scalable, secure AI/ML solutions and cloud-native applications within AWS GovCloud, adhering to FedRAMP High and enterprise security standards.
Engineer end-end LLM workflows, including data ingestion, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and vector databases.
Design, develop, and operate serverless and event-driven workloads using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Step Functions, Fargate, and DynamoDB.
Build reusable AI accelerators, shared libraries, APIs, and microservices that integrate AI models with enterprise platforms.
Maintain FedRAMP High compliance posture including encryption at rest and in transit, access logging, and audit trail integrity.
Manage secure, containerized applications with AWS Fargate and Application Load Balancer.
Administer data governance controls including fine-grained access and cross-account sharing through AWS Lake Formation.
Monitor platform health and triage operational issues using CloudWatch, EventBridge, and standard alerting patterns.
Work within the constraints of organizational SCPs and coordinate with the central cloud team as needed.
Implement cloud security and governance controls, including IAM, encryption, KMS, Secrets Manager, AWS Lake Formation, fine-graine access controls, and cross-account data sharing.
Collaborate with product teams, data scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into production-ready solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with at least 8+ years of professional experience.
5+ years of cloud architecture experience with hands-on work in event-driven, serverless systems with 2+ years dedicated to AI/ML, generative AI, or LLM-powered application development.
Comfortable reading and contributing to Python or other programming languages.
Hands-on experience developing production AI applications, REST APIs, backend microservices, RAG workflows, embeddings, vector databases, and multi-agent orchestration.
Experience working as a tenant within a managed AWS Organizations environment (Landing Zone Accelerator, Control Tower, or similar).
Comprehensive knowledge of AWS architecture, including serverless computing, event-driven systems, S3, Lambda, Step Functions, Fargate, DynamoDB, IAM, Cognito, secure VPC networking, and managed AI services such as Amazon Bedrock.
Experience implementing cloud security and governance controls, including FedRAMP HIGH compliance, encryption, access management, audit logging, and AWS Lake Formation.
Experience with infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform), containerization (Docker/ECS/EKS), CI/CD pipelines, and production monitoring
Familiarity with big data processing frameworks (such as Apache Spark), distributed computing, and handling both structured and unstructured document pipelines.
Experience operating within Agile delivery frameworks and utilizing modern project-tracking tools.
Build and maintain AWS Step Functions workflows with error handling and parallel processing.
Manage KMS and Secrets Manager integrations for encryption and credential handling.

Leads and executes deep dive diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to support data-driven business decision making. Mentors and develops junior data scientists and analysts.

Vanguard is committed to continuous Client Experience improvement, and the Enterprise Intelligence group develops and supports a suite of internal CX analytical tools. These Data Science tools – spanning models, software, and interfaces – are used by internal Vanguard expert analysts to better understand CX outcomes. This position is for a full stack Data Scientist supporting the continued development of our internal suite of CX analytical tools. The role will be responsible for rapidly understanding the current state of those methods / models / systems, then working with existing Data Science and Machine Learning stakeholders to support and update that suite.

Applicants should have a baseline understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), deployment of code through Python packages, integration of AI into code (both in development and application), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) fundamentals for text processing & analysis. Your work will connect with subject matter experts across Data Science, Analytics, Client Experience, and Business – you’ll need to be able to cater your technical communication across audiences. You will follow the Vanguard Model Governance process and adhere to AI usage policies, protecting client information and ensuring full compliance with safety & security best practices.

You’ll be working with a highly-skilled team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers, on a suite of software that has moved beyond its initial development stages. This will demand rapid familiarization, the ability to quickly understand existing codebase, and finding opportunities for improvement. You will need to work with your management and stakeholders to prioritize tasking, autonomously deliver on that tasking, and proactively come back with proposed next steps.

Core Responsibilities

Deliver technology:

Build and support existing software, models, packages, and other analytics tools used for data-driven business decision making.
Implement AI prompt engineering, NLP text processing, and unstructured data modeling in systems & packages.
Deploy software to internal consumers, adhere to the PDLC process, create and use monitoring & tracking features.

Use technology responsibly:

Follow the Vanguard Model Governance methodology & process, adhering to security policies around AI usage, software design, and model validation.
Identify and diagnose data & code issues, always through continuous code review, and when necessary by performing root-cause analysis and post-mortems.
Proactively surface found issues or risks.

Manage stakeholders:

Engage with internal stakeholders (DS, MLE, Business...) to understand and probe business processes in order to improve CX models, packages, and tools.
Establish Definitions-of-Done with stakeholders, ensure that DoD is tracked and met through the PDLC process.
Communicate complex findings and implications to leaders & teammates.

Be a team player:

Mentor and develop junior data scientists and analysts.
Actively share information across workstreams, promote cross-pollination of findings & hurdles.
Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum of five years related work experience in Data Science development & modeling roles.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or related Data Science field of study, or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred.
Experience with the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), especially deploying Data Science tools to expert analyst users.
Proven experience using AI and NLP methods & tools to extract information from unstructured data at scale. Strong background using quantified measures to evaluate text, developing models around those measures, and improving them over time.
Advanced programming experience with Python, including deploying solutions as Packages that include telemetry feedback, safeguards, secure credentialing, and other User Access Controls (UAC).
Ability to communicate technically complex concepts across varying audiences. Know when to dive deep, and when to keep things high-level.
Some experience with data wrangling required – ability to extract, transform and load (ETL) large-scale data for statistical modeling.
Preference for candidates who have worked with Client Experience & client outcomes, who have familiarity with terminology surrounding client feedback & stories.

Intuit's Consumer Group (CG) AI is in the business of creating impactful, intelligent experiences that save time and money for our customers. Our work spans two deeply connected fronts: agent-powered experiences that reason, plan, and act on complex user challenges, and the in-product recommendation and personalization systems that surface the right guidance, products, and next-best-actions to millions of customers at exactly the right moment.

off-the-shelf AI by experimenting with novel applications of existing methods, including

agentic system evaluation and optimization.

Technical Skills & AI Science

Select appropriate AI approaches, explain trade-offs, and spot common failure modes like

hallucination, bias, and drift.

Curate task-specific datasets, define baseline metrics, and design AI-centric features

balancing latency, cost, and quality, including within multi-agent pipelines, building

evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic workflows.

Apply data mining, NLP, and ML (supervised/unsupervised, Causal-ML, Online, Bayesian,

agent-generated work.

standards through the full development cycle.

communicate impact to peers and leaders.

Customer Impact

Use customer feedback, usage, and product data, plus AI agents, to deepen technical

analysis and influence product direction.

Partner with Product and Design to shape priorities based on real customer behavior and

business goals.

Define success at the outset, track adoption and impact, and drive post-launch iteration.

Share feedback on best practices; help teammates direct AI agents with sharper intent.
Resolve ambiguities and encode what works into shared, reusable team practices.
Work with PMs, engineers, and designers to design experiments and MVPs.

Qualifications

BS, MS, or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Applied Math, Operations

Research, or a related field.

4+ years of industry experience with AI science.
Hands-on expertise in ML paradigms (Causal-ML, supervised/unsupervised, Online,

Bayesian, Reinforcement, Deep Learning).

Proficient in NLP techniques, explainable AI, and common ML frameworks.

Linux.

Strong communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

The AI Models & Digital Twins team is changing the world’s energy future by building cutting-edge AI that analyzes real-world energy assets in near-real time, from the materials that go into them to the grids they power.

We’re looking for a research data scientist who wants to turn complex, messy, real-world data into models that people can use to make decisions. Apply and advance technologies such as explainable SI/ML, large language models (LLMs), physics-informed machine learning, uncertainty quantification, systems performance analysis, and data and sensor fusion methodologies.
Apply energy systems and domain knowledge from engineering or the physical and earth sciences to identify and originate opportunities for ML and data-driven analysis within energy generation, resource characterization, operations, and research programs.

jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on.

We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way.

What you’ll do

Build models for the problems in front of us. You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi-view, multi-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short.
Work through the difficult footage. You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects.
Find out where your models fail. You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results.
Own the path to production. You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back.
Follow problems through to a fix. You’ll reproduce customer-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up.

What you’ll bring

Strong machine learning fundamentals. You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch.
Experience training large vision models from scratch. Your experience goes beyond running or fine-tuning existing models.
Depth in a computer vision specialty. You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction.
Experience owning models in production. You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward.
Comfort with the work as it is. You can make progress with noisy real-world data and adapt when priorities shift.

Nice to have

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

Hand and body tracking: 3D hand and full-body tracking, mesh recovery, human-object and human-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground.
SLAM, VIO and calibration: Learned ego-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale.
3D reconstruction and objects: Feed-forward or per-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
TL;DR

We're hiring an AI Engineer to help shape how Century Health builds AI for life sciences. You will work with 6M+ longitudinal patient records that combine physician notes, imaging, and structured data from community practices most of the industry can't reach. Our first products extract research-grade data from these records and answer partners' questions in plain language. They are only the start. You will have real ownership and autonomy: you'll bring ideas for what we build next, take them from first prototype to production, and work on cutting-edge problems alongside our ML, data science, and clinical teams. The role is a mix of building, customer work, and science, including research we plan to publish.

Compensation
: $150-200K base + equity

Benefits
: Top-tier healthcare, vision, and dental coverage

Experience
: 2-6 years building ML or AI systems, including recent hands-on production work with LLMs

Location
: Hybrid, NYC office

Reporting to
: Founding AI Engineer

About Century Health

Century Health is on a mission to accelerate medical breakthroughs using AI and real-world clinical data.

Today, answering critical clinical and commercial questions is slow because rich clinical data is siloed across health systems, academic institutions, and private practices. Our platform transforms this complex real-world data into research-ready datasets and rapid insights for life sciences partners, while protecting patient privacy and supporting the research community.

We partner with specialty provider practices across the country, which share de-identified patient records with us. Our AI, led by our abstraction model CHARM, reads years of physician notes, imaging reports, and scanned documents and turns them into structured, research-grade variables, with clinical experts in the loop to validate the results. Biopharma companies use these datasets and insights to understand their patients, generate real-world evidence, and get treatments to the people who need them faster.

We are building the infrastructure that turns raw clinical data into impact.

The role

As AI Engineer you will build, evaluate, and improve the AI systems at the core of our platform. That means post-training and validating models, building and testing evals, fine-tuning LLMs, and writing the code that makes our agents and harnesses better. You will report to our founding AI engineer and work alongside our software engineering, data engineering, data science, and clinical teams, as well as directly with the founders and our business development team.

The data.
Our network includes 240+ community clinical sites across neurology, GI, nephrology, ophthalmology, and pulmonology. Each patient record can hold years of physician notes, imaging reports, scanned documents, and structured data, the kind of clinical depth life sciences companies can't find in other real-world datasets.

The challenge.
Accuracy. Partners make research and commercial decisions based on what our models extract, so a model has to reason over a patient's history the way a specialist would. CHARM reaches 97% accuracy against clinical expert judgment today, and building evaluations that hold up to physician review across every specialty is still an open problem.

The opportunity.
Demand is growing quickly, including a recent multi-year partnership to curate hundreds of thousands of patient records. As one of our first AI hires, you'll get significant ownership early, have the autonomy to propose what we build next, contribute to research we plan to publish, and grow quickly as the company scales, with equity in what you help create. We're also a small, fun team that genuinely enjoys working together.

What You'll Do

Fine-tune and post-train LLMs, and validate post-trained models before they go into production, including exploring training models for partners.
Build and test evals for everything we ship, including how we define ground truth with physicians, measure clinical reasoning, and catch errors across a full cohort before a partner does.
Write code to improve our agent and harness infrastructure.
Co-develop every part of our AI pipeline, and bring ideas for new capabilities and product components based on what partners need.
Push the accuracy of our abstraction models on the hardest variables, working with clinicians and annotators across specialties.
Own abstraction projects for specific provider sites end to end: learn how their clinicians document a condition (for example, an MS relapse), use our in-house tools to abstract the variable start to finish, and find where better tooling could improve the process.
Design systems that run inference across hundreds of thousands of patient records with reliability, speed, and cost in mind.
Build the internal tooling and APIs that let our team and AI agents work with our data and model outputs.
Contribute to research and publications on our methods and results.
Collaborate closely with the rest of the engineering team, including software engineering and data engineering.
Communicate clearly what you've built and why, to engineers, clinicians, and partners.

Requirements

2-6 years of industry experience building and shipping ML or AI systems; we're not looking for new graduates.
Strong Python skills, and the ability to ship quickly and make the most of AI coding tools.
Experience deploying and maintaining LLM-based systems in production.
Hands-on experience with LLM harnesses and agents, such as structured extraction, tool use, or fine-tuning.
You stay current with modern AI: you read papers, track new model releases, and bring new techniques into your work.
Experience designing evaluations for model behavior where ground truth is hard to define.
Strong engineering fundamentals; you develop and monitor accurate AI pipelines.
High ownership and autonomy; you're excited to own projects end to end and propose what to build next.
Strong, low-ego communicator; you can explain a model's errors in plain language and turn feedback from clinicians and nontechnical teammates into a better model.
Able to work hybrid from our NYC office.

Nice to have

Experience with post-training, reinforcement learning, or RLHF.
Experience with clinical or healthcare data. If you're new to the domain, you'll learn it quickly alongside our physicians.
Research experience, such as a PhD or publications in ML.

These qualifications are guidelines. If you are excited about the mission and believe you would thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply.

Our Values

❤️ Patients first

Our work starts and ends with what's best for patients.

🤝 Delight our partners

Our partners place their trust in us, and we take that responsibility seriously. When we're not sure how to do right by them, we ask.

📈 Follow the data

We dig into the data to understand why, and we act on what it tells us. When opinions differ, the data decides.

⚡ Bias to action

We move fast because trying an idea is the fastest way to prove it works. When we're wrong, we learn and go again.

🏆 Pride In What We Build

Making our mark on the world requires ownership and sweating the details. We celebrate doing what we love, doing it well, and doing it together.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 People are the point

We're an AI company, but first we're a group of smart, caring, fun-loving humans who reflect the patients we serve.

Apply now

We're growing fast and are backed by top-tier investors, so what you build has a good chance to create massive impact for patients! As one of our first AI hires, you will be a key part of the Century Health journey.

If you're interested, please apply and we'll be in touch.

We’re looking for a Network Automation & AI Software Engineer
who can turn complex network data into trusted insights, scalable applications, and intelligent automation.

You’ll work across network engineering, software development, data engineering, and AI, using Layer 1, Layer 2, and Layer 3 network data including telemetry, inventory, alarms, routing, NetFlow, and router configurations. You’ll build data pipelines, APIs, dashboards, automation tools, and AI-enabled solutions that improve network design, operations, troubleshooting, and capacity planning.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that transform network inventory, telemetry, alarms, routing, NetFlow, and configuration data into trusted, reusable datasets.
Develop software and automation solutions using Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Perl, and other technologies appropriate to the use case.
Build network applications, APIs, backend services, GUIs, and MCP servers that make network information accessible to users, applications, and AI systems.
Develop AI agents and automation workflows that analyze structured and unstructured network data to support troubleshooting, engineering, and operational decision-making.
Parse and analyze router configurations and map network configuration data to inventory, topology, and network models.

Apply network knowledge across Layer 1 transport, Layer 2 switching, Layer 3 routing, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, topology modeling, and network simulation.

Containerize applications with Docker and deploy them to Kubernetes and Azure environments through CI/CD pipelines.

Use AI-assisted development tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, troubleshooting, and code review while validating outputs against engineering and security standards.
Document data lineage, application behavior, testing results, troubleshooting procedures, and operational handoffs.
Present solutions, technical findings, and product demonstrations to senior leaders and key stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

Strong software engineering and automation skills, particularly with Python and modern development practices.
Hands-on experience turning network data such as telemetry, inventory, alarms, routing, NetFlow, and router configurations into usable datasets, applications, or operational insights.
A working understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, routing, switching, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and network topology.
Experience building data pipelines, APIs, backend services, dashboards, and automation tools.

Curiosity about generative AI, AI agents, RAG, MCP, and intelligent automation, paired with good judgment around validating AI-generated output.
The ability to translate technical requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and demonstrate solutions to both technical and leadership audiences.
A collaborative, ownership-driven approach and the ability to work effectively with network engineers, data engineers, software engineers, and senior technical leaders.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience where permitted.
Experience with Python plus one or more of Java, JavaScript, Perl, or SQL.
Experience with Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, data lakes, data warehouses, or relational databases.
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Git/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and Ansible.
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines, including data validation, schema mapping, lineage, and data-quality controls.
Familiarity with router configurations and extracting information from configuration files, device outputs, telemetry, or network-management systems.
Experience with REST APIs or similar application integration patterns.
Experience with modern frontend technologies such as React or Angular is preferred.
Experience with OIDC, RBAC, Azure Identities, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, or comparable enterprise security technologies.
Experience with automated software testing, including unit, integration, regression, or end-to-end testing.
Exposure to AI agents, retrieval-based/RAG workflows, prompt engineering, MCP, or AI-assisted software development is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
About AKASA

AKASA is building the future of healthcare by developing AI-native solutions for some of healthcare’s most complex, consequential work. Our customers include the most innovative health systems in the country, like Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, NewYork-Presbyterian, Duke, Stanford, and Johns Hopkins. Our customer base represents 1 in 10 inpatient discharges across the United States and more than $180B+ in net patient revenue.

Our products help health systems comprehensively capture and communicate the full patient clinical journey. By empowering health systems to streamline their operations, they can focus on what matters most - delivering quality patient care.

We train internal models and build domain-specific harnesses to power our products and best capture clinical nuance for each customer. We hire people with high agency and good judgment. Everyone here is an owner and builder who is looking to help solve high stakes challenges every day.

We have raised over $250M in funding from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, BOND, and Coatue. Our deployments have been recognized nationally as "one of the most comprehensive real-world uses of GenAI in healthcare finance to date" (link).

Some of our recent recognitions include being named one of America's Top Startup Employers 2026 by Forbes, a Top Healthcare Technology Company of 2026 by Healthcare Technology Report, the #1 most promising healthcare RCM startup of 2025 by Black Book Market Research, and we have been certified as a “Great Place to Work” for the past 6 years in a row.

About The Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will be building AI-powered solutions across our Clinical Documentation and Medical Coding suite. You will work closely with the product, design, and machine learning teams to design and build the services, APIs, and tools that undergird our SaaS products.

Together with the broader team, you will work on AI-native products that correct clinical errors for hundreds of thousands of patients, and deliver hundreds of millions of dollars in measurable value for our customers.

These products improve the quality of physician documentation, help clinicians identify missing diagnoses, convert documentation to medical codes and ensure financial integrity for health systems. The interfaces you develop help thousands of clinicians and hospital staff tackle some of the most challenging and high-impact patient encounters in U.S. healthcare.

Candidates for this role must be based in either the SF Bay Area or NYC and attend our in office days (2-3x/week).

What You'll Do

Build features and products driven by LLMs. You will touch the whole stack, from designing agentic systems for revenue cycle workflows to the infrastructure that runs them in production across hundreds of hospitals.
Work alongside strong subject matter experts on complex, challenging problems that span from high-stakes clinical diagnoses to regulated medical billing with no easy answers.
Deploy the evaluation frameworks and experimentation loops that deliver reliable, production-grade systems. You'll use data-driven and statistical approaches to balance across medical coding guidelines, user feedback, and auditability.
Partner directly with product, clinical, and revenue cycle experts to push the frontier of what AI can do inside the healthcare revenue cycle.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science/Software Engineering or related field
3+ years in a technical role with a strong foundation in AI and data analysis or backend systems
1+ years shipping production AI systems to end users
Experience designing offline/online evaluations and landing agentic systems
Proficiency in Python
Thrives in a startup environment working on challenging problems
Healthcare technology experience (EDI,HL7,FHIR) is a plus

What We Offer

Flexible paid time off (PTO)
Expansive coverage for health, dental, and vision
Employer contribution to Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
Generous parental leave policy
Full employee coverage for life insurance
Home office stipend
Cell phone/internet reimbursement
Company-paid holidays
401(K) plan

Compensation

Based on market data and other factors, the salary range for this position is $180,000-$250,000 + Equity. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

We’re committed to doing the best work of our lives, together. Come see if we're the right team for you.

AKASA is a proud equal opportunity employer and we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is an imperative. We welcome people of different backgrounds, genders, races, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations, and perspectives, just to name a few. We do not discriminate based upon any protected class and we encourage candidates of all identities and backgrounds to apply. AKASA considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

AKASA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at recruiting@akasa.com.

jobs.description:
Make a profound impact on how millions of people connect with technology globally by shaping the future of marketing intelligence. In this dynamic role, you will design, build, and productionize next-generation machine learning and Generative AI components that directly drive strategic decisions, optimize campaign performance, and unlock novel insights for a world-renowned technology leader.

Aquent is thrilled to partner with a globally recognized technology leader that stands at the forefront of innovation, continuously shaping how millions worldwide interact with technology and digital experiences. This visionary organization is dedicated to pushing boundaries, crafting intuitive products, and delivering unparalleled value to its vast customer base through cutting-edge advancements in artificial intelligence and data science. By joining forces with Aquent, you will gain access to an extraordinary opportunity to bring innovative concepts to life, from ideation to seamless deployment, and contribute to products that are truly at the leading edge.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a visionary professional eager to drive significant business impact by building advanced intelligence products. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional analytics experts to refine modeling approaches, manage the full model lifecycle, and serve as a primary technical resource. This is an unparalleled opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI infrastructure, build intelligent agents, and develop sophisticated forecasting models that redefine industry standards.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and productionize machine learning and Generative AI components for critical applications such as media planning, campaign estimation, and intelligence products.
Develop sophisticated forecasting, estimation, and marketing response models, including dynamic budget-allocation recommendations informed by response curves and diminishing-returns analysis.
Construct advanced Generative AI components, including intelligent agents, robust retrieval mechanisms, and sophisticated entity resolution systems, implementing rigorous evaluation frameworks to ensure reliable and consistent LLM output.
Independently manage the full model lifecycle, encompassing initial problem framing, meticulous feature engineering, comprehensive model development, thorough validation, deployment as Python services and automated pipelines, and continuous monitoring with strategic retraining.
Collaborate closely with internal analytics experts to refine modeling approaches and rigorously validate results, ensuring accuracy and business relevance.
Serve as a primary point of contact for machine learning engineering support during business hours.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in building and deploying machine learning models specifically for marketing use cases, including expertise in time-series forecasting, effort/resource estimation, and advanced media-mix style response curve and diminishing-returns (saturation) modeling.
A strong understanding of core marketing performance concepts such as budget allocation, marginal efficiency, campaign pacing, and incrementality.
Exceptional Python skills, demonstrating proficiency with essential libraries including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, and at least one forecasting or probabilistic modeling library (e.g., Prophet, PyMC, Stan).
A solid grounding in statistics and experimentation principles, including uncertainty quantification, robust backtesting methodologies, and comprehensive model validation techniques.
Hands-on experience building and operating batch machine learning pipelines, specifically within Apache Airflow, covering intricate scheduling, efficient backfills, data quality checks, and automated retraining processes.
Demonstrated ability to independently own the full model lifecycle, from initial concept to production deployment, including advanced feature engineering, meticulous model versioning, proactive drift monitoring, and effective retraining feedback loops.
A strong understanding of developing Generative AI components, including expertise in AI infrastructure components, tool design, governed semantic layers, LLM agents, intricate tool-calling workflows, advanced prompt engineering, and structured outputs.
Familiarity with various LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., creating golden datasets, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and regression testing).
Proficiency with vector databases and embeddings for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and designing entity resolution across diverse systems.
Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with enterprise-grade data warehouses (e.g., Redshift).
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex model assumptions, intricate trade-offs, and actionable results to both highly technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience developing robust services and APIs in Python.
Proficiency with PySpark for efficient large-scale feature processing.
Practical experience with Bayesian modeling techniques.
Knowledge of advanced optimization techniques and constrained budget allocation strategies.

Client Description

Our client is a global leader in consumer technology, renowned for redefining the intersection of hardware, software, and services. Known for their uncompromising commitment to world-class design and user experience, they create products that have become essential to daily life. You will be joining a team that values craftsmanship and simplicity, working on high-impact projects that reach hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

jobs.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

.

to address Pharmaceutical

Build scientific data workflows, analytics, and visualization tools

Automate repetitive or manual scientific data-processing and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, reproducibility, and scalability
Design, develop, validate, and deploy computational tools and scientific applications
supporting research and development workflows.
Integrate diverse scientific datasets to enable data-driven insights, predictive modeling, and decision making
.
Partner with experimental and computational scientists to identify high-value opportunities and translate scientific needs into practical digital solutions.
Promote reproducible scientific computing, good software-development practices, and adoption of data and AI capabilities
across the organization.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Computational Science, Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering
, or a related quantitative/scientific discipline.
Pharmaceutical experience is REQUIRED

Strong programming skills, preferably in Python
, with demonstrated ability to analyze data and develop computational solutions.
Experience with Pharmaceutical
data analysis, processing, scientific computing, statistics, machine learning, AI, or scientific informatics
.
Experience working with chemistry, pharmaceutical, materials-science, or laboratory-generated scientific data
.
Demonstrated ability to work with complex and heterogenous scientific datasets, including extracting, transforming, integrating, and analyzing structured and/or unstructured data. translate scientific questions into data-driven analyses or computational solutions.
Familiarity with modern data-science, scientific computing, and machine-learning tools, libraries and frameworks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate within multidisciplinary scientific teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing scientific software, analytical applications, visualization tools, dashboards, automated workflows, or APIs.

Hands-on experience developing or applying machine-learning, deep-learning, generative-AI, or large-language-model approaches
.

.
Experience developing interactive scientific applications and user interfaces, including notebook-based environments such as Jupyter/JupyterLab and web-based frameworks or visualization platforms.

.

jobs.description:
Job Description

As an AI Engineer II at Honeywell Aerospace, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of AI-enabled applications and services. You will work with experienced AI engineers, product managers, and domain experts to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions, while applying established engineering practices and learning emerging AI methods and tools.

In this role, you will support important AI initiatives by building production-oriented components, integrating models and enterprise data, and improving solution quality through testing, debugging, and monitoring. This role is intended for an engineer who can deliver defined work independently, collaborate effectively across functions, and grow toward broader technical ownership.

You will work out of our Phoenix, AZ location on a Hybrid work schedule. NO RELOCATION OFFERED.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Collaborate with AI engineers, product managers, software teams, and domain experts to understand requirements and develop AI applications that address business needs.
Design, build, test, and maintain AI application components and REST APIs in Python, following secure coding, documentation, and code-review practices.
Develop and improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using keyword, vector, or hybrid search approaches, including basic relevance testing and reranking where appropriate.
Prepare data, integrate models and services, and implement reusable components that support reliable AI solution delivery.
Troubleshoot application, data, prompt, retrieval, and model-integration issues by separating deterministic software logic from probabilistic AI behavior.
Contribute to solution evaluation through test cases, regression checks, quality metrics, and documented analysis of model or application behavior.
Participate in research and technical learning activities to assess relevant AI models, frameworks, and infrastructure tools for enterprise and on-premises environments.
Apply established software-development practices, including version control, unit and integration testing, CI/CD participation, and production support.
Document designs, implementation decisions, operating procedures, and technical findings; communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to the team.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

Minimum 2 years of hands-on professional experience developing AI, machine-learning, data-driven, or generative-AI applications.
Proficiency developing applications and REST APIs in Python, including testing, debugging, and integration with external services.
Working knowledge of machine-learning and generative-AI concepts, including model limitations and the practical differences between deterministic and probabilistic system components.
Experience working in a collaborative software-engineering environment using source control, code reviews, and agile delivery practices.

WE VALUE

Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in computer science, engineering, mathematics, data science, or another relevant technical discipline.
Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation and search techniques, including keyword, vector, and hybrid search, embeddings, indexing, and basic reranking.
Understanding of AI evaluation approaches, such as offline test sets, regression checks, human review, and LLM-as-judge methods, with awareness of their limitations.
Understanding of basic AI safety guardrails, including input and output validation, prompt-injection defenses, PII handling, access controls, and human-in-the-loop review.
Experience with database operations and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including data storage, retrieval, and efficient SQL.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines used to deploy and operate applications in production.
Experience using AI coding assistants, such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, to improve developer productivity while maintaining code quality and responsible review.
Familiarity with state machines, workflow orchestration, agentic application patterns, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Curiosity, sound engineering judgment, and a commitment to staying current with AI trends, tools, and best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Delivers well-defined features and technical tasks with moderate guidance, escalating ambiguity and risks early.
Makes sound implementation decisions within established architectures and contributes constructively to design discussions.
Owns the quality of assigned work through testing, documentation, operational readiness, and follow-through.

jobs.description:
POSITION: Software Engineer, Applied AI

DIRECT REPORT: Sr. Director, AI and Architecture

COMPENSATION: Pursuant to state regulations, the salary range is $120,800-$133,300 plus bonus potential. Eligible to participate in the company benefits plan. We offer health, vision, dental, and pet insurance. We offer a 401(k) retirement plan, student loan assistance, licensing and continuing education reimbursement, parental leave, and housing allowances or gifts.

Summary

The Software Engineer, Applied AI is responsible for designing, building, and supporting production software and AI solutions that solve business problems across Cardinal. Working across the full software development lifecycle, this role owns solutions end-to-end, including web applications, APIs, integrations, and AI agents. The engineer works AI-natively, using agentic development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as everyday collaborators, while bringing the engineering mindset and computer science fundamentals needed to direct, review, and verify AI-generated work so that what ships is secure, tested, and maintainable. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role moves quickly from prototype to production, partners with senior engineers on architecture, and helps raise the technical bar across the team.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Including But Not Limited To)

Translate business requirements into well-designed technical solutions, including web applications, APIs, integrations, automated workflows, and AI agents, and own their delivery end-to-end, from rapid prototypes that validate ideas with stakeholders to hardened production releases.
Build backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI, and front-end applications using TypeScript and Angular.
Use agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of the daily workflow, from planning and specification through implementation, testing, and documentation, including delegating well-scoped tasks to coding agents and rigorously reviewing the results.
Build and maintain the team's shared AI development assets, such as agent instruction files, reusable skills and commands, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, to make AI-assisted development faster and more consistent.
Design, build, and operate AI agents and LLM-powered features using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or LangGraph, applying tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and multi-agent patterns where appropriate.
Bring the same rigor to AI features that the team applies to conventional software: build evaluation datasets and automated evals, instrument tracing and monitoring, and track quality, cost, and latency in production.
Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including automated quality gates and AI-assisted code review.
Deploy and operate solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, and Vertex AI, using containers and infrastructure-as-code where appropriate, and participate in production support, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and reliability improvements.
Design data models and build integrations with internal and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and event-driven messaging, ensuring reliable data flows.
Apply secure-by-design practices, including authentication and authorization, secrets management, least-privilege access for agents and their tools, protection of resident and team member data, and mitigation of AI-specific risks such as prompt injection.
Contribute to architecture and technical design discussions alongside senior engineers, documenting decisions and trade-offs.
Perform thorough code reviews of both human- and AI-authored code, contribute to team coding standards, and help mentor associate team members.
Collaborate directly with business stakeholders and cross-functional partners, including data engineering, to clarify requirements, demo working software early, and communicate technical decisions in accessible terms.
Participate in sprint ceremonies, provide estimates, and surface technical risks and dependencies early.
Evaluate new AI models, tools, and frameworks through small proofs of concept, and assess platform, framework, and model updates (including model deprecations) for impact on existing solutions.
Support Cardinal OKRs as needed.
Participate in Cardinal U training as required.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Three (3) to five (5) years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and supporting applications in production.
Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) and software design skills (API design, data modeling, design patterns), with the judgment to recognize when AI-generated code falls short.
Proficiency in Python and TypeScript, with experience building RESTful APIs (FastAPI preferred) and front-end applications with a modern framework (Angular preferred).
Demonstrated daily use of agentic AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including the ability to plan, direct, and verify AI-generated work.
Experience building and shipping LLM-powered applications or AI agents, including tool calling, RAG, and prompt and context engineering, using Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar frameworks.
Experience with automated testing, Git-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred).
Hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on a major cloud platform (GCP preferred), including containers (Docker) and serverless services.
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred); experience with BigQuery or another analytical data platform is a plus.
Working knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, secrets management, the OWASP Top 10, and LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection.
Familiarity with MCP, LLM evaluation and observability practices, and the capability, cost, and latency trade-offs across major model families (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI) is preferred.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), event-driven architectures, C#/.NET, Azure, or property management platforms such as Entrata is a plus.
Ability to work independently through ambiguity, break problems into deliverable increments, and know when to pull in senior team members.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A continuous-learning mindset and genuine curiosity about the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
Champion the Cardinal Culture and Cardinal Core Values every day.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
