Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside within a commutable distance from our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices, or who are willing to relocate.

Build a career with purpose. Join our
Cause
to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For

Every day, Cambia's Data & Analytics Engineering Team is living our mission to make health care easier and lives better.

Join our Data & Analytics Engineering team as a Senior Engineer on the Semantic & Agentic Intelligence Squad. You will design, build, and own the semantic foundation and agentic AI capabilities that power governed analytics, intelligent automation, and purpose-built data products across the enterprise.

You will serve as a technical lead, combining deep dimensional modeling expertise with modern AI/LLM engineering, mentoring engineers, driving technical standards, and contributing to platform strategy. This role positions you for growth into Principal-level engineering, architecture, or people leadership.

If you're a motivated Senior Engineer with a passion for making data trustworthy, intelligent, and actionable in healthcare, apply today!

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:

6+ years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Semantic Modeling, or AI/ML Engineering, with senior or lead experience
College degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field
A degree may be substituted by sufficient years of experience in the healthcare industry

Experience with a supported business area is preferred (e.g., Provider Network, Claims, Membership, Digital Solutions, Pricing)
Equivalent combination of education and experience

Skills and Attributes:
Preferably seeking a technically versatile engineer with deep expertise in dimensional modeling, semantic layer design, and agentic AI development. You bring a consulting-oriented mindset, strong SQL fundamentals, and hands-on experience building governed, observable AI solutions in complex enterprise environments.

Preferred Skills

Dimensional Modeling & Data Platform

Deep expertise in dimensional modeling with strong command of grain, bridge tables, many-to-many relationships, and slowly changing dimensions (SCDs)
Awareness of common data modeling pitfalls and how to prevent them
Strong SQL skills on Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Experience with dbt, ELT/ETL design patterns, and orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)
Understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and enterprise platform ownership

Semantic Layer & Governed Metrics

Experience defining governed metrics in a semantic or metrics layer
Has built and deployed a semantic layer (SSAS, LookML, dbt Semantic Layer, or similar) used directly by business users
Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and diagnosing and fixing root causes in the semantic layer

Agentic AI & LLM Engineering

Experience deploying and monitoring AI agents in a governed, regulated environment
Built LLM/agentic applications including RAG pipelines, embeddings/vector search, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agent orchestration frameworks
Experienced with Snowflake Cortex (Analyst, Search, Agents) or comparable native AI tooling
Experience developing and managing AI agents for use cases such as:
Prior authorization
Member support
Care gap identification
Utilization analytics
Anomaly/outlier detection

AI Ops & Observability

Implemented evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability for AI agents covering accuracy, hallucination detection, latency, and cost
Familiarity with scoring techniques such as F1 scoring and related evaluation metrics
Experience with model/agent monitoring, cost optimization, and performance tuning

Healthcare Domain Knowledge

Working knowledge of payer data: claims (837/835), eligibility, enrollment, and provider data
Familiarity with healthcare standards: HL7/FHIR, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS

Nice To Have

Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or formal business vocabularies
Built and managed MLOps pipelines with familiarity with ML models including regression and ensemble methods (e.g., KNN, XGBoost, Random Forest, Decision Trees)
Experience building consumer-facing AI applications or features involving inference
Experience building multi-tier AI applications or multi-agent workflows, including multimodal LLM experience
Experience with statistical and predictive modeling (regression, classification, clustering, time series forecasting)
Experience with BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and translating analytical findings into business narratives
Exposure to experimentation and hypothesis testing (A/B testing, statistical significance)

What You Will Do At Cambia

Lead and mentor Data and AI Engineers and drive engineering standards and best practices across the squad
Design, build, and own scalable dimensional models, semantic layers, and governed metric definitions used by business users and AI systems
Develop and deploy AI agents for healthcare use cases (prior authorization, member support, care gaps, utilization analytics, anomaly detection) in a governed, regulated environment
Build LLM/agentic applications including RAG pipelines, vector search, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration leveraging Snowflake Cortex or comparable tooling
Implement AI Ops practices including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and cost/performance optimization for deployed agents
Optimize platform performance including query tuning, compute sizing, workload isolation, and cost management
Partner with Analytics, Product, Governance, QA, and Business teams to deliver high-quality, observable, and trustworthy data and AI solutions
Contribute to platform strategy, risk assessments, and adoption of modern practices (DataOps, CI/CD, AI tooling)
Ensure data quality, testing, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the team
Demonstrate technical leadership by breaking down complex work and delivering measurable value in squad/model environments

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.

National pay structure — applies to the Boise and Lewiston, ID; Salt Lake City, UT, Oregon and Washington. The full salary range is $115,000 - $188,000 and the bonus target is 15%. The expected salary range is $122,000 - $165,000/year.
Regional pay structure — applies to North Dakota and Idaho and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The full salary range is $103,000 - $169,000 and the bonus target is 15%. The expected salary range is $110,000 - $149,000/year.

About Cambia

Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.

Why Join the Cambia Team?

At Cambia, You Can

Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.

Benefits

In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:

Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
Commute and parking benefits.

Learn More About Our Benefits.

We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.

As part of our security requirements, new hires will need access to a personal mobile device to set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) upon joining the company. MFA is an important layer of protection for accessing Cambia systems and is required for all employees.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer dedicated to a drug and tobacco-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required.

If you need accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please email CambiaCareers@cambiahealth.com. Information about how Cambia Health Solutions collects, uses, and discloses information is available in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Data, AI and Cloud Solutions)
jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

About The Role

At Jacobs
, we’re building systems that enable global teams to think faster, act smarter, and deliver at scale. As part of the Alluvial Data & AI Platform organization, this role sits at the intersection of engineering, analytics, and applied intelligence. You will be part of a global team that builds and deploys advanced data solutions across multiple markets—accelerating delivery through reusable platform capabilities.

You’ll be forward-deployed into projects where Jacobs’ clients are trying to move fast, and where Alluvial’s ecosystem—Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Power BI, Python, and AI-powered DevOps—gives you leverage to prototype, integrate, and deliver with speed and precision.

You will learn from senior data engineers and consultants, work alongside solution architects and visualization specialists, and help turn messy datasets into usable, explainable, and scalable intelligence.

You will work directly with client teams to turn business needs and complex datasets into secure, maintainable applications and analytical solutions.

Location
Hybrid, two days per week at any Jacobs office in the United States. View Jacobs U.S. locations https//www.jacobs.com/locations/americas/united-states

Responsibilities

Work with clients and stakeholders to understand needs, gather requirements, and shape secure, scalable solutions. Contribute to solution architecture, data models, component design, integrations, and data flows for applications, reporting, real-time analytics, and event-driven systems.
Develop responsive, accessible front-end applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
Build and maintain back-end services and REST APIs with C# and ASP.NET Core, including MVC, middleware, dependency injection, and identity. Implement data access with Entity Framework Core, LINQ, and code-first or database-first approaches.
Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases. Write complex queries and improve performance through indexing and query tuning.
Develop ETL/ELT pipelines, notebooks, and APIs using Python, SQL, and PySpark. Support analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Data Factory, Power BI, and Azure Machine Learning.
Build rapid prototypes with Alluvial reusable components for data ingestion, semantic modeling, and visualization.
Explore structured and unstructured data through exploratory analysis, statistical profiling, and model testing; help turn findings into explainable analytical products.
Deploy and manage cloud-native solutions on Azure, including App Services, Functions, Blob Storage, Container Apps, and microservices.
Contribute to AI-assisted workflows through prompt engineering, Copilot integration, and low-code automation. Help integrate AI features using Azure Cognitive Services, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Document Intelligence.
Assist with deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines, and environment setup using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. Work with Docker and infrastructure templates such as ARM.
Maintain quality through unit, integration, and end-to-end testing with tools such as xUnit, Cypress, and Postman. Apply OWASP security practices and support performance improvements through caching, Azure Cache for Redis, CDNs, and asynchronous programming.
Monitor and troubleshoot applications with Azure Monitor and Application Insights, and contribute to structured logging with tools such as Serilog.
Take increasing ownership of delivery from requirements gathering through deployment, maintenance, and iteration. Participate in Agile ceremonies, document technical specifications and lessons learned, and share project feedback with Alluvial platform engineers to identify platform improvements.

Here's what you'll need

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
At least 1 year of experience as a Full Stack Developer or in a related software delivery role, with experience focused on Azure cloud services.
C# and ASP.NET Core skills for back-end development, with experience in recent versions such as C# 11+ and ASP.NET Core 8+.
Proficiency in Python and SQL for data transformation and analysis, and experience with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Experience with a modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue, and familiarity with Azure services such as App Services, Functions, Blob Storage, and Azure DevOps.
Familiarity with the Microsoft Data and AI stack, such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric, Power BI, or Databricks.
Understanding of data modeling, Git version control and branching, Agile delivery, testing methods, application security, and performance optimization.
Experience building CI/CD pipelines, working with Docker or other containerized environments, and managing cloud infrastructure.
Comfort collaborating across disciplines and time zones, taking initiative and ownership, and developing practical solutions when requirements or situations are ambiguous.
A client-focused, seller-doer mindset, with interest in building client relationships and contributing to business development.

Preferred Qualifications

About 3 years of experience building or delivering data, analytics, or software solutions.
Experience or coursework in data science, machine learning, or applied AI.
Familiarity with AWS and interoperability across cloud ecosystems.
Exposure to Palantir Foundry or a similar enterprise data platform.
Experience with Jupyter notebooks, pandas, and visualization tools such as Plotly or Matplotlib.
Experience with Databricks collaborative notebooks and data engineering workflows.
Experience creating Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modeling and visualization.
Working knowledge of prompt engineering, Copilot, or other LLM-assisted workflows.
Basic experience with GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, Docker, or other CI/CD and containerized development tools.
Experience with NoSQL databases such as Azure Cosmos DB or MongoDB.
Exposure to Azure Cognitive Services, Azure OpenAI, or Azure Document Intelligence, and to application monitoring, caching, or structured logging.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has a U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $150,000.00 to $160,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on November 19, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer - VP. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. In this role, you will play a key role in developing financial models and mission-critical trading tools that support a broad range of GMO (Global banking Operations). Working at the forefront of innovative, client-focused financial solutions, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Product Management, and business stakeholders to transform evolving trading strategies and business needs into project plans, requirements, and estimates that align with the firm's overall product and business objectives.

To be successful as a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer - VP, you should have:

Considerable hands-on experience developing production-grade backend applications in Java 17+, with expertise in object-oriented design, concurrency, collections, unit testing, code reviews, and live-production troubleshooting
Proven success designing and delivering Spring Boot microservices and RESTful APIs, including security, configuration management, data access, observability, and scalable service architecture
Experience building event-driven platforms with Kafka, including producers, consumers, topic design, partitioning, consumer groups, and reliable message processing through retries, idempotency, and error handling
Solid understanding of AWS cloud services and cloud-native application delivery, with experience deploying, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting resilient, secure, and high-availability solutions
Practical experience applying AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to business use cases, including document extraction, classification, prompt engineering, output validation, and responsible production integration with human-in-the-loop controls

Other Highly Valued Skills Include

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for engineering teams, operations functions, product partners, and senior business stakeholders, while strategically managing risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes
Ample DevOps expertise, including CI/CD pipeline implementation, containerization, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, release management, and ownership of monitoring, incident response, and continuous service improvement
Good understanding of Financial Markets and Trade Lifecycle processes, including trade capture, confirmation, validation, settlement, and control frameworks across asset classes such as FX, Rates, and Equities
Proven ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, promoting engineering best practices, architectural standards, code quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement
Experience serving as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME), designing and delivering scalable, maintainable, and business-aligned technology solutions that meet performance, resilience, and regulatory requirements

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in our Whippany, NJ office.

Minimum Salary: $170,000

Maximum Salary: $230,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

This position is eligible for an incentive award.

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Vice President Expectations

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist to join our team within the Pharmaceutical Small Molecule Materials Science Computational Sciences group. The successful candidate will work at the interface of materials science, scientific informatics, data science, artificial intelligence/machine learning, and computational tool development
.

This role will collaborate closely with experimental and computational scientists to develop scientific and automated workflows, data-driven approaches, AI/ML models, scientific applications, and informatics solutions that improve how scientific data are accessed, parsed, analyzed, connected, visualized, and used for decision making.

The position offers an opportunity to contribute to an evolving computational-experimental ecosystem connecting scientific data, predictive models, AI, and experimental knowledge
.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and apply data science, AI/ML, and informatics approaches to address Pharmaceutical Materials Science challenges.
Build scientific data workflows, analytics, and visualization tools that enable effective use of experimental and computational data.
Develop tools and pipelines to extract, transform, standardize, and integrate data from experimental & computational workflows
Automate repetitive or manual scientific data-processing and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, reproducibility, and scalability
Design, develop, validate, and deploy computational tools and scientific applications supporting research and development workflows.
Integrate diverse scientific datasets to enable data-driven insights, predictive modeling, and decision making.
Partner with experimental and computational scientists to identify high-value opportunities and translate scientific needs into practical digital solutions.
Promote reproducible scientific computing, good software-development practices, and adoption of data and AI capabilities across the organization.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Computational Science, Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related quantitative/scientific discipline.
Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, with demonstrated ability to analyze data and develop computational solutions.
Experience with Pharmaceutical data analysis, processing, scientific computing, statistics, machine learning, AI, or scientific informatics.
Experience working with chemistry, pharmaceutical, materials-science, or laboratory-generated scientific data.
Demonstrated ability to work with complex and heterogenous scientific datasets, including extracting, transforming, integrating, and analyzing structured and/or unstructured data. translate scientific questions into data-driven analyses or computational solutions.
Familiarity with modern data-science, scientific computing, and machine-learning tools, libraries and frameworks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate within multidisciplinary scientific teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing scientific software, analytical applications, visualization tools, dashboards, automated workflows, or APIs.
Experience with scientific databases, data integration, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, or scientific informatics.
Hands-on experience developing or applying machine-learning, deep-learning, generative-AI, or large-language-model approaches.
Familiarity with modern software-development practices, including Git/version control, testing, documentation, and reproducible computing.
Experience developing interactive scientific applications and user interfaces, including notebook-based environments such as Jupyter/JupyterLab and web-based frameworks or visualization platforms.
Experience with cloud computing, high-performance computing, or scalable data-processing environments.
Demonstrated ability to take a scientific problem from raw data → structured data → analysis/model → automated workflow or usable computational solution.

Additional Information

Position is Monday- Friday 8:00 AM- 5:00PM. Overtime as needed.
May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs
Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CT are encouraged to apply.
Excellent full-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
Life and disability insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid vacation and holidays
Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

Powerus collects imagery and sensor data from every test and customer flight. Turning that data into models that run reliably onboard requires labeled datasets, repeatable training, and a controlled path from a trained model to a flight-qualified software release.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Multimodal Foundation Models
jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

Every capture tells a story: what someone did, when they did it and whether they completed the task. At Mecka, you’ll build vision-language and video models that turn that footage into useful annotations and catch quality issues across more video than a human team could review.

You’ll own the work from data selection and training through evaluation and production. We’re looking for someone who brings strong research instincts and the engineering skills to make models reliable at scale—and who wants to understand where they fail as much as where they succeed.

What you’ll do

Build models that understand the footage. You’ll develop and improve vision-language and video models for egocentric and manipulation footage.
Catch problems across what we collect. You’ll build model pipelines that identify capture defects, missing coverage and task errors, then check their performance against human audits.
Make models more reliable. You’ll use supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve reliability and reasoning.
Turn video into useful annotations. You’ll build pipelines for captioning, temporal grounding and video annotation at scale.
Take experiments through to production. You’ll run large experiments on distributed GPU infrastructure, analyze the results and turn successful approaches into production systems.

What you’ll bring

Hands-on experience with large multimodal models. You’ve trained, fine-tuned or post-trained vision-language or multimodal models.
Strong deep learning fundamentals. You’re comfortable building and training models with PyTorch or JAX.
Experience running large experiments. You can design an experiment, see it through and draw sound conclusions from the results.
Familiarity with distributed training. You know your way around GPU-based development and distributed training infrastructure.
Research instincts and engineering discipline. You ask good questions, test your assumptions and build clean systems that hold up beyond the experiment.

Nice to have

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

Footage quality control: Using vision-language and video models to identify defects and gaps in captured data.
Video understanding and annotation: Structured captioning, temporal grounding and scene understanding.
Training and post-training: Reward modeling, synthetic data, and data curation and filtering for multimodal models.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$200K

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Role Overview

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical owner for strategic customer AI engagements, responsible for turning high-value business problems into working, production-ready AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI engineering, solution architecture, and hands-on delivery. The FDE works directly with customer business and technical teams to identify the right problem, rapidly build and validate a solution, deploy it into real operating environments, and continuously optimize it against measurable business outcomes.

This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end-to-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer.

Key Responsibilities

Own customer outcomes end to end. Partner with customer business and technical leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, define measurable success criteria, and own the technical outcome from discovery through prototype, live test, production, and optimization.
Build hands-on. Rapidly prototype, code, configure, integrate, test, and deploy AI solutions using customer systems, APIs, data, workflows, and cloud services.
Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and optimize agent behavior, prompts, context, tool invocation, orchestration, grounding, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Connect AI to the enterprise. Develop secure integrations across APIs, webhooks, enterprise applications, data platforms, identity systems, and legacy environments so AI agents can act reliably within real business workflows.
Validate with engineering rigor. Build evaluation and observability approaches that test accuracy, safety, latency, reliability, and business outcomes; diagnose failures and edge cases and iterate rapidly.
Move prototypes into production. Apply sound software engineering, security, governance, CI/CD, version control, monitoring, and operational practices to deliver maintainable production solutions.
Remove production blockers. Work directly with Genesys Product, Engineering, Support, and cross-functional teams to identify platform gaps, resolve technical issues, and unblock customer deployment.
Co-build with customers. Work alongside customer engineers and architects, transfer knowledge, and leave customer teams more capable of operating and extending the solution after the engagement.
Create the field-to-product feedback loop. Translate repeatable customer needs, deployment friction, and edge cases into actionable product feedback, feature requests, technical patterns, and reference implementations.
Build once, scale everywhere. Package proven agents, integrations, prompts, evaluation methods, deployment patterns, and implementation playbooks into reusable assets that accelerate future customer engagements.
Operate with ownership and urgency. Maintain accountability through resolution, manage ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and drive multiple stakeholders toward measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical delivery, solution architecture, or a comparable hands-on role; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
Demonstrated production ownership. Experience taking at least one meaningful software, AI, data, or integration solution from concept or prototype into a production environment and supporting it through real-world use.
Enterprise integration expertise. Experience designing or building with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication/authorization, structured and unstructured data, and modern cloud or SaaS architectures.
Applied AI and LLM knowledge. Practical experience with large language models and agentic AI concepts such as prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, orchestration, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and guardrails.
Engineering discipline for AI. Ability to test, debug, monitor, and improve AI systems using repeatable evaluation, tracing, logging, versioning, and software quality practices.
Customer-facing technical leadership. Ability to lead discovery and technical working sessions, translate ambiguous business problems into buildable technical solutions, and communicate credibly with both senior executives and engineers.
High-agency execution. A record of learning quickly, making sound tradeoffs, operating effectively with incomplete information, and owning problems through resolution rather than handing them off.
Collaborative product mindset. Ability to work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Engineering, Support, Security, and customer teams while converting field learnings into reusable patterns and product feedback.
AI-native development mindset. Comfort using modern AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate software delivery while remaining accountable for code quality, security, and maintainability.
AI-assisted engineering tools. Experience using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Amazon Kiro, or similar AI coding environments as part of a regular development workflow.
Enterprise data and knowledge systems. Experience with vector databases, search, data pipelines, knowledge retrieval, enterprise data platforms, or integrating AI with CRM, ERP, ITSM, or other systems of record.
Agentic AI experience. Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, agent-to-agent workflows, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
Travel flexibility. Ability to travel to customer sites and company events as needed for strategic engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on programming capability. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or an equivalent language, with the ability and willingness to learn additional technologies quickly.
Production AI observability and optimization. Experience with evaluation pipelines, tracing, latency and cost optimization, reliability monitoring, safety controls, or LLM-native performance metrics.
Cloud and deployment experience. Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and with deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, or serverless architectures.
Conversational or voice AI experience. Experience building customer-facing conversational AI, virtual agents, voice AI, or contact-center solutions.
Customer experience domain knowledge. Experience with Genesys Cloud CX, customer experience technology, contact center platforms, workforce engagement, routing, or related enterprise SaaS solutions is valuable but not required.
Security and responsible AI. Understanding of enterprise security, identity and access management, data privacy, auditability, permissioning, prompt injection risks, and safe tool execution for AI systems.
Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced technical education is a plus but not required.

The profile we are building: Business thinker. Hands-on builder. Customer technologist. Relentless owner. Builds once, scales everywhere.

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$134,900.00 - $237,300.00

Benefits:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
Telehealth coverage
Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities
Development and career growth opportunities
Open Time Off in addition to 10 paid holidays
401(k) matching program
Adoption Assistance
Fertility treatments

Working at Genesys

AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to develop our core libraries for Agentic Applications. Are you excited by the prospect of building foundational technology that powers the next generation of agents? Have you ever dreamed of elevating engineering practices to enable the safe and scalable deployment of autonomous systems? As a global leader in AI and deep learning, NVIDIA is redefining industries and our work in agentic computing is at the forefront of this revolution. Join us in building the scalable agentic capabilities, reusable building blocks, and high-quality libraries that will accelerate developer productivity, ensure agent quality, and provide critical acceleration and optimization for highly performant and efficient agents. Work directly with a community of creative engineers and collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in the world of autonomous agents!

What You'll Be Doing

Track and understand evolving agent development patterns across NVIDIA and the broader ecosystem, maintaining current knowledge of both research and commercial products.
Develop open-source libraries and tools which accelerate and optimize agent harnesses and frameworks ensuring top-tier performance, accuracy, quality, and stability.
Benchmark the latest agents to identify bottlenecks and build creative solutions to increase performance, reduce cost, and improve latency.
Work closely with teams building high-performance data pipelines, RAG systems, vector databases, and GPU-optimized training and inference workflows to deliver best-in-class agentic applications.
Identify gaps and friction in current agent architectures, and translate insights into agentic tools that boosts developer velocity and agent quality—backed by evaluations, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years experience in at least one of Rust, Python, Go, or Node.js, with working familiarity in at least one more.
Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, callbacks, request lifecycles, and event-driven systems.
Hands-on experience with evolving agent architectures, multiple agents frameworks and agent harnesses.
Proficiency in LLM applications, agent workflows, tool calls, and model-provider APIs.
Ability to design or extend cross-language APIs with attention to consistency, usability, stability, and backwards compatibility.
Systems-level debugging and performance intuition: able to trace execution from high-level API calls through runtime internals, language bindings, callbacks, serialization, and event emission to understand overhead and optimize hot paths.
Strong interpersonal skills, enabling direct contact and effective collaboration with the open source community.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience building evaluation/benchmarking systems for agent workflows (metrics, regression, feedback loops).
Rust systems work, especially async Rust, Tokio, serde, API design, or runtime state management and /or Python native extension experience with PyO3, maturin, or Python/Rust bindings.
Instrumenting third-party frameworks without changing user-visible behavior. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry, tracing, structured events, exporters, or observability pipelines are a plus.
Middleware, plugin systems, guardrails, policy engines, or request/response interception and maintaining open-source libraries, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.
Profiling or optimizing runtime/library overhead across language boundaries, async execution, native bindings, serialization, tracing, or middleware pipelines.

187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

and Excellence

Lead Applied AI Engineer

Grow your engineering career building the AI systems that understand, model, and rebuild enterprise applications — powering AI automation for the world's largest enterprises.

This role is based at our headquarters in McLean, Virginia. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian.

About The Team

Appian Engineering spans the full depth of our platform: from the foundational layers that power enterprise scale, to the AI capabilities redefining what automation can do. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment focused on technical precision, continuous learning, and high code quality. By joining our team, you will solve real-world problems that directly shape how Appian delivers our AI-Powered Process Automation platform to enterprises around the world.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Lead Applied AI Engineer, you will serve as a technical linchpin for the team building AI systems that reason about enterprise applications end to end — spanning agents and orchestration, specification extraction from existing systems, application intelligence and retrieval, and rigorous LLM evaluation. These skills are shared across the team, so you'll bring production depth in some of these areas and the range to grow into the others. Equipped with cutting-edge AI tooling, you'll design and deliver systems of real sophistication, shape engineering practices, and deepen your expertise while ensuring flawless Enterprise-Grade Orchestration.

What You'll Do

Develop Clean Software: Architect, build, and optimize production AI systems while keeping a strong hands-on technical presence.
Build Production Agents: Design reliable agents and orchestration — planning, tool use, memory, and state — with safe, permission-aware boundaries.
Extract Specifications from Existing Systems: Derive requirements and executable specs from source, metadata, tests, and runtime behavior, and map them onto Appian's object model.
Model Application Intelligence: Build the semantic and dependency models and retrieval that give AI accurate context across large application estates.
Prove Correctness with Evaluation: Build the evaluation and CI pipelines that gate quality and catch real regressions.
Engineer with AI: Use AI coding tools fluently to ship faster without compromising quality or correctness.
Optimize Performance & Scale: Engineer reliability, latency, and efficiency into core systems at enterprise scale.
Mentor & Champion Talent: Coach and guide junior engineers to accelerate their technical growth.
Influence Technical Documentation: Share expertise across the department and publish to Engineering's permanent documentation site.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science or a related technical/analytical discipline.
7+ years of relevant software development experience with a BS (or 5+ years of experience paired with a Master of Science in Computer Science or a related field).
Strong distributed-systems background, including retries, idempotency, partial failure, long-running tasks, and recovery.
Strong software engineering, data-pipeline, and observability skills, comfortable owning a production service end to end.
Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants and a strong ability to evaluate, coach others on, and selectively apply AI-generated code in a production engineering context.
Exceptional ability to communicate highly technical architectures verbally, visually, and in writing to diverse engineering audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in code search, repository intelligence, or developer tools.
Experience with legacy codebase and workflow modernization.
We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.

The base salary range represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant work experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, and market and business conditions that exist when extending an offer. A discretionary bonus may be awarded in recognition of individual and company performance.

In addition, Appian provides generous benefits offerings that include a 401(k) plan with company match, flexible time off, paid parental leave, medical, dental, and vision plans, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness programs, flexible spending accounts, health savings account contributions, an employee referral bonus program, and learning and development resources. Certain positions may be eligible for equity awards.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation, commission, bonus, or benefit plans.

Base Salary Range

$150,000—$300,000 USD

Tools and Resources

Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

Benefits

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Leads and executes deep dive diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to support data-driven business decision making. Mentors and develops junior data scientists and analysts.

Vanguard is committed to continuous Client Experience improvement, and the Enterprise Intelligence group develops and supports a suite of internal CX analytical tools. These Data Science tools – spanning models, software, and interfaces – are used by internal Vanguard expert analysts to better understand CX outcomes. This position is for a full stack Data Scientist supporting the continued development of our internal suite of CX analytical tools. The role will be responsible for rapidly understanding the current state of those methods / models / systems, then working with existing Data Science and Machine Learning stakeholders to support and update that suite.

Applicants should have a baseline understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), deployment of code through Python packages, integration of AI into code (both in development and application), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) fundamentals for text processing & analysis. Your work will connect with subject matter experts across Data Science, Analytics, Client Experience, and Business – you’ll need to be able to cater your technical communication across audiences. You will follow the Vanguard Model Governance process and adhere to AI usage policies, protecting client information and ensuring full compliance with safety & security best practices.

You’ll be working with a highly-skilled team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers, on a suite of software that has moved beyond its initial development stages. This will demand rapid familiarization, the ability to quickly understand existing codebase, and finding opportunities for improvement. You will need to work with your management and stakeholders to prioritize tasking, autonomously deliver on that tasking, and proactively come back with proposed next steps.

Core Responsibilities

Deliver technology:

Build and support existing software, models, packages, and other analytics tools used for data-driven business decision making.
Implement AI prompt engineering, NLP text processing, and unstructured data modeling in systems & packages.
Deploy software to internal consumers, adhere to the PDLC process, create and use monitoring & tracking features.

Use technology responsibly:

Follow the Vanguard Model Governance methodology & process, adhering to security policies around AI usage, software design, and model validation.
Identify and diagnose data & code issues, always through continuous code review, and when necessary by performing root-cause analysis and post-mortems.
Proactively surface found issues or risks.

Manage stakeholders:

Engage with internal stakeholders (DS, MLE, Business...) to understand and probe business processes in order to improve CX models, packages, and tools.
Establish Definitions-of-Done with stakeholders, ensure that DoD is tracked and met through the PDLC process.
Communicate complex findings and implications to leaders & teammates.

Be a team player:

Mentor and develop junior data scientists and analysts.
Actively share information across workstreams, promote cross-pollination of findings & hurdles.
Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum of five years related work experience in Data Science development & modeling roles.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or related Data Science field of study, or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred.
Experience with the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), especially deploying Data Science tools to expert analyst users.
Proven experience using AI and NLP methods & tools to extract information from unstructured data at scale. Strong background using quantified measures to evaluate text, developing models around those measures, and improving them over time.
Advanced programming experience with Python, including deploying solutions as Packages that include telemetry feedback, safeguards, secure credentialing, and other User Access Controls (UAC).
Ability to communicate technically complex concepts across varying audiences. Know when to dive deep, and when to keep things high-level.
Some experience with data wrangling required – ability to extract, transform and load (ETL) large-scale data for statistical modeling.
Preference for candidates who have worked with Client Experience & client outcomes, who have familiarity with terminology surrounding client feedback & stories.

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

Job Description

Senior Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Scientist

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard – from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

We’re seeking a Senior AI/ML Scientist to design and deploy advanced machine learning solutions for vehicle lifecycle management, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance. You’ll work with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, machine learning, and real-time inference systems to develop intelligent, scalable solutions for automotive applications.

In this highly visible role, you’ll work with complex vehicle and engineering data to generate earlier, more precise insights. You’ll focus initially on 12-volt battery health and help develop approaches that can extend to infotainment and other vehicle systems. Your work will connect foundational AI/ML methods with practical tools used by engineers and service teams, helping them recognize issues sooner and resolve them faster. You’ll partner closely with engineering and AI colleagues and communicate findings and impact to a range of stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to apply advanced machine learning to complex engineering challenges and help turn vehicle data into practical insights that support better products and service outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Build, evaluate, and deploy foundational machine learning models using complex engineering, vehicle telemetry, and other technical datasets.
Develop signature clustering, anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis approaches to connect known issues with patterns in vehicle data.
Create predictive capabilities to detect battery drain, software issues, and emerging failure patterns earlier – supporting faster issue resolution and fewer avoidable warranty claims and service visits.
Apply advanced methods across deep learning, natural language processing, time-series forecasting, generative AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), selecting the right approach for each problem.
Integrate AI/ML capabilities into scalable tools and workflows, translating model outputs into useful, actionable insights for engineers and service teams.
Partner with domain experts and cross-functional engineering teams to frame problems, validate findings, and move solutions from experimentation into practical use.
Build and optimize LLM-based applications, including RAG systems for technical information and automated analysis.
Help develop reliable data pipelines and inference workflows, and communicate results to technical and non-technical stakeholders through clear recommendations, dashboards, or APIs.
Share your expertise and support the growth of other team members as AI/ML capabilities expand.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models, with a track record of applying modeling to complex real-world data.
Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience building, evaluating, and improving ML models.
Practical experience with deep learning and at least one major ML framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Strong hands-on experience with advanced and emerging modeling techniques, including deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, or vector databases, and the ability to select and apply suitable methods to complex problems.
Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with noisy, high-dimensional, or otherwise complex datasets.
Ability to collaborate across disciplines and explain technical results in a clear, decision-oriented way.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Skills)

Master’s or Ph.D. in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline; a Ph.D. is highly preferred.
8+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated experience building custom ML models on complex technical, engineering, or telemetry datasets.
Knowledge of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, diagnostics, or automated root-cause analysis.
Experience with automotive systems, vehicle data, or warranty and service workflows.
Familiarity with SQL, distributed data processing (such as Spark or Hive), ML platforms (such as Databricks, MLflow, or Azure ML), cloud environments, or containerization (such as Docker and Kubernetes).

Job Description

Job Family Definition:

This is a hands-on technical engineering role focused on product security vulnerability investigations, CVE coordination, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and AI-driven security automation.

Management Level Definition

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the CVE ecosystem, CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) processes, and Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) operations, combined with software engineering and automation capabilities.

As AI-powered vulnerability discovery technologies increase the volume and complexity of security findings, you will help HPE scale its product security response processes through intelligent automation, workflow integration, and AI-assisted vulnerability analysis.

You will collaborate closely with product engineering teams, security researchers, vulnerability response teams, and technical leaders to ensure vulnerabilities are accurately investigated, documented, remediated, and communicated to customers.

Responsibilities

Product Security Response & Vulnerability Coordination

Lead technical investigations of reported product security vulnerabilities, from initial intake through remediation coordination and disclosure readiness.
Evaluate vulnerability impact, exploitability, affected product versions, and technical severity.
Work with product engineering teams to validate security findings, reproduce vulnerabilities when needed, and coordinate remediation activities.
Support CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) processes, including CVE reservation, assignment, registration, and vulnerability record management.
Coordinate vulnerability disclosures in alignment with CVE Program requirements and established industry practices.
Develop, review, and coordinate customer-facing security advisories and vulnerability bulletins.
Collaborate with internal security response teams, external security researchers, and product stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely vulnerability communication.

AI-Enabled Security Automation

Design and implement automation to improve the scalability and efficiency of product vulnerability response operations.
Develop AI-assisted workflows that process vulnerability findings from engineering defect-tracking systems, security testing platforms, and internal reporting channels.
Build integrations with Jira and other engineering systems to extract, organize, and validate vulnerability information.
Apply approved LLMs, GenAI capabilities, and automation frameworks to support vulnerability triage, case analysis, knowledge retrieval, and security advisory drafting.
Design human-in-the-loop validation processes to ensure AI-generated security information is technically accurate and reviewed before publication.
Develop reusable Python scripts, APIs, services, and automation tools that reduce manual case management and repetitive administrative work.
Evaluate emerging AI and security technologies that can improve vulnerability response quality, consistency, and operational efficiency.

Security Engineering & Technical Leadership

Serve as a technical resource for complex product security vulnerabilities and security response investigations.
Build and maintain security validation tools, proof-of-concept scripts, and test harnesses when needed to support vulnerability analysis.
Collaborate with product security engineers, software developers, cloud engineering teams, and security researchers.
Help improve security response processes, technical documentation, and operational workflows.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across product security and development teams.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of HPE's enterprise product security response capabilities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
Typically, 10+ years' experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience working within or closely supporting a Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT/PSRT).
Experience working for a CVE Numbering Authority or participating directly in CVE assignment and publication workflows.
Experience developing or integrating AI/LLM-enabled tools, GenAI workflows, or agentic automation systems.
Experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, case management, reporting, or security advisory generation.
Experience with security automation, Python-based tooling, REST APIs, and enterprise workflow integrations.
Familiarity with cloud and SaaS security environments, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with enterprise infrastructure, networking, storage, operating systems, or related technology products.
Knowledge of security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability research, or proof-of-concept development.

jobs.title: MLOps Senior Lead Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

The Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS) organization at NVIDIA deploys and operates modern GPU high performance computing systems for NVIDIA researchers. We are seeking a senior engineer for our MLOps team: expert in HPC and computational machine learning who work alongside researchers to dig into their requirements, workloads and infrastructure needs, and turn recurring problems into platform improvements.

What You Will Be Doing

Set the technical direction for the MLOps team. Keep the team passionate about customer efficiency. Serve as the senior hands-on engineer others rely on in complex customer and performance situations.
Work 1-to-1 with researchers on LLM, autonomous-vehicle and generative-model workloads to diagnose training and inference performance problems and repeated crashes across compute, network and storage.
Debug large-scale distributed training end to end: NCCL collectives, high-speed interconnects and remote direct memory access, parallel storage, containers (Enroot, Pyxis), and Slurm and Kubernetes schedulers.
Find recurring problems across customers, work with MARS peers, partners and platform teams to fix them at scale, and translate customer needs into platform feature requests.
Test the platform: run what customers run, and shift testing earlier so issues are caught before capacity is handed over.
Produce trainings, guidance and reference tests; share what we learn through blog posts, talks and papers.
Raise the engineering bar: mentor engineers at all levels, pair on bring-ups, run design reviews and keep decisions written down with a clear owner.

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years designing, operating or supporting large-scale GPU or HPC compute infrastructure, with experience in distributed training and inference as an infrastructure engineer or advanced user.
Strong hands-on experience with Slurm or Kubernetes for model development and prediction, and with containers (Docker, Enroot, Apptainer or Singularity).
Solid understanding of at least one distributed training framework (PyTorch, NeMo or Megatron, JAX) and inference servers (Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve).
Experience profiling distributed training performance with tools such as the PyTorch profiler or flight recorder, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute, and a proven grasp of NCCL collectives such as all-gather and all-to-all.
Fluency in Python and at least one systems language (Go, Rust or C++); familiarity with infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
Ability to explain how to isolate a performance problem to compute, network or storage, and to debug several kinds of complex systems.
Data-driven judgment, and the ability to influence without authority across research, platform and partner teams. Excellent written and verbal communication.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience leading bring-up or acceptance testing of GPU clusters with thousands of nodes, including MLPerf or similar benchmarking.
Deep knowledge of InfiniBand and RDMA, and of fast distributed storage such as Lustre or GPFS for AI and HPC workloads.
CUDA programming background and a clear picture of how GPUs, networks and storage interact during training.
Experience with observability for ML workloads (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ClickHouse) and with goodput or efficiency metrics.
Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, shaping a team's engineering practices, and engaging partners and vendors.
