jobs.title: Data Scientist, Growth
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

Team members for this role must be based In San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on our products daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Help shape how millions of people discover and get value from a connected suite of AI-powered products that work where they do.

Superhuman is bringing together products including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Go, GPTZero, and Fathom. The opportunity is bigger than growing any one product: it’s understanding how people move across the suite, what they need next, and how a more connected experience can create lasting value for users and the business.

As a Growth Data Scientist,
you’ll help define how we measure and accelerate that growth. You’ll investigate questions like which product a user is most likely to value next, where people encounter friction across the self-serve journey, and how packaging and monetization can support both adoption and retention. You’ll use experimentation, modeling, and rigorous measurement to turn those questions into decisions.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Finance, and User Research, with visibility into the leaders shaping our growth strategy. Your analysis won’t stop at reporting what happened: you’ll help teams decide what to build, where to invest, and how to know whether it worked.

This role is a chance to bring your multi-product growth experience to an ambitious, evolving portfolio—and help shape how it grows. If you enjoy untangling complex user journeys, connecting product-level insights to portfolio-wide outcomes, and making your work matter in the roadmap, you’ll find meaningful scope in this opportunity.

What you’ll do

Identify the next-best product within our suite that users would value through modeling, persona mapping, and experimentation that increases customer lifetime value.
Map and analyze self-serve user journeys across our product suite, from first visit through activation, purchase, and long-term retention.
Help shape the bundle economics and monetization capabilities of the Superhuman bundle.
Be an embedded data science partner across our growth areas, earning trust and driving evidence-based decision-making by turning insights into roadmap decisions.
Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions that improve user-funnel efficiency and drive meaningful user growth.

Qualifications

You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers.
You have experience with B2C or product-led growth, especially self-serve funnels spanning acquisition, activation, onboarding, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
You understand bundled products and multi-product growth, including how product discovery, adoption, cross-sell, and continued use of multiple products affect conversion, retention, and customer value.
You can use modeling and user-journey analysis to inform next-best-product recommendations, bundle economics, and monetization decisions.
You have experimentation expertise: you can design and analyze A/B tests, choose appropriate success metrics, account for guardrails and tradeoffs, and communicate uncertainty clearly.
You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions.
You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere.
You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity.
You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output.
You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

Nice To Haves

Experience with cross-product attribution and measurement, such as understanding how one product contributes to adoption or retention in another.
Expertise working within a multi-product GTM offering.
You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks.
You have experience working at a fast-growing startup, on AI-native consumer products, and/or in B2C/SaaS.

Compensation And Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
Disability and life insurance options
401(k) matching
Paid parental leave
20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time
Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)
Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations.

Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.

US Zone 1 (SF, SEA, NYC)

$225,000 to $275,000

US Zone 2

$200,000 to $248,000

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Job Description:

The Principal Marketing Data Scientist serves as a senior level individual contributor and subject matter expert for advanced analytics, predictive modeling, customer intelligence, and marketing data science. This role is responsible for developing sophisticated analytical solutions that drive customer engagement, marketing effectiveness, business growth, and enterprise decision-making. The incumbent partners closely with teams and Line of Business leaders across the enterprise to solve complex business challenges through advanced statistical analysis, machine learning, predictive modeling, experimentation, and customer analytics. The role serves as a technical leader, establishing analytical standards, mentoring team members, and advancing enterprise analytical maturity.

Develops, implements, maintains, and continuously improves advanced statistical, predictive, machine learning, and optimization models that support customer acquisition, retention, engagement, growth, personalization, and marketing effectiveness initiatives.
Designs, executes, and evaluates customer segmentation, clustering, audience intelligence, customer lifetime value, attribution, forecasting, recommendation, and next-best-action methodologies to improve business performance and customer experience outcomes.
Leads the design and evaluation of experimentation and measurement methodologies, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, incrementality studies, attribution models, conversion path analyses, and other analytical frameworks that support data-driven decision-making.

Attribution models
Customer analytics solutions
Statistical models
Forecasting frameworks
Machine learning applications
Experimentation methodologies

Experience working with large-scale customer, operational, transactional, behavioral, and engagement datasets.
Strong proficiency with Python, R, SQL, Databricks, Snowflake, SAS or equivalent analytical platforms.
Experience developing analytical solutions within cloud-based data environments preferred.
Knowledge of customer data platforms, marketing technology ecosystems, digital analytics, and customer journey analytics preferred.
Strong communication, storytelling, consulting, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to explain highly technical concepts to executive, business, and operational audiences.

Ability to work prolonged periods sitting and/or standing at a workstation and working on a computer.
Ability to travel across the Health Plan service region for meetings and/or trainings as needed.

This role is a chance to bring your multi-product growth experience to an ambitious, evolving portfolio—and help shape how it grows. If you enjoy untangling complex user journeys, connecting product-level insights to portfolio-wide outcomes, and making your work matter in the roadmap, you’ll find meaningful scope in this opportunity.

Help shape the bundle economics and monetization capabilities of the Superhuman bundle.
Be an embedded data science partner across our growth areas, earning trust and driving evidence-based decision-making by turning insights into roadmap decisions.
Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions that improve user-funnel efficiency and drive meaningful user growth.

Qualifications

You have experimentation expertise: you can design and analyze A/B tests, choose appropriate success metrics, account for guardrails and tradeoffs, and communicate uncertainty clearly.
You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions.
You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere.
You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity.
You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output.
You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

Position Summary

About the Role Morehouse School of Medicine ( MSM ) seeks a highly analytical and collaborative Epidemiologist / Population Health Data Scientist to join the Department of Pediatrics in support of the Solve Sickle Cell Initiative. The successful candidate will lead and contribute to population health and outcomes research, design and analyze epidemiologic studies, and support the integration of basic science discoveries into clinical care across hospital and community settings. Findings from community implementation and health services research will, in turn, inform future translational and basic science questions, reinforcing a bidirectional research model. Program Description Morehouse School of Medicine ( MSM ), The Aflac Cancer and Blood Disorders Center of Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta (Children’s), and Emory University School of Medicine (Emory) are partnering in a $16M expansion of their Sickle Cell Disease Program called the Georgia Solve Sickle Cell Disease Initiative (Solve Sickle). The Initiative is supported by the Georgia Research Alliance, and investments from MSM , Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta, and Emory University. This initiative will focus on the development, testing, and implementation of new therapies in sickle cell disease and includes the addition of three faculty members at Emory and MSM . The Department of Pediatics at MSM invites qualified applicants to apply for the keystone position of this initiative as Data Scientist/Epidemiologist. * “This position may be funded by extramural grant funding and continuation is contingent upon the availability of these external funds.”

Minimum Qualifications

PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Data Science, Public Health, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related population science discipline; from a regionally accredited college or university. Familiarity with public health systems, health policy, and/or healthcare delivery systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong quantitative, analytical, statistical, and scientific writing skills. Proficiency in statistical software (e.g., SAS , SPSS , R, or equivalent tools) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams. Demonstrated experience in population health research, clinical trials, and/or health outcomes research. Demonstrated record of research productivity, including peer-reviewed publications and successful collaborative research initiatives. Demonstrated history of external research funding, where relevant. Experience working in collaborative, multi-institutional research environments. Experience in sickle cell disease research, health informatics, population health, clinical trials, or related fields.

Description of Job Duty

Roles and Responsibilities Provide leadership for the Innovate Care and Data Science Research Theme of the Solve Sickle Cell Initiative. Design and conduct population-based, epidemiologic, and health services research addressing sickle cell disease outcomes, symptomatology, self-management, care delivery, and survivorship. Participate in and help lead clinical trials, including pragmatic and implementation science studies focused on behavioral interventions, care delivery models, and health outcomes. Apply advanced statistical and epidemiologic methods to analyze clinical, claims, registry, and EHR data to evaluate patterns of care, quality, and disparities. Develop and evaluate interventions to improve screening, care coordination, and long-term outcomes. Lead and contribute to competitive extramural grant applications (e.g., R01, U01, or equivalent) as PI, Co-Investigator, or site lead. Demonstrate a strong track record of securing extramural research funding (note: language intentionally excludes “independent funding”). Publish high-quality, peer-reviewed manuscripts and present findings at national and international scientific meetings. Collaborate effectively across Morehouse School of Medicine, Emory University School of Medicine, Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta, and other Solve Sickle partners. Engage with statewide, national, and global research networks. Prepare scientific reports and communicate findings to academic, clinical, and community stakeholders. Contribute to the development of evidence-informed public health and care delivery strategies. Mentor research staff, trainees, and students in population health sciences, epidemiology, outcomes research, and clinical trial methodology. Ensure compliance with policies, federal regulations, and sponsor requirements across all research activities for Morehouse School of Medicine and its institutional partners.

We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to define the architecture for a governed, zero-copy, cross-cloud data platform, establishing the design standards and integration priorities that guide the engineering team. Working across Databricks, Snowflake, and adjacent cloud data sources, this leader will translate an evolving product vision into concrete design specifications and a clear path toward agent-based data consumption, while ensuring alignment with the organization’s existing enterprise engineering practices. The role is accountable for owning the end-to-end solution architecture of a governed, zero-copy data platform in which data remains in place within its source systems. This position requires a senior, hands-on technical leader who can operate at the intersection of platform strategy, modern data engineering, and architectural governance — creating clarity from complexity, making sound build-versus-integrate trade-offs, and setting the technical standards that help Appnovation’s clients deliver faster, safer, and more reusable data capabilities.

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Role Overview

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical owner for strategic customer AI engagements, responsible for turning high-value business problems into working, production-ready AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI engineering, solution architecture, and hands-on delivery. The FDE works directly with customer business and technical teams to identify the right problem, rapidly build and validate a solution, deploy it into real operating environments, and continuously optimize it against measurable business outcomes.

This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end-to-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer.

Key Responsibilities

Own customer outcomes end to end. Partner with customer business and technical leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, define measurable success criteria, and own the technical outcome from discovery through prototype, live test, production, and optimization.
Build hands-on. Rapidly prototype, code, configure, integrate, test, and deploy AI solutions using customer systems, APIs, data, workflows, and cloud services.
Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and optimize agent behavior, prompts, context, tool invocation, orchestration, grounding, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Connect AI to the enterprise. Develop secure integrations across APIs, webhooks, enterprise applications, data platforms, identity systems, and legacy environments so AI agents can act reliably within real business workflows.
Validate with engineering rigor. Build evaluation and observability approaches that test accuracy, safety, latency, reliability, and business outcomes; diagnose failures and edge cases and iterate rapidly.
Move prototypes into production. Apply sound software engineering, security, governance, CI/CD, version control, monitoring, and operational practices to deliver maintainable production solutions.
Remove production blockers. Work directly with Genesys Product, Engineering, Support, and cross-functional teams to identify platform gaps, resolve technical issues, and unblock customer deployment.
Co-build with customers. Work alongside customer engineers and architects, transfer knowledge, and leave customer teams more capable of operating and extending the solution after the engagement.
Create the field-to-product feedback loop. Translate repeatable customer needs, deployment friction, and edge cases into actionable product feedback, feature requests, technical patterns, and reference implementations.
Build once, scale everywhere. Package proven agents, integrations, prompts, evaluation methods, deployment patterns, and implementation playbooks into reusable assets that accelerate future customer engagements.
Operate with ownership and urgency. Maintain accountability through resolution, manage ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and drive multiple stakeholders toward measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical delivery, solution architecture, or a comparable hands-on role; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
Demonstrated production ownership. Experience taking at least one meaningful software, AI, data, or integration solution from concept or prototype into a production environment and supporting it through real-world use.
Enterprise integration expertise. Experience designing or building with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication/authorization, structured and unstructured data, and modern cloud or SaaS architectures.
Applied AI and LLM knowledge. Practical experience with large language models and agentic AI concepts such as prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, orchestration, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and guardrails.
Engineering discipline for AI. Ability to test, debug, monitor, and improve AI systems using repeatable evaluation, tracing, logging, versioning, and software quality practices.
Customer-facing technical leadership. Ability to lead discovery and technical working sessions, translate ambiguous business problems into buildable technical solutions, and communicate credibly with both senior executives and engineers.
High-agency execution. A record of learning quickly, making sound tradeoffs, operating effectively with incomplete information, and owning problems through resolution rather than handing them off.
Collaborative product mindset. Ability to work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Engineering, Support, Security, and customer teams while converting field learnings into reusable patterns and product feedback.
AI-native development mindset. Comfort using modern AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate software delivery while remaining accountable for code quality, security, and maintainability.
AI-assisted engineering tools. Experience using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Amazon Kiro, or similar AI coding environments as part of a regular development workflow.
Enterprise data and knowledge systems. Experience with vector databases, search, data pipelines, knowledge retrieval, enterprise data platforms, or integrating AI with CRM, ERP, ITSM, or other systems of record.
Agentic AI experience. Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, agent-to-agent workflows, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
Travel flexibility. Ability to travel to customer sites and company events as needed for strategic engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on programming capability. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or an equivalent language, with the ability and willingness to learn additional technologies quickly.
Production AI observability and optimization. Experience with evaluation pipelines, tracing, latency and cost optimization, reliability monitoring, safety controls, or LLM-native performance metrics.
Cloud and deployment experience. Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and with deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, or serverless architectures.
Conversational or voice AI experience. Experience building customer-facing conversational AI, virtual agents, voice AI, or contact-center solutions.
Customer experience domain knowledge. Experience with Genesys Cloud CX, customer experience technology, contact center platforms, workforce engagement, routing, or related enterprise SaaS solutions is valuable but not required.
Security and responsible AI. Understanding of enterprise security, identity and access management, data privacy, auditability, permissioning, prompt injection risks, and safe tool execution for AI systems.
Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced technical education is a plus but not required.

The profile we are building: Business thinker. Hands-on builder. Customer technologist. Relentless owner. Builds once, scales everywhere.

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$134,900.00 - $237,300.00

Job Description:

Digital Technology Product Lead – Digital and Agentic Commerce

At Mars Snacking, our purpose is to inspire happiness with better snacks for better days. Our iconic brands M&M'S®, PRINGLES®, SNICKERS®, CHEEZ-IT®, EXTRA®, Skittles®, POP-TARTS® and KIND® are enjoyed in more than 180 countries, sparking connection, creating memories, and adding a little brightness to everyday moments. As the world's leading maker of chocolate, gum, mints and fruity confections, we know that snacks may be small, but they carry real meaning, and behind every one is a team of passionate Associates working to make it even better.

Mars Snacking's Tech-Fueled Sales (TFS) ambition is to build a human-led, digitally powered Sales Engine that keeps our Associates at the center. Within TFS, cross-functional PODs operate as agile value engines, bringing together commercial experts, product leaders, process champions, and digital technologists to deliver high-impact capabilities directly into the flow of commerce. As consumer discovery and commerce continue to evolve through AI-powered experiences, conversational assistants, and emerging digital channels, Mars is helping shape the future of Digital and Agentic Commerce.

The Digital Technology Product Lead – Digital and Agentic Commerce serves as the Product Owner for Mars Snacking's global Digital Commerce and Agentic Commerce capabilities within Tech-Fueled Sales. 5+ years of experience in digital product management, digital commerce, e-commerce, or related technology disciplines.

is responsible for identifying, defining, prioritizing, and managing AI and machine learning products, use cases, and capabilities that deliver measurable business value. This role serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders, data domain teams, and the AI/ML delivery organization, ensuring that AI investments align with strategic objectives and enterprise priorities.

, partnering closely with AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Governance teams, and business leaders to drive the successful delivery, adoption, and scaling of AI-powered solutions across the enterprise.

AI Product Strategy & Roadmap Management

Define and maintain the vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned business function AI/ML products and capabilities.
Identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, customer experience, decision-making, or business performance.
Develop business cases, prioritization, and value realization plans for AI initiatives.
Align AI product priorities with enterprise strategic objectives, data domain roadmaps, and business outcomes.

Use Case Identification & Prioritization

Help develop adoption and change management strategies for AI-enabled capabilities.
Partner with business teams to ensure successful deployment and operational integration.

Benefits And Compensation

This position offers competitive market-based compensation, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee wellbeing. You can learn more about the benefits offered for this position by visiting https://careers.international.com/#benefits.

Company Overview

About TRATON

With its brands Scania, MAN, International, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus, TRATON SE is the parent and holding company of the TRATON GROUP and one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. The Group’s product portfolio comprises trucks, buses, and light-duty commercial vehicles. “Transforming Transportation Together. For a sustainable world.”: this intention underlines the Company’s ambition to have a lasting and sustainable impact on the commercial vehicle business and on the Group’s commercial growth.

About International

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Who WeAre

At the birth of digital, Claravine noticed a persistent problem with data integrity. This discovery eventually led to a unique category solution that continues to redefine how top brands manage the digital experience. We are committed to helping our clients develop the data accuracy, depth, and consistency they need to deliver truly world-class digital experiences and marketing campaigns.

What We Do

At Claravine, we help large enterprises solve complex data consistency and accuracy problems. We do this through the Data Standards Cloud, a SaaS platform that enables customers to set their own data standards and gives their teams a way to validate their data.

Who You Are

You are a consultative technical advisor who makes Claravine work inside customers' real technology stacks and keeps it working as their businesses change. You see the gap between what a customer uses today and what they could be doing, and you can explain that gap to executives and operations teams alike.

As a Solutions Architect (SA), you will own the technical solution for a book of enterprise accounts, from discovery through a validated build.

This is an advisory role with hands-on build responsibility. You will be prescriptive about the decisions a customer needs to make, including the sequence, the trade-offs, and their technical consequences, and you will give a recommended starting point. The customer owns the final content of their taxonomy. You make sure they can make those decisions early, with confidence, and build something that lasts. You will work closely with Customer Success, our Forward-Deployed Product Managers, Enablement, Support, and Product.

What You'll Do

Design and deliver the right solution

Lead technical discovery: understand the customer's workflow from brief to reporting, what consumes Claravine data downstream, and what that system requires.
Solve the business requirement rather than the stated request, and have that conversation openly when the two differ.
Design solutions that the customer's own administrator can maintain and that survive their next reorganization.
Build to a high standard (structure, naming, testing, and documentation) and validate against real customer data before declaring a build complete.
Surface scope change, risk, and blockers early instead of absorbing them quietly.

Advise customers through the decisions that stall implementations

Guide customers through the taxonomy and governance decisions they need to settle (structure, granularity, ownership, approvals, and enforcement) using Claravine's decision guides and a recommended starting point.
Bring these decisions forward to kickoff and discovery, where they are cheap, rather than letting them block the build.
Challenge what customers bring instead of overlaying Claravine on top of a broken process, and identify the organizational problem when it is presented as a technical one.
Document the why behind every design decision as it is made.

Drive value after go-live

Maintain current-state documentation for each account you own: what is built, what is used, and what is dormant.
Identify the top unrealized capabilities for every account and make that gap visible through repeatable plays, run alongside the Customer Success Manager (CSM).
Take over build support from our Forward-Deployed Product Managers at handoff and support incremental growth into new teams, business units, and use cases.

Be the technical authority on the platform and the ecosystem

Know what the platform does and where it stops, and never commit the product to behavior it does not have.
Design against the constraints of adjacent systems such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), ad platforms, digital asset management (DAM) and product information management (PIM) systems, customer data platforms (CDPs), data warehouses, and work management tools.
Resolve complex technical questions and Tier 2 issues, routing routine requests to Support and true defects to Engineering with clear evidence.

Make the product and the team better

Turn customer friction into structured product input, with business impact, affected accounts, and workarounds attached.
Contribute patterns, playbooks, and design decisions to the SA knowledge base as work completes, and take part in design review in both directions.
Keep accounts transferable on documentation rather than on a meeting, and take a defined role in onboarding new SAs.

What Success Looks Like

30 days: You have completed onboarding and know the tools, processes, and people you will work with every day. You have gone deep on the Claravine platform by building templates, lists, and integrations hands-on, so you understand how customers use it to govern their marketing data. You have also taken on your first customer account.
90 days: You are managing a full book of accounts and working independently. You lead discovery sessions, kick off new customer engagements, and design and deliver solutions that fit each customer's workflows and tech stack. You work through technical challenges with confidence, with the team behind you for the toughest problems.
6 months: You lead customers through the full lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through build and ongoing optimization. You are the voice of the customer in product conversations, you add to our shared knowledge base, and you share insights that help the wider Customer Success team serve customers better.
12 months: You are a fully ramped Solutions Architect and a trusted technical advisor to your customers. You guide them on data strategy, taxonomy, and integration decisions, deliver work to a consistently high standard, and help raise the bar for the team through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and process improvement.

What You Bring

Required

4+ years in solution architecture, solutions consulting, technical implementation, or marketing technology at a B2B SaaS company or agency serving enterprise customers.
Hands-on experience with marketing and analytics ecosystems, such as Adobe Analytics and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Google Analytics, Campaign Manager 360, DV360, Meta Ads Manager, DAM or PIM systems, and Workfront. [Confirm which are essential versus "experience with several of these."]
A strong understanding of taxonomy, metadata, campaign tracking, and naming conventions, and why clean data matters for reporting, attribution, and AI.
Comfort working with APIs, file-based integrations, and data flows.
A consultative approach: you can lead a discovery session, push back with evidence, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, from operations teams to executives.
Strong documentation habits and the discipline to build things other people can maintain.
Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in your work, and a clear view of where human judgment is needed.

Preferred

Willingness to travel for customer meetings and team events.
Scripting or SQL experience.
Experience designing or governing taxonomies across multiple business units, or driving adoption of data standards in a large organization.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Claravine, Inc is committed to the principles of equal employment. It is our intent to build and maintain a work environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation based on an individual’s race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status, protected medical leaves, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

We Encourage You to Apply

We know that some candidates, especially those from historically underrepresented groups, may hesitate to apply unless they feel they meet 100% of the requirements. If you’re excited about this role and believe you could be a great fit, we encourage you to apply. Your unique experiences and perspective could be exactly what we need.

About Gravity

Gravity is the ad network for AI. We place relevant, sponsored suggestions inside AI platforms, right when someone is deciding what to do or buy.

Everyone at Gravity believes three things:

AI should be free for everyone.
Most people will never pay for an AI subscription.
Someone has to pay for the compute, and advertising is the answer.

If you believe these too, you'll probably fit right in.

We built our ad engine from the ground up for AI interactions. Any AI platform can plug in with one integration, and we're already live on 50+ of them, reaching millions of conversations every day.

Conversation understanding. Build semantic analysis of conversations from scratch, so the engine knows what each moment is about.
Identity and audiences. Build our identity graph and lookalike products.

LLM-based ad matching. Very few people have done it.

Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role, requiring 3 days per week in our SF Hub. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer who takes real ownership and does well in a fast-moving, ambitious, and problem-oriented environment. You’ll work hands-on with improving our LLMs, and using them to solve for high-impact product opportunities. You’ll own part of the direction of our AI work: framing the right problems, finding their most effective solution, and helping shape the roadmap.

This role is a bit of a hybrid of machine learning/engineering with product. It would suit someone already in an AI Engineering role, as well as software engineers or data scientists that have gone deep into shaping models (themselves) to propel them forward.

What you’ll do

Lead entire AI/ML initiatives from problem definition through delivery.
Influence technical direction and roadmap decisions by framing problems clearly and backing choices with evidence.
Partner with product, engineering, and design to deliver high-impact models.
Strengthen our ML practices and infrastructure, including evals, training pipelines, and model serving.
Mentor teammates and share knowledge to raise the bar across the team.

By 30 Days, You Will Have

Upgraded an existing feature to be meaningfully smarter and/or faster, and shared what you learned with the team.
Reviewed our evaluation approach and improved or built evals for our core features.
Found the highest-leverage opportunities in our AI stack and started shaping priorities with the team.

By 90 Days, You Will Have

Led the delivery of AI features that address valuable customer use cases.
Fine-tuned models for our specific needs and set repeatable practices others can build on.
Developed new processes to speed up how we utilize new AI models.

Qualifications

A track record of owning and shipping production AI/ML systems end-to-end, with the independence and judgment expected of a senior engineer.
A blend of modern LLM expertise and structured problem-solving. You can work backward from a user problem, frame the right technical question, and define how to evaluate success. That structured problem-solving might come from product engineering, technical consulting, or comparable experience.
Deep hands-on experience in LLM post-training and/or inference optimization, with evidence of exceptional results in a specific problem area. For example:
Building a model that outperforms strong alternatives on a specialized task through thoughtful dataset development, supervised fine-tuning, preference tuning, or reinforcement learning.

Making LLMs substantially faster or more efficient through tailored quantization, speculative decoding, or other inference techniques.The ability to go beyond established recipes: diagnosing failure modes, designing experiments, and adapting methods to the problem at hand.Strong evaluation judgment. You design evals grounded in user needs, distinguish meaningful improvements from benchmark gains, and establish practices that catch regressions before users do.
Experience serving and optimizing models at scale, with a practical understanding of the trade-offs between latency, throughput, uptime, and cost.
Strong production Python and fluency with data, including building and cleaning datasets, analyzing results in Python or SQL, and working comfortably with modern training and serving stacks.
Experience influencing technical direction and helping other engineers succeed through clear reasoning, collaboration, and mentoring.

Nice to have

Experience spanning both LLM post-training and inference optimization.
Successful application of preference tuning or reinforcement learning to improve real-world model performance.
Speech or long-context experience, especially with noisy, lengthy transcripts.
Experience establishing ML infrastructure, evaluation practices, or model development workflows at a startup or growth-stage company.

How you work

Ownership: You take ambiguous problems and drive them to clear outcomes without waiting for perfect specs.
High standards: You care about quality and detail, you’re tenacious, and you raise the bar for everyone around you.
Pragmatic and results-driven: You pick the right hills to climb and find the fastest way up.
A generalist who dives deep: You might work on data one day and training methods or infrastructure the next.
Clear communicator: You explain technical results and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
Multiplier: You make the people around you better through mentorship, reviews, and knowledge-sharing.

Job Description

Senior Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Scientist

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard – from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

We’re seeking a Senior AI/ML Scientist to design and deploy advanced machine learning solutions for vehicle lifecycle management, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance. You’ll work with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, machine learning, and real-time inference systems to develop intelligent, scalable solutions for automotive applications.

In this highly visible role, you’ll work with complex vehicle and engineering data to generate earlier, more precise insights. You’ll focus initially on 12-volt battery health and help develop approaches that can extend to infotainment and other vehicle systems. Your work will connect foundational AI/ML methods with practical tools used by engineers and service teams, helping them recognize issues sooner and resolve them faster. You’ll partner closely with engineering and AI colleagues and communicate findings and impact to a range of stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to apply advanced machine learning to complex engineering challenges and help turn vehicle data into practical insights that support better products and service outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Build, evaluate, and deploy foundational machine learning models using complex engineering, vehicle telemetry, and other technical datasets.
Develop signature clustering, anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis approaches to connect known issues with patterns in vehicle data.
Create predictive capabilities to detect battery drain, software issues, and emerging failure patterns earlier – supporting faster issue resolution and fewer avoidable warranty claims and service visits.
Apply advanced methods across deep learning, natural language processing, time-series forecasting, generative AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), selecting the right approach for each problem.
Integrate AI/ML capabilities into scalable tools and workflows, translating model outputs into useful, actionable insights for engineers and service teams.
Partner with domain experts and cross-functional engineering teams to frame problems, validate findings, and move solutions from experimentation into practical use.
Build and optimize LLM-based applications, including RAG systems for technical information and automated analysis.
Help develop reliable data pipelines and inference workflows, and communicate results to technical and non-technical stakeholders through clear recommendations, dashboards, or APIs.
Share your expertise and support the growth of other team members as AI/ML capabilities expand.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models, with a track record of applying modeling to complex real-world data.
Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience building, evaluating, and improving ML models.
Practical experience with deep learning and at least one major ML framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Strong hands-on experience with advanced and emerging modeling techniques, including deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, or vector databases, and the ability to select and apply suitable methods to complex problems.
Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with noisy, high-dimensional, or otherwise complex datasets.
Ability to collaborate across disciplines and explain technical results in a clear, decision-oriented way.

Master’s or Ph.D. in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline; a Ph.D. is highly preferred.
8+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated experience building custom ML models on complex technical, engineering, or telemetry datasets.
Knowledge of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, diagnostics, or automated root-cause analysis.
Experience with automotive systems, vehicle data, or warranty and service workflows.
Familiarity with SQL, distributed data processing (such as Spark or Hive), ML platforms (such as Databricks, MLflow, or Azure ML), cloud environments, or containerization (such as Docker and Kubernetes).

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Staff AI/ML Engineer
is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying intelligent models that enable autonomous decision-making across scientific workflows. By leveraging machine learning, statistical modeling, optimization techniques, and emerging AI technologies, this role transforms laboratory, instrument, and operational data into actionable insights that improve scheduling, resource utilization, workflow reliability, and scientific outcomes. Through the development of scalable AI and ML solutions, the Staff AI/ML Engineer helps advance the company’s vision for autonomous, AI-enabled lab operations.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Automation and is part of the R&D Software team located in San Jose, California and Indianapolis, Indiana.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Design, develop, and deploy machine learning, optimization, and AI solutions that improve lab throughput, resource utilization, workflow reliability, and autonomous decision-making across scientific workflows.
Build predictive models and intelligent analytics capabilities using laboratory, instrument, and operational data to enable forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, and workflow optimization.
Develop and maintain scalable model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring pipelines that ensure AI and ML solutions remain accurate, reliable, and production-ready throughout their lifecycle.

Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have an opening for a Machine Learning (ML) Bioengineer
to conduct research training and evaluating next-generation clinical, protein and genome language models. You will join the Bioresilience Incubator, a dynamic engineering center that integrates predictive computational modeling, machine learning, and experimental biology to advance national security and public health missions. This position will be in the Computational Engineering Division (CED), within the Engineering Directorate, matrixed to the Bioresilience Incubator.

As a member of our multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate with experts in machine learning, molecular simulation, optimization, and bioinformatics, and interface with experimentalists generating large datasets via novel high-throughput assays. You will leverage in-house computational tools and contribute to the design, training, and evaluation of new machine learning-based methods.

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

Collaborate with project scientists and engineers to develop, implement, and evaluate computational frameworks and models.
Contribute to the development and application of advanced analysis methodologies; analyze data; document research through presentations and peer-reviewed publications.
Support technical activities for new capability development and provide solutions to moderately complex to complex technical problems using established and innovative methods.
Contribute to the completion of project milestones, influencing the development of organizational goals and objectives. Establish, implement, and maintain quality standards for project deliverables.
Contribute to briefings and presentations documenting project activities and research results.
Routinely interact with technical contacts at sponsor and partner organizations; represent the organization on specific technical projects.
Participate in the development of future research directions and proposals to secure ongoing projects in computational protein design.
Balance multiple projects/tasks and priorities to ensure deadlines are met, working independently with minimal direction within the scope of assignments.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Determine, propose, and implement advanced analysis methodologies and contribute to identifying future research directions and proposals that will secure future projects in the field.
Guide the completion of projects and influence the development of organizational goals and objectives.
Lead the development of briefings and presentations documenting to project activities and research results.
Represent the organization as the primary technical contact on tasks and projects, serving on internal technical/advisory committees and potentially on external committees.
Oversee the activities of other personnel, providing informal mentoring and guidance to less-experienced team members.
Contribute to and influence the development of innovative projects, principles, and ideas in computational protein design.

Qualifications

Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
Comprehensive knowledge and experience developing and applying algorithms in one or more of the following machine learning areas: deep learning, unsupervised feature learning, zero- or few-shot learning, active learning, transformer-based language modeling, multimodal learning.
Experience developing and implementing deep learning models and algorithms using modern software libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar, as evidenced by publications or software releases.
Experience with high-performance computing, multi-node, multi-GPU, distributed training.
Comprehensive knowledge in protein and genome language models sufficient to communicate effectively with team members and subject matter experts.
Proficient verbal and written communication skills necessary to collaborate within a team environment and present technical information to varied audiences.
Effective interpersonal skills and initiative necessary to interact with all levels of personnel and work independently in a collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment.
Demonstrated ability to balance multiple projects and prioritize competing demands while maintaining high-quality standards for deliverables.

Additional Qualifications At The SES.3 Level

Advanced knowledge and experience in developing and applying algorithms in machine learning areas.
Significant experience developing and implementing medium to large-scale deep learning models and algorithms using modern software libraries.
Demonstrated ability to provide guidance and informal mentoring to other personnel and junior team members.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills necessary to effectively collaborate in a multidisciplinary team and present technical information to a variety of audiences.
Demonstrated ability to represent the organization as a primary technical contact and to contribute to the development of innovative projects, principles, and ideas.

Qualifications We Desire

PhD in Computational Biology, Computational Bioengineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
Strong understanding of protein and genome language models and datasets.
Experience publishing research results in peer-reviewed scientific journals and presenting at conferences and workshops.
Experience with GPU programming and running complex workflows.

Independently partners with science, engineering, and product teams to translate business needs into a clear research plan and production-ready solutions.

Description

The IC4 Applied Scientist for Robotics, Perception, and Embodied AI will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for defining, prototyping, and delivering AI capabilities for commercially viable robotic systems. This role partners across science, software engineering, product, and hardware teams to identify high-impact opportunities, translate ambiguous product needs into research and engineering roadmaps, and guide end-to-end solution development from data collection and experimentation through production deployment. The scientist will lead applied research in multi-sensor fusion, real-time signals, perception, multimodal reasoning, reinforcement learning, and action-conditioned planning, with a strong bias for hands-on execution and full-stack delivery.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Solution Identification and Strategy

Partner with science, engineering, product, and hardware leaders to identify strategic product needs where robotics, perception, and embodied AI can create measurable customer and business impact.
Evaluate academic literature, industry benchmarks, robotics platforms, and commercially viable robot APIs to assess feasibility, technical difficulty, and delivery risks.
Break down ambiguous robotics and AI problems into clear research plans, model architectures, data requirements, evaluation criteria, and production milestones.
Set science quality standards for applied robotics workstreams, including perception accuracy, latency, robustness, safety, reliability, and operational feedback metrics.
Prioritize solutions using the scientific process, including modeling approaches, evaluation techniques, data collection strategies, and risk/reward tradeoffs.

Applied Research and Model Development

Lead the design and execution of research programs and POCs for sensors, multi-sensor fusion, real-time signal processing, and perception systems.
Develop and guide approaches for object detection, tracking, activity recognition, scene understanding, and related perception capabilities in real-world environments.
Advance multimodal AI systems that combine signals such as camera, depth, lidar, audio, telemetry, proprioception, and task context.
Apply reinforcement learning, action-conditioned planning, decision-making, and reasoning methods to enable robot behaviors that are robust, measurable, and product-relevant.
Define dataset strategy, data quality criteria, labeling approaches, simulation or synthetic data opportunities, and evaluation protocols for robotics and embodied AI use cases.
Guide model training, fine-tuning, optimization, inference design, and compute/latency tradeoffs for real-time or near-real-time deployment scenarios.

Solution Delivery and Production Integration

Lead full-stack execution across experimentation, data pipelines, model development, evaluation, deployment integration, and production monitoring.
Partner closely with software engineering, machine learning engineering, hardware teams, and product stakeholders to integrate AI capabilities into robotic systems and services.
Evaluate and review high-complexity code, establish best practices for repositories, version control, code review, documentation, testing, and delivery readiness.
Define operational metrics and user feedback loops to assess delivered solutions in production and inform future technical strategy.
Serve as an escalation point for complex robotics, AI, perception, and systems integration issues, driving root-cause analysis and durable solutions.

Research Leadership and Influence

Demonstrate thought leadership in at least one business-critical area such as robot perception, multimodal systems, sensor fusion, reinforcement learning, or embodied AI.
Translate research insights into clear technical recommendations, patents, white papers, design documents, demos, or conference-quality publications where appropriate.
Mentor and guide scientists and engineers, raising the bar for applied research rigor, experimentation quality, and production readiness.
Establish productive collaborations with internal teams, external research groups, academic partners, or commercial robotics ecosystem partners where relevant.

Core Competencies

Bias for action with a strong hands-on orientation; able to move from ambiguous idea to prototype, evaluation, and production path quickly.

new_jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on.

We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way.

What you’ll do

Build models for the problems in front of us. You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi-view, multi-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short.
Work through the difficult footage. You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects.
Find out where your models fail. You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results.
Own the path to production. You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back.
Follow problems through to a fix. You’ll reproduce customer-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up.

What you’ll bring

Strong machine learning fundamentals. You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch.
Experience training large vision models from scratch. Your experience goes beyond running or fine-tuning existing models.
Depth in a computer vision specialty. You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction.
Experience owning models in production. You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward.
Comfort with the work as it is. You can make progress with noisy real-world data and adapt when priorities shift.

Nice to have

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

Hand and body tracking: 3D hand and full-body tracking, mesh recovery, human-object and human-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground.
SLAM, VIO and calibration: Learned ego-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale.
3D reconstruction and objects: Feed-forward or per-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Percept Eye Inc. is an AI agent reliability and fine-tuning platform designed for teams deploying AI systems to production. Engineering and AI teams use Percept Eye to simulate complex production environments, stress-test agent behavior across thousands of real-world scenarios, and accelerate validation cycles from months to days. The platform supports the full pre-deployment lifecycle with observability-driven simulation gyms built from real production data, automated prompt and workflow optimization, and integrated security benchmarking against safety standards such as HarmBench and HELM. Percept Eye was founded by a team that has scaled AI at organizations including Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Broadcom, and Unity, and is backed by Unusual Ventures and participates in the NVIDIA Inception Program. Team members work on cutting-edge reliability and safety challenges for real-world AI applications.
Role Description
The Machine Learning Researcher will design, implement, and evaluate novel methods to improve reliability, robustness, and safety of AI agents running on the Percept Eye platform. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and testing algorithms for simulation, evaluation, and fine-tuning; analyzing large-scale production-like datasets; and creating metrics and benchmarking methodologies aligned with emerging safety standards. The role involves close collaboration with engineering and product teams to translate research ideas into production-ready features, as well as preparing technical reports, prototypes, and internal documentation. This is a full-time role based in San Francisco, CA with a hybrid work arrangement, allowing a mix of on-site collaboration and work-from-home flexibility.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in machine learning and AI, including experience with deep learning, reinforcement learning, or agent-based systems.
Proficiency in programming for research and production (e.g., Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and working with large datasets.
Background in model evaluation, reliability, safety, or robustness, including designing experiments, metrics, and benchmarks.
Understanding of modern LLMs, prompt engineering, and workflow optimization for AI agents is highly beneficial.
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, clearly communicate research findings, and document methods and results.
Experience with cloud-based or distributed systems, experiment tracking, and observability tools is a plus.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in applied ML research.
Prior work in AI safety, security benchmarking, or reliability for production AI systems is strongly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Applied AI Architect - Seedance / Seedream / Seed Audio
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Seedance, Seedream and Seed Audio are ByteDance's AI models for video, image and audio. Customers across advertising, gaming and frontier AI applications want to build with them, and most of those customers need more than an API key. They need someone who understands how their business makes content today, can show leaders where AI changes the economics, and can sit with their creators until the new workflow actually runs.

As an Applied AI Architect with ByteDance, you'll get to use our video, image and audio models and work with the teams that build them. You'll also own the full path from industry insight to working adoption: you learn the customer's business, advise its decision-makers on AI transformation, prototype the solution yourself, and train the creators who will use it every day. From first executive conversations to creators using the solution in production, you'll help define what Applied AI means for generative media across these rapidly changing industries. Multiple levels are available.

- Understand the industry and its workflows
- Build deep knowledge of how content is made and paid for in your target industries, from creative production and asset pipelines to budgets, timelines and performance metrics.
- Map where video, image and audio generation creates real value for a customer, and where it does not yet.
- Track how the industry is adopting generative media and turn that into a clear point of view on high-value use cases.
- Advise decision-makers on AI transformation
- Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives, including CMOs, studio heads, heads of creative and CTOs.
- Shape AI transformation roadmaps that cover use-case priorities, workflow and team changes, ROI, and governance for content safety and IP.
- Lead discovery sessions, executive briefings and workshops that turn broad ambition into scoped, fundable projects.
- Partner with Sales and Business Development on strategic accounts, from first conversation through deployment and expansion.
- Prototype agentic solutions on Seedance, Seedream and Seed Audio
- Turn real customer briefs into working prototypes quickly, so customers can judge results on their own content.
- Design end-to-end solutions that combine our models with APIs, agents, automation and the customer's existing tools and pipelines.
- Develop prompting and multi-model workflows that reach professional quality, and be honest about the limits of each model.
- Define how quality is evaluated for each use case, and guide customers from proof of concept to production.
- Enable creators and customer teams
- Design and run hands-on training for creators, artists, marketers and developers at customer organizations.
- Create the materials that let adoption scale without you: playbooks, prompt guides, demo libraries, templates and reference workflows.
- Build internal capability by equipping our sales and solutions teams with demos and vertical stories.
- Represent our models at industry events, creator communities and customer showcases.
- Close the loop with Product and Research
- Bring structured field feedback to product and research teams, with concrete examples of what works and what fails.
- Separate one-off customer requests from repeatable needs, and turn the repeatable ones into product requirements and reusable solutions.
- Test new model capabilities early and work out what they make possible for customers.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Minimally 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical or creative role, such as applied AI, solutions architecture, forward-deployed engineering, creative technology, technical art, or AI consulting.
- A track record of advising stakeholders and moving them from interest to decision. Good at crafting tailored industry stories and solution pitches to convince stakeholders to take actions.
- Hands-on experience with generative AI for video, image or audio, with a real sense of where today's tools excel and where they break.
- Ability to build: comfortable with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs and scripting, enough to ship a working prototype without waiting for an engineering team.
- Clear communication with both executives and creators, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
- Experience teaching others, through workshops, training programs, public content or team enablement.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in industries such as advertising, gaming, model labs, robotics, film, VFX, e-commerce or other related fields.
- Having a portfolio of creative or technical work.
- Experience taking AI solutions from proof of concept to production in an enterprise setting.
- Familiarity with production tooling such as creative suites, ad platforms, game engines, 3D tools or simulation environments.
- Ideally coming with public presence in AI or creator communities.

About Us

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​

Why Join ByteDance

Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.​
As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
Diversity & Inclusion​
ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist, Growth
new_jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

Team members for this role must be based In San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on our products daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Help shape how millions of people discover and get value from a connected suite of AI-powered products that work where they do.

Superhuman is bringing together products including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Go, GPTZero, and Fathom. The opportunity is bigger than growing any one product: it’s understanding how people move across the suite, what they need next, and how a more connected experience can create lasting value for users and the business.

As a Growth Data Scientist,
you’ll help define how we measure and accelerate that growth. You’ll investigate questions like which product a user is most likely to value next, where people encounter friction across the self-serve journey, and how packaging and monetization can support both adoption and retention. You’ll use experimentation, modeling, and rigorous measurement to turn those questions into decisions.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Finance, and User Research, with visibility into the leaders shaping our growth strategy. Your analysis won’t stop at reporting what happened: you’ll help teams decide what to build, where to invest, and how to know whether it worked.

This role is a chance to bring your multi-product growth experience to an ambitious, evolving portfolio—and help shape how it grows. If you enjoy untangling complex user journeys, connecting product-level insights to portfolio-wide outcomes, and making your work matter in the roadmap, you’ll find meaningful scope in this opportunity.

What you’ll do

Identify the next-best product within our suite that users would value through modeling, persona mapping, and experimentation that increases customer lifetime value.
Map and analyze self-serve user journeys across our product suite, from first visit through activation, purchase, and long-term retention.
Help shape the bundle economics and monetization capabilities of the Superhuman bundle.
Be an embedded data science partner across our growth areas, earning trust and driving evidence-based decision-making by turning insights into roadmap decisions.
Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions that improve user-funnel efficiency and drive meaningful user growth.

Qualifications

You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers.
You have experience with B2C or product-led growth, especially self-serve funnels spanning acquisition, activation, onboarding, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
You understand bundled products and multi-product growth, including how product discovery, adoption, cross-sell, and continued use of multiple products affect conversion, retention, and customer value.
You can use modeling and user-journey analysis to inform next-best-product recommendations, bundle economics, and monetization decisions.
You have experimentation expertise: you can design and analyze A/B tests, choose appropriate success metrics, account for guardrails and tradeoffs, and communicate uncertainty clearly.
You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions.
You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere.
You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity.
You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output.
You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

Nice To Haves

Experience with cross-product attribution and measurement, such as understanding how one product contributes to adoption or retention in another.
Expertise working within a multi-product GTM offering.
You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks.
You have experience working at a fast-growing startup, on AI-native consumer products, and/or in B2C/SaaS.

Compensation And Benefits

Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
Disability and life insurance options
401(k) matching

20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time
Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)
Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Give every agent an owner, scoped credentials, least privilege, and approvals where the action calls for it, and track it from creation to offboarding like a user.

Put limits on tool calls, network access, data egress, and resource use.

Define the logs AI systems must produce, build detections for risky grants and sensitive data going into AI tools, lead the AI side of incidents, and join the on-call rotation.
