Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Job Family Definition:

This is a hands-on technical engineering role focused on product security vulnerability investigations, CVE coordination, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and AI-driven security automation.

Management Level Definition

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the CVE ecosystem, CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) processes, and Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) operations, combined with software engineering and automation capabilities.

As AI-powered vulnerability discovery technologies increase the volume and complexity of security findings, you will help HPE scale its product security response processes through intelligent automation, workflow integration, and AI-assisted vulnerability analysis.

You will collaborate closely with product engineering teams, security researchers, vulnerability response teams, and technical leaders to ensure vulnerabilities are accurately investigated, documented, remediated, and communicated to customers.

Responsibilities

Product Security Response & Vulnerability Coordination

Lead technical investigations of reported product security vulnerabilities, from initial intake through remediation coordination and disclosure readiness.
Evaluate vulnerability impact, exploitability, affected product versions, and technical severity.
Work with product engineering teams to validate security findings, reproduce vulnerabilities when needed, and coordinate remediation activities.
Support CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) processes, including CVE reservation, assignment, registration, and vulnerability record management.
Coordinate vulnerability disclosures in alignment with CVE Program requirements and established industry practices.
Develop, review, and coordinate customer-facing security advisories and vulnerability bulletins.
Collaborate with internal security response teams, external security researchers, and product stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely vulnerability communication.

AI-Enabled Security Automation

Design and implement automation to improve the scalability and efficiency of product vulnerability response operations.
Develop AI-assisted workflows that process vulnerability findings from engineering defect-tracking systems, security testing platforms, and internal reporting channels.
Build integrations with Jira and other engineering systems to extract, organize, and validate vulnerability information.
Apply approved LLMs, GenAI capabilities, and automation frameworks to support vulnerability triage, case analysis, knowledge retrieval, and security advisory drafting.
Design human-in-the-loop validation processes to ensure AI-generated security information is technically accurate and reviewed before publication.
Develop reusable Python scripts, APIs, services, and automation tools that reduce manual case management and repetitive administrative work.
Evaluate emerging AI and security technologies that can improve vulnerability response quality, consistency, and operational efficiency.

Security Engineering & Technical Leadership

Serve as a technical resource for complex product security vulnerabilities and security response investigations.
Build and maintain security validation tools, proof-of-concept scripts, and test harnesses when needed to support vulnerability analysis.
Collaborate with product security engineers, software developers, cloud engineering teams, and security researchers.
Help improve security response processes, technical documentation, and operational workflows.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across product security and development teams.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of HPE's enterprise product security response capabilities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
Typically, 10+ years' experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience working within or closely supporting a Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT/PSRT).
Experience working for a CVE Numbering Authority or participating directly in CVE assignment and publication workflows.
Experience developing or integrating AI/LLM-enabled tools, GenAI workflows, or agentic automation systems.
Experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, case management, reporting, or security advisory generation.
Experience with security automation, Python-based tooling, REST APIs, and enterprise workflow integrations.
Familiarity with cloud and SaaS security environments, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with enterprise infrastructure, networking, storage, operating systems, or related technology products.
Knowledge of security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability research, or proof-of-concept development.
Familiarity with MITRE CWE, NVD, FIRST, and vulnerability disclosure standards.
Experience collaborating with globally distributed product engineering and security response teams.

new_jobs.title: MLOps Senior Lead Engineer
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

The Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS) organization at NVIDIA deploys and operates modern GPU high performance computing systems for NVIDIA researchers. We are seeking a senior engineer for our MLOps team: expert in HPC and computational machine learning who work alongside researchers to dig into their requirements, workloads and infrastructure needs, and turn recurring problems into platform improvements.

What You Will Be Doing

Set the technical direction for the MLOps team. Keep the team passionate about customer efficiency. Serve as the senior hands-on engineer others rely on in complex customer and performance situations.
Work 1-to-1 with researchers on LLM, autonomous-vehicle and generative-model workloads to diagnose training and inference performance problems and repeated crashes across compute, network and storage.
Debug large-scale distributed training end to end: NCCL collectives, high-speed interconnects and remote direct memory access, parallel storage, containers (Enroot, Pyxis), and Slurm and Kubernetes schedulers.
Find recurring problems across customers, work with MARS peers, partners and platform teams to fix them at scale, and translate customer needs into platform feature requests.
Test the platform: run what customers run, and shift testing earlier so issues are caught before capacity is handed over.
Produce trainings, guidance and reference tests; share what we learn through blog posts, talks and papers.
Raise the engineering bar: mentor engineers at all levels, pair on bring-ups, run design reviews and keep decisions written down with a clear owner.

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years designing, operating or supporting large-scale GPU or HPC compute infrastructure, with experience in distributed training and inference as an infrastructure engineer or advanced user.
Strong hands-on experience with Slurm or Kubernetes for model development and prediction, and with containers (Docker, Enroot, Apptainer or Singularity).
Solid understanding of at least one distributed training framework (PyTorch, NeMo or Megatron, JAX) and inference servers (Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve).
Experience profiling distributed training performance with tools such as the PyTorch profiler or flight recorder, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute, and a proven grasp of NCCL collectives such as all-gather and all-to-all.
Fluency in Python and at least one systems language (Go, Rust or C++); familiarity with infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
Ability to explain how to isolate a performance problem to compute, network or storage, and to debug several kinds of complex systems.
Data-driven judgment, and the ability to influence without authority across research, platform and partner teams. Excellent written and verbal communication.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience leading bring-up or acceptance testing of GPU clusters with thousands of nodes, including MLPerf or similar benchmarking.
Deep knowledge of InfiniBand and RDMA, and of fast distributed storage such as Lustre or GPFS for AI and HPC workloads.
CUDA programming background and a clear picture of how GPUs, networks and storage interact during training.
Experience with observability for ML workloads (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ClickHouse) and with goodput or efficiency metrics.
Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, shaping a team's engineering practices, and engaging partners and vendors.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

About The Team

With a minimal degree of oversight, contributes to using advanced experimental design, statistics, technologies, and (e.g., machine learning, natural language processing) to discover and understand data patterns and trends to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services, product enhancement, and business impact.

Description

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Data Science and Analytics team is seeking a passionate, experienced Senior Data Scientist to tackle complex technical challenges of the Infrastructure Build processes, building sophisticated analytical solutions to drive optimization and efficiency. The candidate should have deep expertise in researching disparate data sources, setting up large-scale data pipelines, and deploying large language models in OCI's growing Infrastructure space. As OCI continues to grow the customer base and regions, we need hands-on scientists who can lead data-driven initiatives to ensure that OCI's Infrastructure is in-tune to support new regions/ expansions. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in the face of ambiguity and can quickly distill abstract ideas into concrete solutions and has a proven track record of delivering data-driven solutions across a highly complex environment involving multiple organizations, departments and teams.

The Senior Data Scientist will be responsible for statistical analyses, ML/ large language model deployment, forecasting models and lead business intelligence initiatives that impact Infrastructure and Networking for OCI. In addition, this specific role requires a passion for solving high-impact problems and the ability to jump into any in-flight project and get it on the rails.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

What You’ll Do

Lead exploratory research and rigorous statistical analysis to translate complex data into clear, actionable answers to strategic business questions; apply data transformation, experimental design, predictive modeling, and machine-learning methods as appropriate.
Design, fine-tune, and optimize scalable algorithms and models, ensuring strong reliability, performance, reproducibility, and operational readiness in high-volume production environments.
Partner with data scientists, engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders to define data requirements, evaluate analytical opportunities, and deliver solutions aligned with measurable business outcomes.
Establish and champion data-quality standards, including validation, monitoring, lineage, and remediation practices, recognizing that reliable inputs are foundational to trustworthy analytical and ML outputs.
Mentor junior data scientists on statistical rigor, modeling best practices, experiment evaluation, code quality, and effective communication of data-driven findings.
Lead the development, evaluation, and fine-tuning of LLM-based solutions for infrastructure-build and data-center-materials use cases, including domain adaptation, retrieval/evaluation strategies, and performance measurement.
Stay current on advances in statistics, machine learning, and data science; assess and apply emerging methods to improve business processes, product capabilities, and decision quality.
Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in machine learning, statistics, and data science, applying new techniques for process/ product improvements.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience, in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong foundation in probability, statistical inference, experimental design, hypothesis testing, regression, and predictive modeling.
Experience applying rigorous statistical analysis to large, complex datasets to answer business questions, quantify uncertainty, and communicate actionable insights.
Proficiency in SQL and Python or R for data extraction, transformation, analysis, visualization, and reproducible modeling workflows.
Experience with data warehousing and working with structured and semi-structured data at scale.
Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience developing, validating, and deploying machine-learning models, including model selection, feature engineering, performance evaluation, and monitoring.
Experience evaluating and adapting LLM or generative-AI solutions for business use cases, including prompt design, benchmarking, and quality assessment.
Collaborative problem-solving skills and the ability to develop, evaluate, and iterate on analytical solutions in an ambiguous environment.

Experience with cloud infrastructure and networking domain
Experience with MLOps, building workflows for model retraining, monitoring and deploying
Experience working with ambiguous problem and driving it to the finish line

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist, Growth
new_jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

Team members for this role must be based In San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on our products daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Help shape how millions of people discover and get value from a connected suite of AI-powered products that work where they do.

Superhuman is bringing together products including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Go, GPTZero, and Fathom. The opportunity is bigger than growing any one product: it’s understanding how people move across the suite, what they need next, and how a more connected experience can create lasting value for users and the business.

As a Growth Data Scientist,
you’ll help define how we measure and accelerate that growth. You’ll investigate questions like which product a user is most likely to value next, where people encounter friction across the self-serve journey, and how packaging and monetization can support both adoption and retention. You’ll use experimentation, modeling, and rigorous measurement to turn those questions into decisions.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Finance, and User Research, with visibility into the leaders shaping our growth strategy. Your analysis won’t stop at reporting what happened: you’ll help teams decide what to build, where to invest, and how to know whether it worked.

This role is a chance to bring your multi-product growth experience to an ambitious, evolving portfolio—and help shape how it grows. If you enjoy untangling complex user journeys, connecting product-level insights to portfolio-wide outcomes, and making your work matter in the roadmap, you’ll find meaningful scope in this opportunity.

What you’ll do

Identify the next-best product within our suite that users would value through modeling, persona mapping, and experimentation that increases customer lifetime value.
Map and analyze self-serve user journeys across our product suite, from first visit through activation, purchase, and long-term retention.
Help shape the bundle economics and monetization capabilities of the Superhuman bundle.
Be an embedded data science partner across our growth areas, earning trust and driving evidence-based decision-making by turning insights into roadmap decisions.
Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions that improve user-funnel efficiency and drive meaningful user growth.

Qualifications

You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers.
You have experience with B2C or product-led growth, especially self-serve funnels spanning acquisition, activation, onboarding, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
You understand bundled products and multi-product growth, including how product discovery, adoption, cross-sell, and continued use of multiple products affect conversion, retention, and customer value.
You can use modeling and user-journey analysis to inform next-best-product recommendations, bundle economics, and monetization decisions.
You have experimentation expertise: you can design and analyze A/B tests, choose appropriate success metrics, account for guardrails and tradeoffs, and communicate uncertainty clearly.
You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions.
You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere.
You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity.
You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output.
You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

Nice To Haves

Experience with cross-product attribution and measurement, such as understanding how one product contributes to adoption or retention in another.
Expertise working within a multi-product GTM offering.
You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks.
You have experience working at a fast-growing startup, on AI-native consumer products, and/or in B2C/SaaS.

Compensation And Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
Disability and life insurance options
401(k) matching
Paid parental leave
20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time
Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)
Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations.

Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.

$225,000 to $275,000

$200,000 to $248,000

Summary

Job Description:

The Principal Marketing Data Scientist serves as a senior level individual contributor and subject matter expert for advanced analytics, predictive modeling, customer intelligence, and marketing data science. This role is responsible for developing sophisticated analytical solutions that drive customer engagement, marketing effectiveness, business growth, and enterprise decision-making. The incumbent partners closely with teams and Line of Business leaders across the enterprise to solve complex business challenges through advanced statistical analysis, machine learning, predictive modeling, experimentation, and customer analytics. The role serves as a technical leader, establishing analytical standards, mentoring team members, and advancing enterprise analytical maturity.

Essential Accountabilities

Develops, implements, maintains, and continuously improves advanced statistical, predictive, machine learning, and optimization models that support customer acquisition, retention, engagement, growth, personalization, and marketing effectiveness initiatives.
Designs, executes, and evaluates customer segmentation, clustering, audience intelligence, customer lifetime value, attribution, forecasting, recommendation, and next-best-action methodologies to improve business performance and customer experience outcomes.
Leads the design and evaluation of experimentation and measurement methodologies, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, incrementality studies, attribution models, conversion path analyses, and other analytical frameworks that support data-driven decision-making.
Analyzes large-scale customer, behavioral, operational, engagement, transactional, and business performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and actionable insights that support strategic and operational objectives.
Partners with Marketing, Customer Experience, Digital, Product, Finance, Information Technology, Enterprise Data & Analytics, and business leaders to translate complex business problems into analytical solutions and measurable outcomes.

Provides technical leadership, guidance, coaching, and mentorship to analysts, data scientists, and analytics professionals to advance organizational analytical capabilities and support high-quality analytical outcomes.
Partners with Technology, Enterprise Data & Analytics, Marketing Technology, Architecture, and Data Governance teams to improve analytical environments, customer data assets, data quality, accessibility, scalability, and performance.
Researches, evaluates, and recommends emerging analytical techniques, artificial intelligence capabilities, machine learning approaches, technologies, and industry best practices that enhance organizational effectiveness and analytical maturity.
Consistently demonstrates high standards of integrity by supporting the Lifetime Healthcare Companies’ mission and values, adhering to the Corporate Code of Conduct, and leading to the Lifetime Way values and beliefs.
Maintains high regard for member privacy in accordance with the corporate privacy policies and procedures.
Regular and reliable attendance is expected and required.
Performs other functions as assigned by management.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Analytics, Operations Research, Engineering, or related field. A combination of education and experience may be considered. Master's degree preferred.
Ph.D. preferred for highly advanced analytical environments.
Eight (8) or more years of progressive experience in data science, advanced analytics, customer analytics, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, machine learning, or related disciplines.
Healthcare or other highly regulated industry experience preferred.

Predictive models
Segmentation and clustering methodologies
Attribution models
Customer analytics solutions
Statistical models
Forecasting frameworks
Machine learning applications
Experimentation methodologies

Advanced knowledge of statistical analysis, predictive analytics, machine learning, experimental design, data science methodologies, customer analytics, marketing measurement, and attribution techniques.
Experience working with large-scale customer, operational, transactional, behavioral, and engagement datasets.
Strong proficiency with Python, R, SQL, Databricks, Snowflake, SAS or equivalent analytical platforms.
Experience developing analytical solutions within cloud-based data environments preferred.
Knowledge of customer data platforms, marketing technology ecosystems, digital analytics, and customer journey analytics preferred.
Strong communication, storytelling, consulting, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to explain highly technical concepts to executive, business, and operational audiences.

Ability to work prolonged periods sitting and/or standing at a workstation and working on a computer.
Ability to travel across the Health Plan service region for meetings and/or trainings as needed.

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist, Growth
new_jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

Team members for this role must be based In San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on our products daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Help shape how millions of people discover and get value from a connected suite of AI-powered products that work where they do.

Superhuman is bringing together products including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Go, GPTZero, and Fathom. The opportunity is bigger than growing any one product: it’s understanding how people move across the suite, what they need next, and how a more connected experience can create lasting value for users and the business.

As a Growth Data Scientist,
you’ll help define how we measure and accelerate that growth. You’ll investigate questions like which product a user is most likely to value next, where people encounter friction across the self-serve journey, and how packaging and monetization can support both adoption and retention. You’ll use experimentation, modeling, and rigorous measurement to turn those questions into decisions.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Finance, and User Research, with visibility into the leaders shaping our growth strategy. Your analysis won’t stop at reporting what happened: you’ll help teams decide what to build, where to invest, and how to know whether it worked.

This role is a chance to bring your multi-product growth experience to an ambitious, evolving portfolio—and help shape how it grows. If you enjoy untangling complex user journeys, connecting product-level insights to portfolio-wide outcomes, and making your work matter in the roadmap, you’ll find meaningful scope in this opportunity.

What you’ll do

Identify the next-best product within our suite that users would value through modeling, persona mapping, and experimentation that increases customer lifetime value.
Map and analyze self-serve user journeys across our product suite, from first visit through activation, purchase, and long-term retention.
Help shape the bundle economics and monetization capabilities of the Superhuman bundle.
Be an embedded data science partner across our growth areas, earning trust and driving evidence-based decision-making by turning insights into roadmap decisions.
Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions that improve user-funnel efficiency and drive meaningful user growth.

Qualifications

You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers.
You have experience with B2C or product-led growth, especially self-serve funnels spanning acquisition, activation, onboarding, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
You understand bundled products and multi-product growth, including how product discovery, adoption, cross-sell, and continued use of multiple products affect conversion, retention, and customer value.
You can use modeling and user-journey analysis to inform next-best-product recommendations, bundle economics, and monetization decisions.
You have experimentation expertise: you can design and analyze A/B tests, choose appropriate success metrics, account for guardrails and tradeoffs, and communicate uncertainty clearly.
You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions.
You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere.
You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity.
You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output.
You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

Nice To Haves

Experience with cross-product attribution and measurement, such as understanding how one product contributes to adoption or retention in another.
Expertise working within a multi-product GTM offering.
You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks.
You have experience working at a fast-growing startup, on AI-native consumer products, and/or in B2C/SaaS.

Compensation And Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
Disability and life insurance options
401(k) matching
Paid parental leave
20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time
Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)
Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations.

Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.

US Zone 1 (SF, SEA, NYC)

$225,000 to $275,000

US Zone 2

$200,000 to $248,000

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).

Bachelor’s degree

Job Description

The Department of Chemistry in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences at Iowa State University (ISU) is seeking a Research Scientist I. This position will conceive, design, and conduct research studies, as well as develop and implement software focused on laboratory automation and orchestration. The position will collaborate with the supervisor and other principal investigators (PIs) at Iowa State University, Ames National Laboratory, and external institutions.

The successful candidate will possess strong communication skills to effectively interact with experienced colleagues in interdisciplinary fields for successful collaboration on research projects. The ability to timely plan, initiate, and execute research activities is important for success in this position. In addition, the successful candidate may mentor other researchers in the supervisor’s work groups and prepare reports as necessary.

This is a 10-month term appointment, with the possibility of renewal based on funding availability.

Examples Of Duties

Design, develop, and implement modular, reusable, accessible, and extensible software solutions for laboratory automation and orchestration.
Plan and coordinate research activities, establish project milestones, and develop implementation plans in collaboration with supervisors and project leads.
Collaborate with internal and external scientists to develop methods, algorithms, and software solutions aligned with project needs.
Conduct research investigations, collect and analyze data, interpret findings, and prepare technical and scientific reports.
Present and communicate research findings at professional and project meetings and contribute to manuscripts for publication.
Provide technical guidance, training, and mentorship to students and researchers in software engineering and research methodologies.
Provide scientific expertise, collaboration, and consultation to researchers and project partners within the area of specialization.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing accessible, open-source laboratory automation software, orchestration frameworks, 3D printer software, and autonomous robotic control and coordination.
Proficiency in Python, LabVIEW, GUI development, and software design patterns, with experience with developing technical software documentation and tutorials using tools such as Sphinx.
Experience integrating laboratory devices through hardware/software interfaces, communication protocols, drivers, and technologies such as SiLA2, gRPC, RS-232, RS-485, USB, serial, and Ethernet.
Experience with collaborative software development tools and workflows, including Git, GitHub, and automated build tools.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including experimental scientists.

new_jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today: time to get life-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.

We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

It’s all part of our time-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The AI Platform Architect
is responsible for defining the architecture, standards, and long-term technical strategy for the AI platform that powers intelligent automation across scientific workflows. By shaping how AI agents securely access data, orchestrate experiments, and interact with complex instrument ecosystems, this role ensures the platform can scale across products, accelerate customer value delivery, and realize the company’s vision for autonomous, AI-enabled laboratory operations.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Automation and is part of the R&D Software team located in San Jose, California and Indianapolis, Indiana.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Define the long-term architecture and technical strategy for the AI platform, establishing the frameworks, patterns, and standards that enable intelligent automation across lab instruments, cloud services, and AI agents.
Lead the design of scalable agentic systems, including context engineering, memory architecture, retrieval strategies, tool integration frameworks, and multi-agent coordination models that support complex scientific workflows.
Establish architectural standards and governance for AI platform services, data contracts, APIs, security boundaries, observability, and responsible AI practices to ensure reliable, secure, and compliant operation across product portfolios.
Partner with software, robotics, data, and product engineering teams to translate business objectives into cohesive AI platform capabilities, driving alignment across multiple products, work cells, and instrument ecosystems.
Evaluate emerging AI, LLM, agent, and automation technologies, defining adoption strategies and reference architectures that accelerate innovation while ensuring performance, scalability, maintainability, and regulatory readiness.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field
7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience architecting AI-powered products, AI platforms, agentic systems, or intelligent automation solutions

Role Responsibilities

Agent-Based Access Design: Design agent- and MCP-based access patterns that expose governed data products to enterprise AI tools and agent platforms.
Future-State Direction: Establish future-state direction for data products, cross-source data composition, and agentic consumption, translating an evolving product vision into concrete design specifications.
Enterprise Alignment: Ensure alignment with the organization’s existing enterprise engineering practices while guiding the engineering team toward a clear path for agent-based data consumption.

Strong background in identity and access management for both users and machine/agent identities (OAuth/OIDC, service accounts).
Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Prior experience in a consulting or client-facing delivery environment, working across multiple concurrent initiatives and priorities.

Familiarity with semantic layers, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation or vector search for data discovery.
Awareness of cross-cloud cost management and FinOps practices.
Experience operating in a regulated life-sciences or comparable compliance-driven environment (GxP, GDPR/HIPAA, PII/PHI handling).

Technical Experience

Data platforms: Databricks, Snowflake; AWS-native data a plus.
Governance and catalog: Collibra, Unity Catalog, Horizon; Neo4j and knowledge graphs.
AI and agents: MCP, Snowflake Cortex and Genie, vector search and embeddings.

Governance Mindset: Embeds data governance, access control, and data-contract standards into platform workflows, balancing the openness of governed data products with security, privacy, and compliance.

new_jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Role Overview

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical owner for strategic customer AI engagements, responsible for turning high-value business problems into working, production-ready AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI engineering, solution architecture, and hands-on delivery. The FDE works directly with customer business and technical teams to identify the right problem, rapidly build and validate a solution, deploy it into real operating environments, and continuously optimize it against measurable business outcomes.

This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end-to-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer.

Key Responsibilities

Own customer outcomes end to end. Partner with customer business and technical leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, define measurable success criteria, and own the technical outcome from discovery through prototype, live test, production, and optimization.
Build hands-on. Rapidly prototype, code, configure, integrate, test, and deploy AI solutions using customer systems, APIs, data, workflows, and cloud services.
Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and optimize agent behavior, prompts, context, tool invocation, orchestration, grounding, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Connect AI to the enterprise. Develop secure integrations across APIs, webhooks, enterprise applications, data platforms, identity systems, and legacy environments so AI agents can act reliably within real business workflows.
Validate with engineering rigor. Build evaluation and observability approaches that test accuracy, safety, latency, reliability, and business outcomes; diagnose failures and edge cases and iterate rapidly.
Move prototypes into production. Apply sound software engineering, security, governance, CI/CD, version control, monitoring, and operational practices to deliver maintainable production solutions.
Remove production blockers. Work directly with Genesys Product, Engineering, Support, and cross-functional teams to identify platform gaps, resolve technical issues, and unblock customer deployment.
Co-build with customers. Work alongside customer engineers and architects, transfer knowledge, and leave customer teams more capable of operating and extending the solution after the engagement.
Create the field-to-product feedback loop. Translate repeatable customer needs, deployment friction, and edge cases into actionable product feedback, feature requests, technical patterns, and reference implementations.
Build once, scale everywhere. Package proven agents, integrations, prompts, evaluation methods, deployment patterns, and implementation playbooks into reusable assets that accelerate future customer engagements.
Operate with ownership and urgency. Maintain accountability through resolution, manage ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and drive multiple stakeholders toward measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical delivery, solution architecture, or a comparable hands-on role; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
Demonstrated production ownership. Experience taking at least one meaningful software, AI, data, or integration solution from concept or prototype into a production environment and supporting it through real-world use.
Enterprise integration expertise. Experience designing or building with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication/authorization, structured and unstructured data, and modern cloud or SaaS architectures.
Applied AI and LLM knowledge. Practical experience with large language models and agentic AI concepts such as prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, orchestration, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and guardrails.
Engineering discipline for AI. Ability to test, debug, monitor, and improve AI systems using repeatable evaluation, tracing, logging, versioning, and software quality practices.
Customer-facing technical leadership. Ability to lead discovery and technical working sessions, translate ambiguous business problems into buildable technical solutions, and communicate credibly with both senior executives and engineers.
High-agency execution. A record of learning quickly, making sound tradeoffs, operating effectively with incomplete information, and owning problems through resolution rather than handing them off.
Collaborative product mindset. Ability to work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Engineering, Support, Security, and customer teams while converting field learnings into reusable patterns and product feedback.
AI-native development mindset. Comfort using modern AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate software delivery while remaining accountable for code quality, security, and maintainability.
AI-assisted engineering tools. Experience using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Amazon Kiro, or similar AI coding environments as part of a regular development workflow.
Enterprise data and knowledge systems. Experience with vector databases, search, data pipelines, knowledge retrieval, enterprise data platforms, or integrating AI with CRM, ERP, ITSM, or other systems of record.
Agentic AI experience. Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, agent-to-agent workflows, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
Travel flexibility. Ability to travel to customer sites and company events as needed for strategic engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on programming capability. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or an equivalent language, with the ability and willingness to learn additional technologies quickly.
Production AI observability and optimization. Experience with evaluation pipelines, tracing, latency and cost optimization, reliability monitoring, safety controls, or LLM-native performance metrics.
Cloud and deployment experience. Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and with deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, or serverless architectures.
Conversational or voice AI experience. Experience building customer-facing conversational AI, virtual agents, voice AI, or contact-center solutions.
Customer experience domain knowledge. Experience with Genesys Cloud CX, customer experience technology, contact center platforms, workforce engagement, routing, or related enterprise SaaS solutions is valuable but not required.
Security and responsible AI. Understanding of enterprise security, identity and access management, data privacy, auditability, permissioning, prompt injection risks, and safe tool execution for AI systems.
Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced technical education is a plus but not required.

The profile we are building: Business thinker. Hands-on builder. Customer technologist. Relentless owner. Builds once, scales everywhere.

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$134,900.00 - $237,300.00

Benefits:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
Telehealth coverage
Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities
Development and career growth opportunities
Open Time Off in addition to 10 paid holidays
401(k) matching program
Adoption Assistance
Fertility treatments

Click here to view a summary overview of our Benefits.

Working at Genesys

AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

At Mars Snacking, our purpose is to inspire happiness with better snacks for better days. Within TFS, cross-functional PODs operate as agile value engines, bringing together commercial experts, product leaders, process champions, and digital technologists to deliver high-impact capabilities directly into the flow of commerce. As consumer discovery and commerce continue to evolve through AI-powered experiences, conversational assistants, and emerging digital channels, Mars is helping shape the future of Digital and Agentic Commerce.

The Digital Technology Product Lead – Digital and Agentic Commerce serves as the Product Owner for Mars Snacking's global Digital Commerce and Agentic Commerce capabilities within Tech-Fueled Sales. Partnering closely with the Global DCom POD Lead, this role owns the product vision, roadmap, and delivery of solutions that connect Mars brands to emerging AI-powered shopping experiences, retailer ecosystems, and digital commerce platforms at global scale.

What Are We Looking For?

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Product Management, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in digital product management, digital commerce, e-commerce, or related technology disciplines.
Proven success leading products from discovery and strategy through delivery, launch, and ongoing optimization.
Experience operating as a Product Owner within Agile/Scrum environments, partnering with engineering teams and business stakeholders.
Understanding of digital commerce ecosystems, including online marketplaces, retailer platforms, digital shelf capabilities, and transactional experiences.
Knowledge of APIs, data integrations, cloud technologies, and modern software development practices.
Familiarity with emerging AI technologies, agent-based systems, and generative AI applications in commerce.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and align cross-functional and executive audiences.
Experience working with external technology partners, vendors, and systems integrators.
Product management, Agile, cloud, or AI-related certifications preferred.

Define Product Strategy & Roadmap: Own and execute the multi-year roadmap for Digital Commerce and Agentic Commerce capabilities, balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform scalability.

Advance Commerce Platforms & Integrations: Drive development of digital shelf, catalog management, inventory visibility, pricing, and commerce orchestration capabilities across channels.

is responsible for identifying, defining, prioritizing, and managing AI and machine learning products, use cases, and capabilities that deliver measurable business value. This role serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders, data domain teams, and the AI/ML delivery organization, ensuring that AI investments align with strategic objectives and enterprise priorities.

The Product Owner/Product Manager works within a federated AI Center of Excellence (COE) model
, partnering closely with AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Governance teams, and business leaders to drive the successful delivery, adoption, and scaling of AI-powered solutions across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

AI Product Strategy & Roadmap Management

Define and maintain the vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned business function AI/ML products and capabilities.
Identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, customer experience, decision-making, or business performance.
Develop business cases, prioritization, and value realization plans for AI initiatives.
Align AI product priorities with enterprise strategic objectives, data domain roadmaps, and business outcomes.
Continuously assess emerging AI technologies and industry trends to identify innovation opportunities.

Use Case Identification & Prioritization

Partner with business functions to identify high-value AI opportunities.
Lead AI use case intake, evaluation, and prioritization processes.
Define problem statements, success criteria, and measurable business outcomes.
Facilitate prioritization based on feasibility, business impact, data readiness, and enterprise strategic alignment.
Maintain and manage the AI use case portfolio and backlog.

Product Ownership & Delivery Leadership

Act as Product Owner for AI/ML initiatives from ideation through deployment and adoption.
Create and maintain product backlogs, epics, features, and user stories.
Partner with AI/ML Engineers and Data Engineers throughout development and implementation.
Support Agile planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release management activities.
Partner closely with AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analytics teams, and Enterprise Architects.
Collaborate with Data Domain leadership to align use cases with enterprise data strategies.

Business Stakeholder and Cross-functional Alignment

Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and AI delivery teams.
Translate complex business challenges into actionable AI product requirements.
Communicate priorities, progress, risks, and value realization to leadership stakeholders.
Help drive organizational alignment around AI initiatives.

Value Realization & Adoption Management

Establish KPIs and outcome-based success metrics for AI products.
Monitor solution performance and business impact after deployment
Help develop adoption and change management strategies for AI-enabled capabilities.
Partner with business teams to ensure successful deployment and operational integration.

AI Governance & Responsible AI Alignment

Ensure AI products comply with enterprise governance, security, privacy, and Responsible AI requirements.
Partner with Data Governance and Compliance teams during product planning and execution.
Support documentation, risk assessment, and approval processes for AI initiatives.
Ensure business stakeholders understand AI capabilities, limitations, and risks.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of technical project/program management experience

OR

Master's degree and at least 1 year of technical project/program management experience

OR

At least 5 years of technical project/program management experience

Additional Requirements

Qualified candidates, excluding current employees, must be legally authorized on an unrestricted basis (US Citizen, Legal Permanent Resident, Refugee or Asylee) to be employed in the United States. We do not anticipate providing employment related work sponsorship for this position (e.g., H-1B status)

Desired Skills

Preferred 5-8 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Master's degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
Transformation, Analytics, Data, or Digital Technology roles.
Experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives involving business and technical stakeholders.
Experience translating business requirements into actionable product and technology solutions.
Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies
Experience delivering AI, machine learning, data analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
Product Owner certification (CSPO, PSPO) or equivalent Agile experience.
Familiarity with machine learning concepts, AI platforms, and modern data architectures.
Experience working within large enterprise organizations and federated operating models.
Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, and data governance frameworks.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

Benefits And Compensation

This position offers competitive market-based compensation, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee wellbeing. You can learn more about the benefits offered for this position by visiting https://careers.international.com/#benefits.

The expected salary offered for this position will fall within the stated range, with the final offer based on the candidates' applicable skills, knowledge, and experience.

With its brands Scania, MAN, International, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus, TRATON SE is the parent and holding company of the TRATON GROUP and one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. new_jobs.title: Solutions Architect
new_jobs.description:
Who WeAre

At the birth of digital, Claravine noticed a persistent problem with data integrity. This discovery eventually led to a unique category solution that continues to redefine how top brands manage the digital experience. We are committed to helping our clients develop the data accuracy, depth, and consistency they need to deliver truly world-class digital experiences and marketing campaigns.

What We Do

At Claravine, we help large enterprises solve complex data consistency and accuracy problems. We do this through the Data Standards Cloud, a SaaS platform that enables customers to set their own data standards and gives their teams a way to validate their data.

Who You Are

You are a consultative technical advisor who makes Claravine work inside customers' real technology stacks and keeps it working as their businesses change. You see the gap between what a customer uses today and what they could be doing, and you can explain that gap to executives and operations teams alike.

As a Solutions Architect (SA), you will own the technical solution for a book of enterprise accounts, from discovery through a validated build.

This is an advisory role with hands-on build responsibility. You will be prescriptive about the decisions a customer needs to make, including the sequence, the trade-offs, and their technical consequences, and you will give a recommended starting point. The customer owns the final content of their taxonomy. You make sure they can make those decisions early, with confidence, and build something that lasts. You will work closely with Customer Success, our Forward-Deployed Product Managers, Enablement, Support, and Product.

What You'll Do

Design and deliver the right solution

Lead technical discovery: understand the customer's workflow from brief to reporting, what consumes Claravine data downstream, and what that system requires.
Solve the business requirement rather than the stated request, and have that conversation openly when the two differ.
Design solutions that the customer's own administrator can maintain and that survive their next reorganization.
Build to a high standard (structure, naming, testing, and documentation) and validate against real customer data before declaring a build complete.
Surface scope change, risk, and blockers early instead of absorbing them quietly.

Advise customers through the decisions that stall implementations

Guide customers through the taxonomy and governance decisions they need to settle (structure, granularity, ownership, approvals, and enforcement) using Claravine's decision guides and a recommended starting point.
Bring these decisions forward to kickoff and discovery, where they are cheap, rather than letting them block the build.
Challenge what customers bring instead of overlaying Claravine on top of a broken process, and identify the organizational problem when it is presented as a technical one.
Document the why behind every design decision as it is made.

Drive value after go-live

Maintain current-state documentation for each account you own: what is built, what is used, and what is dormant.
Identify the top unrealized capabilities for every account and make that gap visible through repeatable plays, run alongside the Customer Success Manager (CSM).
Take over build support from our Forward-Deployed Product Managers at handoff and support incremental growth into new teams, business units, and use cases.

Be the technical authority on the platform and the ecosystem

Know what the platform does and where it stops, and never commit the product to behavior it does not have.
Design against the constraints of adjacent systems such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), ad platforms, digital asset management (DAM) and product information management (PIM) systems, customer data platforms (CDPs), data warehouses, and work management tools.
Resolve complex technical questions and Tier 2 issues, routing routine requests to Support and true defects to Engineering with clear evidence.

Make the product and the team better

Turn customer friction into structured product input, with business impact, affected accounts, and workarounds attached.
Contribute patterns, playbooks, and design decisions to the SA knowledge base as work completes, and take part in design review in both directions.
Keep accounts transferable on documentation rather than on a meeting, and take a defined role in onboarding new SAs.

What Success Looks Like

30 days: You have completed onboarding and know the tools, processes, and people you will work with every day. You have gone deep on the Claravine platform by building templates, lists, and integrations hands-on, so you understand how customers use it to govern their marketing data. You have also taken on your first customer account.
90 days: You are managing a full book of accounts and working independently. You lead discovery sessions, kick off new customer engagements, and design and deliver solutions that fit each customer's workflows and tech stack. You work through technical challenges with confidence, with the team behind you for the toughest problems.
6 months: You lead customers through the full lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through build and ongoing optimization. You are the voice of the customer in product conversations, you add to our shared knowledge base, and you share insights that help the wider Customer Success team serve customers better.
12 months: You are a fully ramped Solutions Architect and a trusted technical advisor to your customers. You guide them on data strategy, taxonomy, and integration decisions, deliver work to a consistently high standard, and help raise the bar for the team through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and process improvement.

What You Bring

Required

4+ years in solution architecture, solutions consulting, technical implementation, or marketing technology at a B2B SaaS company or agency serving enterprise customers.
Hands-on experience with marketing and analytics ecosystems, such as Adobe Analytics and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Google Analytics, Campaign Manager 360, DV360, Meta Ads Manager, DAM or PIM systems, and Workfront. [Confirm which are essential versus "experience with several of these."]
A strong understanding of taxonomy, metadata, campaign tracking, and naming conventions, and why clean data matters for reporting, attribution, and AI.
Comfort working with APIs, file-based integrations, and data flows.
A consultative approach: you can lead a discovery session, push back with evidence, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, from operations teams to executives.
Strong documentation habits and the discipline to build things other people can maintain.
Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in your work, and a clear view of where human judgment is needed.

Preferred

Willingness to travel for customer meetings and team events.
Scripting or SQL experience.
Experience designing or governing taxonomies across multiple business units, or driving adoption of data standards in a large organization.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Claravine, Inc is committed to the principles of equal employment. It is our intent to build and maintain a work environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation based on an individual’s race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status, protected medical leaves, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

We Encourage You to Apply

We know that some candidates, especially those from historically underrepresented groups, may hesitate to apply unless they feel they meet 100% of the requirements. If you’re excited about this role and believe you could be a great fit, we encourage you to apply. Your unique experiences and perspective could be exactly what we need.
